row.name: Panic Room: Ghosts of the Past
row.detailed_description: You find yourself in a dark, ominous mansion. Twilight, creaking floorboards, whispers from the void... The house is full of visions of the past and ghostly shadows lurking in dark corners. At every moment, you feel the hostile gaze of an invisible observer between your shoulder blades. To find a way out, you must explore the rooms, peer into the most hidden corners, search for keys, solve puzzles, and complete tasks. Nothing here is accidental – every action affects your future fate. You must make a choice: join the Followers or go into the Underground. But what if both paths are part of someone else's game? Who can you trust when every word could be a lie, and any help could be a carefully planned trap? Something greater is happening behind the scenes. Someone is pulling the strings, arranging the pieces, and setting the rules. Are you a puppet or a puppeteer? Unravel the conspiracy. Learn the terrible truth. Walk the path from a pawn to a player. It's not an ordinary story. It's 'Panic Room: Ghosts of the Past', where escape is just an illusion. Are you ready to fight for freedom? The game offers you: ·        A non-linear, captivating plot that holds your attention from the first minutes. ·        Detailed locations with realistic textures that create a deep immersion in the world of the mysterious mansion. ·        A variety of puzzles, collections, and mini-games in the hidden object genre. ·        Several modes of searching for objects for diverse gameplay. ·        The ability to add friends, communicate, help each other, and give gifts. ·        A completely free game with regular updates and events.   You will love this game if: ·        You enjoy the 'hidden object' or 'I seek' genre, like finding hidden objects, solving complex puzzles, and collecting collections. ·        You like captivating stories with mysteries, unexpected twists, and a dark atmosphere.   'Panic Room: Ghosts of the Past' is a game available for free on PC, phones, and tablets. Join and become part of an exciting mystical adventure!
row.short_description: What awaits a prisoner who wakes up in the house of a host known for his cruel games?
row.notes: This game contains adult content that is presented primarily in textual form (story descriptions, dialogues). The visual component includes static images that may contain the following elements: - Textual descriptions of conflicts and acts of aggression between characters. - Artistic, stylized depictions of blood in static illustrations. - The storyline touches on the theme of criminal acts, which are described in the text. - The narrative contains hints and indirect descriptions of characters consuming alcohol and tobacco. All listed elements are part of the dark storyline and serve to create atmosphere and explore the game's themes. There are no explicit sexual scenes or detailed acts of violence in the game.

row.name: Empower Your Intent
row.detailed_description: Empower Your Intent is an atmospheric rhythm game that helps build mindfulness and intentionality while consuming entertaining software. Researched and designed to enhance your mental state while avoiding addictive patterns. Mesmerizing projectiles are choreographed to the rhythms and melodies of the music. Focus the timing and direction of your sparks to burst the projectiles into an eruption of flower petals.   Potential Uses: A healthier alternative to ease cravings for highly-addictive software like social-media and other games.  A ritual to boost motivation and productivity before starting a bout of focused work. Relax: in general or to prepare for sleep.  Energize and train reflexes/ coordination.  Introduce gaming to those seeking to train new skills. (Has accessibility features so that people with no prior gaming experience can enjoy) Obviously you can just use it to have fun and enjoy the music too :p
row.short_description: Built for those who want to better themselves. A unique rhythm game designed to help reclaim your motivation and attention. Focus the timing and direction of your movements to burst projectiles into a mesmerizing eruption of flower petals.

row.name: Shifter
row.detailed_description: Shifter is a minimalist and atmospheric puzzle experience that will challenge your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills. In this unique puzzle-box adventure, you control a shifting square that moves continuously in a chosen direction until it hits an obstacle. Your goal? Find the perfect path to the exit. With 60 handcrafted levels spread across six distinct zones , Shifter introduces a variety of mechanics that keep gameplay fresh and engaging. Navigate through teleporters, activate moving walls, avoid deadly spikes, and discover even more surprises along the way. Each zone presents new challenges, encouraging players to think ahead, experiment, and refine their strategy. 🔹 Minimalist Aesthetic – A clean and atmospheric design that keeps the focus on the puzzles. 🔹 Unique Puzzle Mechanics – Master teleporters, shifting walls, spikes, and more. 🔹 60 Handcrafted Levels – A carefully curated difficulty curve with satisfying solutions. 🔹 Relaxing Yet Challenging – No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle-solving satisfaction. 🔹 Immersive Sound Design – A subtle, atmospheric soundtrack that enhances the experience. If you love clever puzzle games that require foresight and experimentation, Shifter will keep you thinking from start to finish. Can you find the right path through every level and escape the puzzle box?
row.short_description: Shifter is a minimalist and atmospheric puzzle game where you must navigate a shifting square through intricate puzzle-box levels to find the exit. With 60 handcrafted challenges spread across six unique zones, each with a unique twist. Can you master the shifting mechanics and escape every room?

Take to the stage at one of Japan's largest venues, 'Tokyo Super Arena,' meticulously replicated down to the smallest details. Enjoy breathtaking productions featuring over 100 types of dynamic lighting and stage effects. And that's not all - the movements, provided by expert motion actors, are recorded using professional motion capture technology, allowing us to capture every action, right down to their fingertips! The simple, intuitive rhythm action gameplay makes getting to grips with the game a breeze, even for newbies to the genre! There are 8 original songs for you to enjoy, with exclusive costumes for each, allowing you to fully savor the girls' evolving charm. One standout feature in this game is 'Live Customization.' Select your favorite member to stand in the center position, change vocal parts, customize outfits, and create your own unique performance. Personalize your very own 'Under Ichigo' experience! This game blends realistic live production, easy-to-learn yet hard-to-master rhythm action, and a high degree of customization. Join Under Ichigo and create the ultimate live performance! About 'Under Ichigo' Love as sweet as strawberries, aimed straight at your heart! Meet Under Ichigo, a three-member idol unit from LIGHTUP PROMOTION, featuring Himeka Momoyama, Miyu Yuzuhara, and Mei Aoyama! 🌸 Himeka Momoyama (Momoyama Himeka – Ichigo Pink) The spoiled princess of Under Ichigo! Nickname: Hime-chan 🍋Miyu Yuzuhara (Yuzuhara Miyu – Ichigo Lemon) The energetic style icon of Under Ichigo. Shy but full of curiosity, she absolutely loves all things cute. Nickname: MyuMyu 💙Mei Aoyama (Aoyama Mei – Ichigo Blue) The earnest leader of Under Ichigo. A former child star, she dreams of becoming an actress in the future. Nickname: MeiMei

Experience their first arena concert at one of Japan’s largest venues, 'Tokyo Super Arena,' recreated in real-time 3D. Enjoy professionally motion-captured dances and an intuitive, beginner-friendly rhythm game.

row.name: Everyone Fights
row.detailed_description: Everyone Fights is a turn-based strategy game where you build structures, recruit an army, and battle for land. Choose from 20 unique commanders , each with their own special unit, building, power, super, and trait . Command your army to victory through a series of campaigns to take over the world! Your goal is to capture enemy HQs while defending your own, whether battling AI, challenging friends, or playing through the campaign . Success requires managing both your army and city, building a powerful force to dominate the battlefield. With a diverse array of units at your command, engage in tactical combat and adapt your strategy as the day and night cycle reshapes the fight. As visibility shifts and unit effectiveness changes from dawn to dusk, new challenges and opportunities emerge. Get creative with the extensive level and character creators . Design custom maps with unique terrain and play styles. Craft your own commander—whether it's a fun, unique character or the most powerful leader possible. Lead your forces through four different campaigns in a war for global supremacy. Capture cities, unlock new characters, and battle for a world under your faction’s banner. Everyone Fights gives a new city-building spin to the familiar turn-based war gaming genre. Try it out!
row.short_description: Everyone Fights is a turn based city building and conquering strategy game. Complete with a map creator, character creator, campaign, multiplayer, and loads of characters with their own unique ways to play.

row.short_description: MimiBird is a crafting exploration game set in a place full of colorful nature, where you must craft different tools after collecting various materials in order to capture birds and take them to your grandmother.

row.name: Math Attack
row.detailed_description: Math Attack is a mathematical puzzle game, built around the idea of using math operations to attack various expressions and reduce them to zero. Each level presents a new expression involving integers, irrationals, complex numbers, or even polynomials. Armed with a limited set of operations like subtraction, logarithms, and differentiation, your challenge is to determine the optimal order in which to apply them. There are three categories of levels presented as folders in the level select: Real, Complex and Functions. Each category requires you to deduce certain properties of the expressions you work with. With no tutorial or hand-holding, you're dropped straight into a mathematical labyrinth, left to uncover how each operation shapes the expressions before you. Trial, error, and insight are your only guides. Features Minimalist Design – A clean and focused interface that keeps the math front and centre. 39 Handcrafted Levels – Puzzles spanning three distinct mathematical domains: Real, Complex, and Functions. Built-in Info Tool – Peek under the hood of each expression and visualize how different operations affect it. Free-Form Level Selection – Tackle any level in any order. No restrictions, just exploration. Undo & Redo – Experiment freely with different strategies and operation sequences.
row.short_description: Math Attack is a mathematical puzzle game about using math operations to reduce expressions to zero. Each level presents a clever numerical riddle hidden behind deceptively simple notation. It’s a game of logic, foresight, and elegant solutions.

row.short_description: DuckStruck is a fast paced, top down bullet hell pixel art shooter, where you play as... a duck! Battle enemy zombie ducks, and build defences to aid your survival with endless waves of enemies attacking you at every moment!

row.short_description: As you climb this place, you will fall countless times, sinking into despair. Prove that you're not just a loudmouth coward—reach the top. The 2D platforming jump game that will break your keyboard: I Wanna Ascend.

row.name: First Steps in Child Developmental Support
row.detailed_description: Welcome to “First Child Development Support”! This game is a serious game that allows players to experience the field of child development support. From the perspective of medical and welfare professionals or family members supporting children’s growth, players can learn about child development support and the flow of therapeutic interventions. Game Content • Story-based Progression Players take on the role of a nursing student or support worker participating in a practicum at a child development support facility. They will assist children with developmental traits and work with support staff and caregivers to learn about practical interventions and how to address challenges. • Choices that Influence the Story Throughout the story, players will encounter various choices that help them learn about appropriate support methods and the importance of communication with caregivers. Each choice is accompanied by explanations to deepen understanding of child development support. • Realistic Scenarios Supervised by experts in child development support, the game faithfully reproduces real-life support settings. Players will experience how professionals such as nursery teachers, child development support managers, and occupational therapists collaborate in providing support. Features • Approximately one hour of gameplay, with a save function allowing players to resume at any time. • Recommended for medical and welfare students, as well as middle and high school students interested in child development support. • The knowledge gained in the game can be applied to parenting and professional support settings. Recommended for • Those interested in child development support and therapeutic interventions. • Those who want to learn about child development. • Parents and support workers looking for appropriate support strategies. Development Team • Production & Supervision: Shinshu University Department of Pediatrics, Yukihide Miyosawa Voice in the preview video by Experience the World of Child Development Support In First Child Development Support , you will encounter children with developmental traits, their families, and the professionals who support them. Through gameplay, you will gain insight into the importance of support and the real challenges faced in the field. [Medical Disclaimer] This application provides information related to child development support and therapeutic interventions; however, it does not offer medical advice or individual diagnoses. The information within the app is general in nature and is not a substitute for personalized guidance or diagnosis. Although this application is supervised by medical professionals, we cannot guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the information provided. Always refer to official sources or consult a medical professional for advice. The developers and associated third parties assume no responsibility for any outcomes or damages resulting from the use of this application. Users are expected to act based on their own judgment and responsibility.
row.short_description: Yuuka, a nursing student, is doing a summer practicum at a Child Development Support Center. Explore the facility in a role-playing format and experience child support activities. Learn about medical care, therapeutic interventions, and home healthcare over three days.
row.notes: This game is an educational game designed to help players learn how to support children with disabilities. The game includes the following scenes: •A scene where a child experiences a seizure (depicted for educational purposes to provide medical knowledge). •Illustrations of medical care, such as gastrostomy (G-tube feeding) and catheterization (used as educational material for learning proper medical support). These elements are intended to help players gain the necessary knowledge to support children with disabilities, particularly those interested in the medical and welfare fields. The game does not contain excessive violence or sexual content.

row.short_description: Control your gaze with the arrow keys and stop the cute prisoners from escaping! A surveillance action game that requires quick decision-making and full concentration!

row.name: Jaro TCG
row.detailed_description: Este es un simulador físico de cartas. Tiene funciones automáticas limitadas, como robo de carta del mazo, pero para jugar, se ha de conocer el jueo JARO TCG mediante tutoriales o unirte al Discord a aprender. El jugador deberá arrastrar las cartas, eliminarlas y consultar los comandos para sacarle el máximo provecho en las opciones. Jaro TCG es un simulador del juego de cartas coleccionables de Jaro (Jaro TCG), no tiene modo de un jugador, se necesita emparejar contra los rivales con código. Puedes invitar a amigos o unirte al Discord para encontrar gente y unirte a la comunidad. Bienvenidos al universo de Jaro TCG (juego de cartas coleccionables) en su versión PC en Steam. Sumérgete en un universo donde la estrategia y la colección de cartas se fusionan para ofrecerte una experiencia inigualable en PC. Ponte en la piel de un poderoso líder y construye un mazo para buscar los amuletos. Aquel que primero consiga cuatro, ¡será el vencedor! Características destacadas: Colección Dinámica: Construye y personaliza tu mazo con una amplia variedad de cartas únicas, permitiéndote adaptar tu estrategia y estilo de juego. Modo de Juego: Invita a tus oponentes con código de sala o únete a ellos. En la comunidad de Discord encontrarás gente dispuesta a ponértelo muy difícil. Actualizaciones Constantes: Con expansiones y eventos regulares, siempre habrá nuevas cartas y desafíos esperando por ti. Basado en el cómic Jaro, Jaro TCG combina lo mejor del género de cartas para brindarte una experiencia fresca y emocionante. Ya seas un veterano en juegos de cartas o un recién llegado, encontrarás en Jaro TCG un título accesible y profundamente gratificante. ¡No esperes más! Descarga Jaro TCG en Steam y demuestra tus habilidades estratégicas en el campo de batalla. Se necesita conección a internet, teclado y ratón.
row.short_description: Juega ya mismo a Jaro TCG. Enfréntate a tus amigos invitándolos con un código y que gane el mejor.

row.name: Skilander
row.detailed_description: Grab your Ski's and race downhill while avoid melting ice caps and perilous pits in Skilander ! Proudly utilizing Ken Silverman's Build engine to provide what's possibly the first ever tactical FPS (First Person Skiing) game ever! Skilander is a game designed with the fun of speedrunning in mind and comes with an easy Quick reset, encouraging competitive play and improving your times through the built-in high score system. You play as Connor MacGleisberg , taking on the challenge of mastering 3 difficult Skiing slopes. But you are not alone! The legendary ski shop maintainer Seppo from the city of Jaemsae is there to provide you valuable assitance! Remember – when in doubt, the right way is always the downhill. Reach speeds you could have never imagined before and control the awesome power of 'Snowquelching' ! Some highlights: - Six funky tracks utilizing Ken's own KDM digital music format for some authentic 90s tech. Never used in Build engine games before! - Cool speedrunning friendly features such as quick reset, in-game timer and Full Run Tracking - Three Gnarly stages to master with a fully voiced over fourth tutorial stage to get you started - Supports both keyboard and controller play, Glorious! - Want to make maps? Just open one in any compatible BUILD editor, save and play your own creations, Way cool! - Most of all, expect some Outrageous lighthearted fun!

row.name: Yurei Hunt
row.detailed_description: Yurei Hunt – A Supernatural Prop Hunt Like No Other Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer prop hunt game set in a world of haunted, mystical locations. Play as a Yurei, a ghost that can possess almost any object to hide, trick, and escape, or as a Hunter, searching for spirits disguised in plain sight. Each map is filled with interactive elements that both sides can use to outsmart each other, making every round a thrilling mix of strategy, deception, and quick thinking. Proximity Voice Chat Immerse yourself in the haunting atmosphere of Yurei Hunt with real-time proximity voice chat! Communicate with your teammates and strategize, but beware—your voice travels just like in real life. The closer you are to someone, the clearer they hear you. As you move away, your voice fades into the eerie silence. Ghosts can whisper... or taunt! Hunters and ghosts alike can use voice chat, making every round an intense mind game. Feel the tension rise as you hear distant whispers in the dark—was that your teammate... or something else? Stay silent, stay hidden... or risk being heard! Immersive Environments & Evolving Gameplay Explore diverse maps inspired by eerie traditional Japanese locations and futuristic cyberpunk cityscapes . From cursed shrines cloaked in mist to neon-lit streets pulsing with energy, every setting offers unique ways to outmaneuver your opponents. Key Features 🌏 Diverse Maps – Haunted shrines, dense forests, cyberpunk streets, and more, each designed for mind games and strategy. 🌀 Tactical Abilities & Deception – As a Yurei you can turn into almost any object in the map and you can manipulate your surroundings, creating illusions and using darkness to evade capture. 🎮 Multiplayer  – Play with up to 8 players , competing with friends or online opponents. Dynamic Weather: Thick fog, sudden snow, or lightning strikes can change visibility and create new strategies for both Yurei and Hunters. Dynamic World Elements: Each map features unique interactive elements that shape the game. Turn off streetlights with switches to cloak Yurei in darkness, or extinguish lanterns in shrines for a stealthy escape. From flickering neon signs to creaky doors, every environment offers new ways to hide, hunt, and manipulate the shadows. ⚡ Advanced Graphics & Performance – Powered by Unreal Engine’s latest technology , with Nvidia DLSS ensuring smooth, high-performance gameplay . Will you become the hunter or the hunted ?
row.short_description: Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer hide & seek prop hunt game where deception is key. Play as a Yurei, possessing objects & using abilities, or as a Hunter, relying on instincts & proximity voice chat to track them. With a world full of tricks, surprises & eerie tension, every match is a battle of wits.

row.name: Lunacid - Tears of the Moon
row.detailed_description: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is a First Person Dungeon Crawler made with the Sword of Moonlight - King’s Field making tool from 2000. Explore various dungeons for powerful weapons and spells to forestall the previsioned end of the world. The Kingdom of Lyria rests in darkness, surrounded on all sides by the vast poison sea. In ages long past, brilliant silver moonlight fell upon Lyria, leading to its accession as a great kingdom of magic. But this time of solace may soon end. Calamis Cerulean was granted a vision of this macabre future, the Great Old One who sleeps beneath the earth will soon awaken from it's slumber and plunge the world into another dark age. He must venture into dangerous lands to gather magics of light and dark. Only then can he coax the silver moonlight to fall upon the Great Old One and lull it back into a deep sleep.
row.short_description: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is a First Person Dungeon Crawler made with the Sword of Moonlight - King’s Field making tool from 2000. Explore various dungeons for powerful weapons and spells to forestall the previsioned end of the world.

row.name: Apple Rabble Dazzle

Versus: Take turns deciding moves and outperform your friends!* *Versus is the only mode that requires a minimum of two players.
row.short_description: Harvest apples all year round!

row.name: Scare Crow
row.detailed_description: In Scare Crow, you will unleash your inner prankster by playing as Casey the Crow, who is feuding with squirrels over their limited food source. In a blend of stealth and 3rd person tower defense gameplay, you will hide and set traps to jump-scare your skittish enemies and send them fleeing your territory in fear. Protect your birdseed Your precious bird feeders are under siege! Sergeant Squeak and his squirrel army are eyeing your tasty treasures with greedy determination. Your mission is to stop them before they sink their paws into your beloved snacks. Every seed you save brings you closer to victory—and every loss stings. Lure your enemies Publicly known intel: squirrels love acorns—and that love is a weakness you can use against them. Toss acorns in strategic spots to lure these knuckleheads off their paths......and right into whatever you’ve got waiting for them. Scare invading squirrels These skittish squirrels may come in numbers, but a good scare is all it takes to send them scrambling! From leaping out of bushes to sneaky greetings from behind, unleash your arsenal of pranks and watch them panic, scatter, and bolt across the yard in hilarious chaos. Play your way! Outsmart your furry foes—whether by jump-scaring, trapping, or kicking their butts off the bird feeders, the choice is yours! Use balloons, sandboxes, beehives and other hilarious backyard props to turn your territory into the ultimate prankster’s playground!
row.short_description: Play as a mischievous crow in this stealth-meets-tower-defense game. Outsmart invading squirrels with traps and jump-scares to drive them out of your backyard.

row.name: Faceless
row.detailed_description: In this short but intense action-adventure game, you play as a faceless guardian, the last protector of a dying village lost in the endless desert. When a lone traveler destroys the village’s only water source, you are tasked with delivering justice—only to uncover a deeper mystery that could halt the relentless desertification of the world. With responsive combat, easy-to-learn mechanics, and about two hours of fast-paced action, Faceless is an accessible yet challenging experience. Master its fluid movement and strategic encounters to uncover the truth and reclaim the desert’s lost life. The fate of your village—and perhaps the world—rests in the hands of a warrior with no face, but endless resolve.
row.short_description: Faceless is a fast-paced action-adventure game with tight combat, platforming, and strategic customization. Dodge traps, battle mechanical foes, and equip mystical masks to alter your abilities. With easy-to-learn mechanics and fluid movement, it delivers an intense yet accessible experience.

row.name: Little Luna
row.detailed_description: In  Little Luna , you play as a brave moth who has fallen deep underground, far from the light of the surface. Guided by the mysterious power of  Luna —a lost goddess of lunar light—you must navigate treacherous terrain, solve intricate puzzles, and find your way back to the world above. But  Luna  is more than just a guide; her magic is the key to your survival. Can you harness her power and escape the darkness? What happens when every second counts, and every mistake could lead to failure?  Little Luna  invites you into a world where logic and quick thinking become your greatest allies. Travel through mysterious platforms, activate magical lunar blocks, and find your way through intricate puzzles. But don’t think it’s easy! These blocks don’t just activate—they can move, reshaping the level before your eyes. And time? It’s never on your side. You’ll need more than just brains—you’ll need lightning-fast reflexes.
row.short_description: Little Luna is an engaging puzzle-platformer where every step is a race against time! Help little moth to escape the dark and dangerous cave!

row.name: Triage
row.detailed_description: Step into the role of a doctor in the town of Stagmarch, where an otherworldly illness is mutating residents. Get to know your patients, diagnose their illnesses, and treat them. However, you have limited medicine, and every day your patients get worse. How far will you go to save others? MEET THE PATIENTS WHO YOU SAVE MATTERS Your patients all hold important roles in Stagmarch, and the town will feel their absence. More than just their fates rest in your hands. YOU CANNOT SAVE EVERYONE There's not enough medicine to go around, and as the only doctor you'll have to decide who gets treated and who gets left behind. LEARN ABOUT YOUR PATIENTS Throughout 3 days of work at the town's clinic, get to know your patients. Find out who they really are. CRAFTING To treat the sick, harvest herbs from the clinic’s garden and make your own medicines from them. Refer to the prior doctor’s notes if you need to, because if you screw it up you could make things worse... IMMERSIVE ATMOSPHERE In this mansion turned clinic, discover what sort of secrets linger within these halls… Triage features many endings, all different varieties of bad! Triage was developed over the course of 1 academic year as part of the Champlain College Game Studio capstone project.
row.short_description: Step into the role of a doctor in the town of Stagmarch, where an otherworldly illness is mutating residents. Get to know your patients, diagnose their illnesses, and treat them. However, you have limited medicine, and every day your patients get worse. How far will you go to save others?
row.notes: Triage will contain strong language, blood, and medical malpractice.

row.name: shutterbuds
row.detailed_description: Explore a National Park with up to 3 of your photojournalist friends. Take jobs from top magazine brands, and then hit the trail in search of interesting landmarks and goofy creatures to photograph. Use your pay to buy useful items and cosmetics. You’ll be sure to make the front page in a flash! ДИСКЛЕЙМЕР : Проверьте минимальные системные требования, чтобы узнать, сможет ли ваш компьютер запустить shutterbuds! [shutterbuds was developed over 1 academic year as a part of Champlain College's Game Studio Capstone program] COOPERATIVE MULTIPLAYER Explore a National Park with up to 3 of your friends! Work together to complete jobs for top magazine brands or just smack your comrades upside the head with a hammer (sickle not included). CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER shutterbuds contains a bunch of funny and interesting cosmetic options for you to unlock and personalize your character with! Some of them may cost your your hard-earned words, but if you complete enough jobs you're sure to make plenty of money. YOU HAVE A CAMERA AND CAN TAKE PICTURES Armed with your trusty Rejec brand digital camera, you can take photos of anything you see. You can caption these pictures, display them in game, or save them to your PC. SILLY LITTLE GUYS The park is filled with a variety of unique creatures, all with their own behaviors and personalities! MAKE THE FRONT PAGE IN A FLASH As you complete more jobs, the magazines you work for will be filled out with your photos. As you improve, new magazine issues are unlocked with more challenging missions. Some say that a picture is worth 1,000 words, but as a rookie, yours are gonna be worth less until you build your rep.
row.short_description: Explore a National Park with up to 3 of your photojournalist friends. Take jobs from top magazine brands, then hit the trail in search of interesting landmarks and goofy creatures to photograph. Use your pay to buy useful items and cosmetics. You’ll be sure to make the front page in a flash!

row.name: Angvik : Returns
row.detailed_description: Angvik: Returns is a fan game inspired by the platform action game Angvik , which was loved for its unique atmosphere and high difficulty. While maintaining the original's core philosophy of 'only one chance', it adds a different kind of fun with new content. As the last hope of a fallen kingdom, the player embarks on a journey to reclaim the lost legacy and restore the balance of the world. Unknown creatures, dangerous terrain, and various weapons and items that can be obtained through exploration await you along the way. But don't let your guard down. With only one life, you must survive until the end. [Key Features] - 6 unique classes: Play with different weapons and strategies - New level design: Different map composition and terrain traps from the original - Various enemies and boss monsters: New enemies and attack patterns that are different from the original add to the tension. - Exploration and rewards: Find hidden artifacts and equipment throughout the map to strengthen your abilities. - Leaderboard: Register your name and country on the leaderboard with quick and accurate play.
row.short_description: A fan game capturing the nostalgia of Angvik! Embark on a challenging and fun-filled 2D action platformer adventure with unique equipment and combat styles.

row.name: ZODIAC
row.detailed_description: 옛날, 밤하늘은 수많은 별자리로 가득 차 있었고, 이 별자리들은 세상에 희망과 조화를 가져다주는 빛이었다. 그러나 암흑의 존재, '어둠의 군주'가 나타나 별자리들의 빛을 삼켜버렸다. 희미해진 밤하늘은 더 이상 세상을 비출 수 없었고, 사람들은 어둠 속에서 길을 잃고 희망을 잃어갔다. 이때, 별자리를 수호하는 별의 정령들은 마지막 남은 힘으로 별의 아이를 탄생시켰다. 별의 아이는 어둠에 맞설 수 있는 빛의 힘을 가진 존재로, 별자리들의 빛을 되찾고 세상을 구원할 유일한 희망이었다.
row.short_description: 황도 12궁을 배경으로 펼쳐지는 판타지 어드벤처! 별의 아이의 운명을 짊어지고 잃어버린 별자리를 찾아나서세요. 장르 : 퍼즐 + 어드벤쳐 + 3D + RPG 레퍼런스 : 젤다의 전설, 아스트로봇, Tunic 차별점 : 별자리 컨셉과 퍼즐 요소를 합친 RPG 다양한 퍼즐을 해결하고, 몬스터를 물리쳐 잃어버린 별자리를 되찾아주세요! 퍼즐을 풀고, 몬스터를 물리치며 잊혀진 별자리의 비밀을 밝혀내는 흥미진진한 여정이 시작됩니다.

row.name: Witch Hazel
row.detailed_description: Witch Hazel is an enticingly cozy, witch themed whimsical gardening simulator where you can immerse yourself in the unique joy and whimsy of tending to your very own magical garden. Play as the intrepid Hazel Newt, a young, adventurous garden witch, and develop your powers, grow magical plants, and maybe even find your own witchy animal companion! As your mystical powers grow, unlock new seed types and discover what each plant has to offer! Explore different patterns in your garden and discover what secrets lie within the magical plots. Witch Hazel is a lovely escape from the stressors of life into a relaxing, cozy world of whimsy and wonder. Gardening simulation -Five magical items to discover -Four magical plants to grow Three days of whimsical gardening fun This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: An enticingly cozy, witch themed gardening simulator. immerse yourself in the joy and whimsy of tending to your magical garden. Develop your powers, grow magical plants, and maybe even find your own witchy animal companion!

row.name: Pawns of War
row.detailed_description: Searching for a ray of salvation inside this nightmare. The year is 2044. There is a war going on in the world between two superpowers. On neutral territory, you will have to guard the base as usual, but suddenly the war catches up with you here. You will have to assemble a squad of different characters, equip them, give them weapons and join the battle. The battle scene is presented in the form of 3x3 cells. Place the units correctly on it, choose the battlefield and win against a randomly generated enemy units. Upgrade your characters, buy weapons in the store for in-game currency, and perform daily boss battles. Experience fear and anxiety when faced with unknown nightmares, manage your resources carefully. An atmospheric action autobattler and a short-story about personality, memory, as well as the horrors of the unknown and unknowable awaits you.
row.short_description: Dark parallel world in which humanity has destroyed itself. And only small colonies have survived the last centuries holding on to power at the expense of the totalitarian regime of government. You were thrown here after your death, is this how you were given a second chance?
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

row.name: CLTRS
row.detailed_description: CLTRS is an experimental and artistic game that invites players to discover and explore pleasure through an intuitive, sensory, and short experience. Designed as a meditative and interactive journey, the game transforms education into an act of play, curiosity, and empowerment. With one-button gameplay and a peaceful, aesthetic world , CLTRS offers a unique perspective on pleasure, intimacy, and body awareness. Through symbolic interactions and fluid exploration , the game provides an opportunity to reconnect with a part of the body too often overlooked.
row.short_description: Sometimes to reach the climax you just need to explore...

row.name: Rezarus
row.detailed_description: Step into the cockpit of Rezarus and experience a pulse-pounding fusion of retro aesthetics and firepower built on a modern game engine. Seize control points, capture enemy flags stations, and outmaneuver and outduel your foes. Your mission is simple: destroy the enemy before they destroy you. 🌐 Online : First-person tank arena combat game, teams of 3–10 players go up against one another in arcade-style warfare—with every keystroke determining victory or defeat. ⌨️ Revolutionary keyboard-only controls : Say goodbye to boring copypasta twitchy mouse-aiming and hello to precision maneuvers that reward the dance of mastering both your tank's position and turret aim. Every movement is mapped to your keys, creating a tactile battlefield experience that grows deeper and more rewarding the longer you play. Whether you’re coordinating a pincer in Capture the Flag or holding the line on a contested control point, keyboard tactics become your ultimate weapon—something no other first-person tank combat game can touch. Once you master them, you'll never be able to go back to a mouse-controlled tank combat game again. Four Electrifying Game Modes 🚀 Total Wars CTF:  Unleash chaos with an arsenal of tanks and weapons at your fingertips. Seize control points, capture enemy flags, and wage all-out war by any means necessary—whether you rain shells from afar or charge headlong into the fray. In Total Wars CTF, victory belongs to the bold and the relentless. 🚀 Laser Wars:  Streamlined and simplified, yet tactical as ever. Each player commands a single tank equipped with a laser cannon, plus one customizable module to tweak your playstyle. With perfectly balanced loadouts, teamwork and coordination are everything—so lock in with your squad and execute flawless flanks. 🚀 Phoenix Wars:  Two shots; one chance to reign supreme. This mode strips combat back to raw FPS fundamentals: lead your target, dodge incoming fire, and prove your sharpshooting prowess. Every engagement tests your reflexes and decision-making—survive the heat, and you’ll rise from the ashes like a true Phoenix. 🚀 Impulse Wars:  Gravity is your deadliest weapon. Instead of chasing kills, you’ll mastermind physics: push your opponents towards towering ledges, launch them off ramps, and watch them tumble into oblivion. Impulse Wars rewrites the rules of engagement—outsmart your foes and let physics do the rest. Early Access Join us in Early Access! After extensive alpha testing and with core gameplay fully in place, we’re opening up the gates so you can help us fine-tune server performance for bigger online battles. Your feedback will help guide future optimizations that ensure not only smooth larger-scale combat, but also fun. Your participation will help shape Rezarus’s future along with the rest of the community passionate about bringing back the fun in arcade style tank warfare. 🎯 Hop onto Rezarus today and be among the first to redefine tank warfare! It's free and there's no account registration necessary! Indie by Design, AAA in Ambition Rezarus is the passion project of a solo developer and dedicated closed-alpha testing community. Don’t let “indie” fool you—Rezarus already provides an online experience that stands up to big-budget blockbusters. Smaller team, bigger heart: creative freedom fuels innovation here, making your arcade-style tank warfare experience truly one-of-a-kind!
row.short_description: An online first-person tank arena combat game where teams of 3–10 players go up against one another in arcade-style warfare—seize control points, capture enemy flags, outmaneuver and outduel your foes. Dare you master the keys and dominate the retro designed arenas like the OG gamers once did?

row.name: Der Fachinformatiker-Trainer
row.detailed_description: The IT Specialist Training Program for Trainees and Career Changers ;) This program was developed by the two of us (Jakub and Patrick) during our own career change training. It is designed to help others pass the AP1 exam. The current question catalog in the game focuses on the topics relevant to the first exam. This means that other professions (such as IT system electronics technicians) can also use this trainer. Since we are developing this privately as a two-person team, please be considerate of the program's quality. At the moment, it does not include sound effects or elaborate graphics. Bugs may occur, but in general, the game should run without issues. Features: Random questions from the entire question catalog Questions focused on specific topics (e.g., hardware, project management, etc.) Time limit and points system (Theoretically) playable on Steam Deck Controller support (tested: Xbox controller) should work For additional planned features, please refer to the Early Access section. row.detailed_description: 🔥 A Thrilling PvP Third-Person Shooter! 🔥 Gear up and dive into intense action! Fight with friends or against each over! row.short_description: A fast-paced, dynamic PvP shooter. Choose your strategy with a variety of weapons and dive into multiple game modes! Team up with friends or battle against others! Use buffs like shields, speed, super jumps and invisibility to dominate the battlefield!

row.name: B.A.D. Institute
row.detailed_description: After transferring to Brightwater Art & Design, a boarding school in Utah, Háo awakens to find the school's campus overtaken by monstrous creatures taking appearances from people he once knew. Equipped with only a phone, attempt to escape this campus where danger lurks at every corner. With enemies roaming the halls that can't be defeated, Háo must learn what happened and how to survive in this new world. You'll hide, explore, outsmart, and survive using only your wits. Can you survive your stay at B.A.D. Institute? FEATURES Explore the campus of Brightwater Art & Design to find a way out Stun enemies with your phone to escape dangerous situations Use your surroundings to your advantage to hide from enemy sights  Find papers that influence the course of the story
row.short_description: Once you come to B.A.D. Institute, you'll never leave. A first-person survival horror game where hiding and outsmarting your enemies is the only way to survive. Uncover the mystery of what happened at this boarding school and how to escape with your life.

row.name: The Last Son of Vorona
row.detailed_description: After an alchemist spent his days working to craft the philosophers stone, he accidentally released a plague onto the Transylvanian village of Cavarna. Izaak is the last member of a family of hunters who sought to create a land free of persecution, and their missing leader wanted to achieve that dream through Alchemy. After accepting a job in the village, Izaak slowly meets familiar faces while seeking the end of the plaguebearer.  Find a way to stop the plague from consuming you and cavarna. In The Last Son of Vorona, you start with nothing but a bounty  from Cavarna's Priest- '...an evil that once hid in shadows now leeches from the castelul and our count has disappeared...' Features Engage in first Person Melee combat where you slash through rats and dash to avoid attacks. Explore the Helltorn village of Cavarna and uncover the tragedy of Cavarna through it's peoples last notes. Take a break in the serene Cavarnian Forest. Turn into a rat and navigate Castelul Cavarna's rat maze. Race against time before the Lycanthropic Plague takes over your body. Find out what happened to the Sons of Vorona and who (or what) is responsible for the plague. If you want to make God laugh, tell him your plans. built for educational purposes.
row.short_description: In this first person combat adventure, you have one job: Destroy the plague before it destroys you. Slash, dash, jump and run through rats or run the rat race yourself.

row.name: Bouncy Butt Castle
row.detailed_description: BOUNCY BUTT CASTLE A game all about Butts and Bouncy Castles. Drop in with your friends, Activate Star Power-ups and Squash your opponents! Bounce in the Pit that is Free For All, Conquer the World in King of the Slide or Race to come first in Sky High Parkour! Make yourself stand out by finding outfits in-game. BUTTS Using your rear, propel yourself in any given direction, allowing you to maneuver like a deadly spring. TRICKS Commit to flips, in different directions to fill up your launch meter allowing your gasses to propel you forwards. POWERUPS Launch yourself through stars throughout levels to earn power-ups that will aid you in battle, and assist in platforming! GAMEMODES Play a variety of gamemodes, from ones you know and love such as Free For All, or new ones such as King Of The Slide and Sky High Parkour. Each with their own set of maps. BOUNCE IN STYLE Find Collectiballs throughout the maps, unlocking different outfits, colours and fart trails for you to style yourself with! Who has the shiniest rear of them all?
row.short_description: Its all about Butts and Bouncy Castles. Launch in with your friends or foes. Collect star power-ups and squash your opponents with your rear! Make yourself stand out against the competition in style!

row.name: WARMONGER:45
row.detailed_description: YEAR: 2045 In a future under constant threat of complete annihilation , several technologically-advanced superpowers have combined. Now, they're sending their enhanced soldiers and war machines to claim as much territory as possible. Will you hold the line for the overwhelming force of the Federation of America , or push back alongside the United Nations of Eurasia ? Key Features Large-scale multiplayer that allows up to 60 players at once (30v30). Dynamic stat system . Each class has a different set of health and weight. Weight determines walking speed, stamina usage, and stamina regeneration. Weight-based weapon sway that affects accuracy. Diverse class system with specialized soldiers for every situation. Assault (w/ ammo box) Engineer (w/ deployable wall) Medic (w/ medic bag) Sniper (w/ marksman rifle) Advanced classes that become available as the battle wages on.
row.short_description: WARMONGER:45 is a large-scale sci-fi multiplayer FPS that features the worldwide conflict between the Federation of America and the United Nations of Eurasia. Face-off in 30-vs.-30 combat to dominate the battlefield using numerous specialized classes.
row.notes: Warmonger: 45 is a military-themed first-person shooter featuring large-scale battles between two opposing factions. Players engage in combat using a variety of firearms and explosives in an effort to capture and control objectives. The game includes frequent depictions of combat violence, including gunfire, explosions, and melee attacks. Corpses remain on the battlefield after a player is eliminated, but there is no blood or gore. There are no depictions of self-harm, drug or alcohol use, or sexual content. This game is suitable for players comfortable with military-style first-person shooter gameplay.

row.name: Lex Talionis A
row.detailed_description: Lex Talionis A, the law of retaliation, whereby a punishment resembles the offense committed. As Aliens you must fight your way through astronauts, drones and bosses in order to enact your revenge on the humans for their hostile takeover. Every alien life is sacred, and in this team based couch co-op experience you will have to place your trust in your companions to not use all your lives. There are four aliens to choose from with abilities ranging from a golf club to summoning a mammoth. But no matter who you choose you mustn't give up on your assault..THIS..IS..WAR!
row.short_description: Lex Talionis A is a team-based, 4 player, couch co-op where aliens fight astronauts, drones, and bosses for revenge against humanity. Choose from four aliens with unique abilities and survive together in this 2D Run n' Gun Adventure.
row.notes: Mature content includes blood, violence, and war.

row.name: Wuthering Waves
row.detailed_description: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world. We're working to resolve Wuthering Waves' compatibility with STEAM DECK and will share updates in the community. Thanks for your understanding! Welcome aboard, roving voyager. Upon the shores lay the silent embers of a world during the Ebb Tide. Desolated by the Lament, the erstwhile creations and earthly beings are left static. But they strike back, strong enough to penetrate the silence. Humanity has risen anew from the ashes of the apocalypse. And you, Rover, are poised for an adventure of Awakening. Companions to meet, enemies to conquer, new powers to gain, hidden truths to unveil, and unseen spectacles to behold... A vast world of endless possibilities awaits. The choice rests in your hands. Be the answer, be the leader, and follow the sounds to arrive at a new future. As Wuthering Waves echo endlessly, mankind set sail on a new journey. Rise and embark on your odyssey, Rover. Desolated by the Lament, civilization is born anew / Delve into an expansive world Embrace high degrees of freedom in immersive overworld explorations. Utilize flight, grapple and wall dash to travel great distances and overcome obstacles with little strain for stamina consumed. Strike fast and unleash your inner warrior / Engage in smooth & fast-paced combat Avail against enemy attacks in smooth and fast-paced combat. Apply easy controls of Dodge, Counterattack, Echo Skill, and unique QTE mechanisms that allow the fullest possibility of battle experience. Forte awakened, journey alongside your companions / Encounter Resonators Compose a harmonious battle concerto with Resonators of different abilities. Their unique Fortes revealing distinctive personalities will be your strong assets for the journey ahead. Power of your foes at your command / Collect Echoes to aid you in battle Capture lingering phantoms of Tacet Discords to harness your own Echoes. Upon this mystic land of everlasting reverberations, master a diverse array of Echo Skills to defeat formidable enemies.
row.short_description: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.

row.name: DashFire
row.detailed_description: About DashFire is an online multiplayer arena-style shooter, inspired by Quake and Unreal Tournament. Face off against 7 of your friends in this fast-paced first-person shooter experience! Up to 8 players compete in two unique maps, collecting a variety of weapons and other various pickups to dominate the competition! Features 8 Player Lobbies Server browser In game text chat 8 Unique Weapon Types 2 Unique Maps
row.short_description: A fast-paced arena-style shooter with an emphasis on movement, collect various weapons, and other pickups to dominate the competition in a peer-to-peer 8-person free-for-all!

row.name: Xerminus
row.detailed_description: Xerminus is a top down wave survival shooter where you need to annihilate increasingly ridiculous waves of enemies. No roguelite elements, no ingame upgrades, the only the sheer force of your twisted enemies. Expect no Survivors.  -Conquer arenas of the netherworld. -numerous enemies crawling out of forbidden void, to get you. -countless weapons(didnt count).
row.short_description: Survive randomized waves of enemies in top down arena combat. No upgrades or roguelite elements. No survivors.
row.notes: Zombie dismemberment with lots of gibs.

row.name: Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Experience Prologue Version Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator Prologue is your introduction to the world of mini car shop management! This Prologue version provides a taste of the full game, offering a similar experience with select content limitations. Manage your shop, customize mini cars, and take them to the race track for unique challenges. Get a feel for the exciting gameplay before diving into the full Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator! Experience special Prologue challenges across three unique chapters, each designed to introduce you in managing your shop, customizing mini cars, and racing them on the track! Find Rare Spare Parts Each car pack features a gacha system that adds an extra layer of excitement! Try your luck and draw for rare spare parts that could be the key to building your ultimate mini racer. Every draw offers a random part, making each pull a thrilling opportunity to enhance your collection. Sell Mini Cars Access a selection of highly detailed miniature racing car models designed to attract car enthusiasts. Carefully manage your stock to always have the best selection available, keeping your customers satisfied. As the shop owner, you can also start your personal mini car collection by opening car packs! Sell Spare Parts In addition to selling mini cars, provide a variety of spare parts to enhance their performance. From mini engines to wheels and unique components, offer your customers the best selection for building their dream cars. Each part has different quality levels and performance attributes, making inventory management a crucial strategy. Custom Car Showcase Show off your most impressive custom-built mini cars in a dedicated showcase area! Here, you can display your masterpieces for customers to admire and purchase. Set your own price based on the car’s performance and rarity. Test Drive Your Car Take your custom-built mini cars for a test drive on a race track! Experience their speed, handling, and unique upgrades firsthand. Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator Prologue offers an exciting preview of the full game, making it the perfect starting point for you. Begin your journey today and turn your shop into the ultimate destination for customers!
row.short_description: Test drive the game with three chapters challenge in this prologue version. Manage your mini racer car shop, sell mini cars and spare parts, and unleash your creativity with custom builds. Test drive your creations on the race track before putting them up for sale.

row.name: Yokai Survivor
row.detailed_description: Yokai Survivor is a single-player survivor-like auto-shooter. Face relentless waves of twisted yokai in a cursed underworld, harvest precious fruits, and master powerful ninjutsu skills to turn the tide. Grow stronger with each run, unlock deadly abilities, and carve your path through the darkness. It’s one ninja against a world of nightmares — how long can you survive? 🔥 Key Features ⚔️ Survive Relentless Yokai Hordes: Face chaotic, fast-paced battles against swarms of supernatural enemies. 🥷 Master Deadly Ninjutsus: Unlock and upgrade a diverse arsenal of ninjutsu abilities, combining them for devastating combos. ⛏️ Harvest & Progress: Collect materials during runs to invest in permanent upgrades and traits, enhancing future attempts. 🌌 Endless Procedurally Generated Nightmares: Each session offers a unique challenge with randomized enemy waves and arena layouts. 📈 Meta-Progression That Sticks: Persistent progression system allowing players to grow stronger over time and tailor their playstyle.
row.short_description: Yokai Survivor is a single-player survivor-like auto-shooter. Face relentless waves of twisted yokai in a cursed underworld, harvest precious fruits, and master powerful ninjutsu skills to turn the tide. It's one ninja against the underworld!

row.name: OCCT
row.detailed_description: OCCT (OverClock Checking Tool) is the best software for testing system stability, diagnosing hardware issues, and monitoring performance. Whether you're an overclocking enthusiast, a technician, or just want to ensure your PC is running smoothly, OCCT provides a powerful suite of tools to push your hardware to the limit. Processor (CPU) – Evaluate your CPU’s stability and performance with various test modes. Graphics Card (GPU) – Push your GPU to its limits with DirectX and CUDA-specific stress tests. Memory (RAM) – Detect potential errors by putting your RAM under heavy load. Power Supply (PSU) – Simulate extreme power consumption to assess PSU reliability With OCCT’s Stability Certificates , you can validate your system’s stability like never before. After passing a complete series of stress tests, receive a personalized, shareable certificate proving your hardware's robustness. Perfect for benchmarking, troubleshooting, or simply showcasing the performance of your setup. OCCT includes a powerful monitoring system that tracks: ✔ Temperatures (CPU, GPU, VRM…) ✔ Clock speeds and voltages ✔ Resource usage ✔ Sensor data (fans, power consumption, etc.) After each test, OCCT generates in-depth reports to help you analyze performance and detect potential hardware issues. With a modern and easy-to-use design, OCCT is perfect for both beginners and advanced users.
row.short_description: OCCT is the gamer's favorite app for stress testing their PC or Steam deck components and check for errors ! Find out if your latest crash is due to a hardware malfunction or yet another game bug, and see all monitoring and system information in an easy-to-use interface.

row.name: 战区危机
row.detailed_description: Warzone Crisis is a third person shooter game that supports online battles between 2-32 players. Players can create rooms and join the game through the Steam platform. The game adopts a red and blue two team battle mode, where players can pick up firearms, bullets, and bonus items in the map to enhance their combat abilities, including attributes such as health, shields, movement speed, and jumping ability. Each game lasts about half an hour, and the winner is determined based on the number of defeated opponents. The camp with higher accumulated tactical points wins. The game emphasizes strategy and skills, providing players with a thrilling and intense competitive experience.
row.short_description: The War Zone Crisis is a third person shooting game for online online combat on the Internet. The game supports remote online games through the steam platform. In the game, players play the roles of red and blue teams of anti-terrorism special forces。

row.name: Melodic Mage
row.detailed_description: Unleash the power of music in Melodic Mage , a 2D pixel art action shooter where every attack and dodge must follow the rhythm! Play as a wizard battling through dynamic levels, casting spells, dashing, and dodging— all in sync with the beat . Key Features 🎵 Rhythm-Based Combat – Cast spells and dodge enemy attacks in sync with the music. 🧙‍♂️ Magical Arsenal – Unlock and choose between different mages. ⚔️ Challenging Enemies & Bosses – Conquer diverse levels, each with their own final boss. 🎶 Hard mode  – For those looking for a challenge, the hard mode will punish you every time you miss a beat. Master the rhythm. Control the magic. Become the Melodic Mage!
row.short_description: A rhythm-based action shooter where you play as a mage, casting spells and dodging to the beat. Battle through dynamic levels, defeat challenging bosses, and unleash the magic of music!

row.name: Deductopia Chapter 1: Bring Your Pet to School Day
row.detailed_description: Can you sort out this chaotic classroom? Six kids, six pets, six desks--but whose is whose? Drag the right names and pictures to the right desks to win! row.short_description: Can you sort out this chaotic classroom? Six kids, six pets, six desks--but whose is whose? Drag the right names and pictures to the right desks to win!

row.name: 大圣伏魔：黑神话之无间劫
row.detailed_description: Restarting the myth, re-casting the legend Five thousand five hundred years after the distant era of conferred gods, the Three Realms ushered in a time of change again. 'Black Myth: Eternal Tribulation' takes you to a world that combines the essence of 'Wu Kong' and 'Investiture of the Gods'. Here, the three religions of Buddhism, Taoism and Demonism are constantly fighting, and the disputes between the mortal world, the fairy world, the demon world and the god world are intensifying. You will become a key role in this epic journey. As the descendant of the Three Pure Ones of Taoism, your mission is not only to assist Emperor Jiang in the crusade against Donghuang Taiyi, but also to uncover the secrets of your previous life, condense Pangu's flesh, and reshape the order of heaven and earth. In this mysterious land, every step may become a turning point in history, and every battle is a challenge to fate. Unique selling point Exciting PVE and PVP: Compete with other players in fierce PK and feel the real passion of battle. Visual feast-like skill effects: Every skill release is a display of visual art, allowing you to immerse yourself in a colorful magic world. Explore unknown fairy equipment: Find those mysterious treasures hidden in ancient legends, arm yourself, and embark on the road of strength. Exciting battle for heaven: Participate in large-scale team battles, fight for control of heaven, and write your own heroic chapter. Smooth game experience: The operation feel is optimized to the extreme, ensuring that every click can bring the most direct feedback. Story Background As Wuchao's ambition grows, he is plotting to unite various forces in an attempt to subvert the existing three-world structure. At this moment, a destined soul descends to the world, carrying the power of Pangu's blood, shouldering the great mission of reopening the world. This is not only a contest of strength, but also a test of wisdom and courage. 'Black Myth: Eternal Tribulation' is not just a game, it is a journey of pursuit of dreams, adventures and glory. Here, you can meet like-minded friends and face unprecedented challenges together; you can also explore the secrets hidden under the heavy fog alone. Whether you are an explorer seeking excitement or a guardian longing for peace, let 'Wukong' lead you into a mythological world that is both familiar and unfamiliar, and create a legendary story that belongs only to you!
row.short_description: Incorporating classic stories such as 'Wu Kong', as the descendant of the Three Pure Ones of Taoism, you will step into the fierce disputes among the human world, the demon world, and the god world, a fantasy world that is about to be reborn!

row.name: Houseplan
row.detailed_description: With societal developments and technologic advancement, visualization and virtual reality are becoming a greater and greater part of people's work and life. As its foundation, 3D simulation is rapidly changing from a technology that only some professionals can master to a basic skill that is popular among the general public. In reality, softwares supporting this technology usually have problems such as huge volume, complicated functions, low integration, high price, steep learning curve and poor comprehensive performance, which make them unable to meet needs for and affect the popularity of this technology. Houseplan is a 3D drawing and simulation software designed by senior design professionals, with professional and flexible modeling functions and an efficient rendering engine to achieve dynamic simulation with simultaneous drawing and rendering. With a small volume, high integration, excellent cost performance, the practical, easy-to-use, and efficient Houseplan can be widely applied to architectural and scene design, and can be used with virtual reality and metaverse. It is a user-friendly 3D software, suitable for individuals and organizations with any kind of background. Houseplan offers the most efficient 3D modeling for building planning, helping you complete your scheme design quickly and easily with just a few clicks. Houseplan offers advanced 3D modeling tools to satisfy diverse and complicated modeling requirements. It's simpler, lighter, and easier to use than other large and complex software on the market. Houseplan uses a high-performance rendering engine to sync 3D model editing with simulations, providing interactive and responsive environments that display rendered results instantly. With Houseplan, you can not only gain the power to effortlessly apply and fine-tune materials, but also seamlessly import a diverse array of materials from a wide range of sources, whether you're handling them individually or in bulk. With Houseplan, you can easily import DWG drawings and directly extrude them. Additionally, it supports importing of oblique photography and point cloud data, as well as various other file formats. Houseplan enables convenient addition of water, vegetation, terrain, and other scene elements, and provides the ability to exchange realistic weather environments. Moreover, you can easily add animation entities and set their movements. Houseplan provides tools for specifying camera points and video paths, allowing users to export images and videos. It also supports VR device viewing. Additionally, users can publish their designs as .exe files for independent operation, enabling image and video viewing, drawing new video paths, displaying properties, and switching weather environments.
row.short_description: Houseplan is a versatile and intuitive 3D modeling and real-time rendering software, providing a lightweight yet robust solution for visualizing and presenting design schemes.

row.name: Fallen Vestige
row.detailed_description: SAVE THE HUMAN RACE Seeking vengeance against the creatures that killed his family, embark on a journey to find the source and uncover the mystery of the creatures in this open-world light RPG with horror elements. EXPLORE AN OPEN-WORLD Venture through a post-apocalyptic earth from your homestead and uncover unearthly threats where danger lurks in every corner. Explore enemy encampments and abandoned points of interest such as caves and bunkers to find ways to access the source of the creatures. DISCOVER A COMPELLING STORY Unravel the story behind the downfall of earth, piece together clues scattered throughout the world to uncover the truth behind the monsters. Why are they here? FIGHT TO SURVIVE Face off against terrifying threats, hostile entities that lurk in the dark and prowl the desolate world whilst avoiding environmental hazards. Armed with axes, hammers, knives, rifles, stealth takedowns, and throwables such as grenades and more. PLAY HOW YOU WANT Whether you want to play with guidance or want to uncover the story yourself, with an intuitive objective system that can be enabled or disabled, you choose how to play the game. PARKOUR Scale infrastructure utilising means like vaulting, climbing, and jumping to reach areas otherwise inaccessible. PUZZLES Solve puzzles using clues found in the vicinity to crack safes and unlock access to new areas. SKILL TREE Gain XP through eliminating enemies and exploring locations to provide permanent benefits to your character, furthering strength, speed, stealth, and health. SCAVENGE Loot powerful equipment to improve your arsenal that will aid you in your journey from abandoned structures teething with threats. DYNAMIC WEATHER Immerse yourself in photogenic environments that features a real-time light-cycle and a weather system that features rain and snow.
row.short_description: Seeking vengeance against the creatures that killed his family, embark on a journey to find the source and uncover the mystery of the creatures in this open-world light RPG with horror elements. Explore, scavenge, fight, and survive through means such as parkour, puzzle solving, and skills.

row.name: コ、今に在り - Ko ima ni ari
row.detailed_description: Ko ima ni ari is an interactive story-driven game about the past, present and future of someone loosing slowly their sight. Venture into a simple and short visual novel driven by it's art, music and detail story. row.short_description: Ko ima ni ari is an interactive story-driven game about the past, present and future of someone loosing slowly their sight.

row.name: Phyllosoma
row.detailed_description: You are a lone hunter who awakens in the darkness. In a place where reality and hell are twisted together, there is only one goal : Reach the top of the fortress. Fight horrific enemies that seem to have crossed over from hell. Challenge yourself, grow stronger, and press onward. At the summit, face the being that awaits you. Features A 3D Soulslike Set in a Fortress Battle unfolds within a cursed fortress where hell and reality have merged for unknown reasons. Overcome cursed enemies and ascend toward the upper levels. The Fallen Fortress Explore every corner of the fortress to find your path upward. Look carefully—items needed for survival may be hidden nearby. Fast and Intense Combat The fortress is filled with many types of enemies. Strike down anything that blocks your way. Manage your stamina and control the flow of battle—your enemies are relentless. Guard & Counter System Guard at the exact moment of an enemy’s attack to trigger a Perfect Guard . Follow up with a Counter Attack . Master Perfect Guards and Counters to survive. Soul Gauge System The Soul Gauge is gained through normal attacks. Spend it to unleash powerful attacks on your enemies. Face Powerful Enemy Some enemies are extremely powerful. Use your Soul Gauge skills and items wisely. A Dreadful Presence Awaits At the upper levels of the fortress, the most terrifying being awaits you. Overcome the trials and move beyond. About the Team Team Respect Guild  is a small indie team of four developers who love games. We will continue to create fun and challenging experiences. Thank you for playing.
row.short_description: You are a lone hunter who awakens in darkness. Within a cursed fortress where reality and hell intertwine, your goal is clear: Reach the top. Fight horrific enemies, grow stronger, and face what awaits at the summit.

row.name: Myth of Lumi
row.detailed_description: Myth of Lumi is a 3D physics-based turf war game where you duel rival magicians in card throwing showdowns. Set in the underground utopian city of Prospera, play as Luce, an ambitious street performer striving to join the legendary Conclave—an elite circle of top-tier magicians. Recruit Lumis, mystical creatures bound within your playing cards, to aid you in battles and carve your path to fame and fortune. Master your skills, outwit your opponents, and rise to the top! THROW PLAYING CARDS Perfect your craft by adjusting your card throwing technique, Cover the most ground with your cards to dominate the battlefield. UNLEASH YOUR MAGIC Unlock more Lumis as you play. Harness the unique magical abilities of each Lumi to stack the deck in your favor. Chain multiple skills together to optimize your deck synergy! YOUR DESTINY AWAITS Rise through the ranks of Prospera's legendary magicians through dazzling displays of magic and high-stakes trials. Will you prove your worth or will your name be lost in the shuffle?
row.short_description: Myth of Lumi is a 3D physics-based turf war game where you duel rival magicians in card throwing showdowns. Recruit Lumis, mystical creatures bound within your playing cards, to aid you in battle and carve your path to fame and fortune.

row.name: 异兽洪荒
row.detailed_description: 游戏简介 游戏中玩家虽然出身平凡，但他热爱修行、无所畏惧，在洪荒之子的气运加持之下，一路逍遥闯荡，成为这片大陆上最特立独行的悟道者。大陆内每个地点活动都有不同挑战等着你，随着境界等级、战力的提升优化奖励和获得更多经验值，能够更好体验游戏。游戏内丰富的成长型系统诸如异兽、法宝、境界、升阶、神戒等能为玩家带来与众不同的修仙悟道体验。同时游戏中多种PVP、PVE战斗模式，不停刺激玩家战斗欲望。画面精美、效果逼真，会令玩家爱不释手，快来体验吧！ 日常任务 1.系统入口 位于界面上方的日常 2.系统玩法 日常中共有两个页签： 活跃； 活动大厅。 2.1活跃 完成其中的日常任务，可以获得活跃度 活跃度积攒到一定程度可以领取宝箱，宝箱中有大量日常资源 活跃度和任务每日刷新，记得及时领取 2.2活动大厅 活动大厅也可通过此入口进入 可以在此处查看每日的大型活动，以及活动的规则和内容 活动开启时，右下角还会有弹窗可以直接跳进相关页面 转生 1.入口 通过点击主界面下方-角色入口图标进入角色界面后，选择转生页签。 2.主界面 3.系统介绍 1）通过获取修为和银锭提升转生等级，提高属性和转生技能等级； 2）日常可通过界面内购买和野外BOSS掉落获得修为丹，使用修为丹即可获取修为； 3）转生技能可在PVP战斗时原地复活并恢复一定血量，技能冷却时间较长。转生等级越高，技能等级越高，冷却时间越短，恢复血量越多。 激战BOSS—野外BOSS 1.入口 界面右上角BOSS大殿图标。 2.主界面 3.系统说明 1）每个页签对应一个BOSS等级，提升转生等级后解锁新的页签； 2）每个页签共3张地图，每张地图的进入条件、掉落的装备阶数、道具不同，玩家可自由选择不同的地图挂机； 3）每个地图对应2种类型的怪，每种怪的数量不同，难度越高的怪掉率越多； 4）产出：人物装备、经验丹、法宝升阶材料、转生修为丹、银锭等。
row.short_description: 《异兽洪荒》是一款极具仙侠气息的大型动作角色扮演类游戏，神秘的故事让人体会到仙侠的神奇和性格魅力。在这款仙侠类游戏中，玩家将在上古洪荒世界中探索神秘的异兽之地。

row.name: ゴールド漁師 (金條釣手)

row.name: JungleBoys

row.short_description: Enter the jungle to fight for your survival in this local splitscreen showdown. Heal up, collect items to use in combat, and look for other players to fight in custom lobbies with friends. Last player standing wins. Gameplay in the jungle supports Xbox controller use for up to 4 players.

row.name: Silent Pathways Playtest
row.detailed_description: PLAYTEST VERSION - MIGHT CHANGE The last traces of your memories slip away into darkness. You can’t remember why you’ve returned, but something is pulling you to the house. Something is watching you. You must uncover the truth before it breaks you. Awaken... Silent Pathways is a first-person psychological horror game that delves into the darkness of a family’s past. You return to your childhood home, a place that should feel familiar, but it’s twisted with disturbing memories. The house is alive with echoes of something that won’t let you forget what happened on that fateful day in 1965. Every corner holds secrets, and every step brings you closer to the truth or your descent into madness. Explore... As Dave, you will search through the decaying remnants of the house, piecing together clues, diary entries, and unsettling flashbacks that reveal a dark history. But the house isn’t just a building, it’s a reflection of the horrors lurking within your mind. With every discovery, the lines between past and present blur, and the deeper you go, the more you question what’s real. Experience... Immerse yourself in a fully realized world, where every creak of the floorboards, every flicker of the lights, and every whisper of the wind is designed to keep you on edge. The house feels alive with cutting-edge graphics and dynamic sound design, with each room more haunting than the last. Your mind is your worst enemy as you confront the terrifying memories that refuse to stay buried.
row.short_description: Drawn back to his home, Dave searches for closure in the decaying remnants of his past. But the house is not as he remembers—shadows linger where they shouldn't, whispers echo through the halls, and buried memories refuse to stay forgotten. Explore the abandoned home and a past that won’t let go.

row.detailed_description: MEET YOUR NEW FRIEND: BUBS!
