row.name: 永夜地铁Eternal Night Metro Playtest
The Door
row.detailed_description: Welcome to The Door, a narrative and psychological game where every choice confronts you with your own thoughts. 'What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?' In The Door, you will have to go through a series of trials where each door represents an inner reflection. Between light and darkness, hope and doubt, you will have to solve puzzles and make decisions to move forward. But will you be ready to face what your mind has in store for you? Gameplay and main mechanics A narrative game based on choices: each door plunges you into a dilemma to solve. Symbolic puzzles: play with lighting and interactions to progress. An immersive atmosphere: an intriguing narration accompanied by a striking sound atmosphere. An introspective journey: explore themes such as solitude, failure and resilience. A short but intense experience: designed to leave a lasting mark.
row.short_description: “What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?” Welcome to The Door, a captivating narrative game where exploration and reflection are at the heart of the experience.

row.name: Dreamland
row.detailed_description: Dreamland Welcome to Dreamland - a mysterious and fascinating world of dreams, where reality intertwines with fantasy, and fear and admiration go hand in hand. In this game, you will go on a fascinating journey through a world inhabited by mythical creatures and creepy characters. Plot We see the world through the eyes of Alexey, an ordinary worker at the logistics company 'Watcher's Cargo.' He has long stopped communicating with his old acquaintances. However, after several unusual incidents, Alexey begins to see symbols. Gathering together, the group decides to uncover the root cause of the events that have occurred to them. The young people travel through several dimensions, solving puzzles and interpersonal conflicts along the way. But will they be able to overcome themselves and untangle this story? Everything depends entirely on the player and their choices. This story is just a brief excursion into a vast and mysterious world of dreams. Will it turn into a nightmare? Characters In Dreamland you will meet many colorful characters, each with their own story and personality. Each of these characters adds uniqueness and depth to the atmosphere of the game. To some, they may seem very familiar. Isn't it? Style Dreamland combines elements of a visual novel and an interactive book, creating a familiar, yet unusual style. Bright colors and bizarre shapes intertwine with dark shadows and ominous silhouettes, creating a contrast that immerses the player in a dream world. The music, filled with mysterious melodies and sounds of nature, enhances the atmosphere and helps you forget about reality. Immerse yourself in the world of Dreamland, where every action you take matters, and every decision can change the course of events. Are you ready to face your fears and uncover the secrets of this eerie and beautiful kingdom?
row.short_description: A group of young people decides to find out why they are seeing mysterious symbols. As they unravel the mystery, they travel through other worlds that are indistinguishable from those seen in dreams. One can only hope that this will not turn into a nightmare for them...
row.notes: The game contains content for adults. During the game you will be able to encounter jokes on adult themes, scenes with the presence of alcohol, jokes on the topic of drugs, skin cuts, blood, obscene language, battle scenes.

row.name: Colossal Crisis
row.detailed_description: Can a lone swordsman stand against giants? A once-thriving island now lies in ruins. Towering giants, led by the tyrannical Master Giant, have brought the land to its knees. In this fast-paced 2D hack-and-slash platformer, you are the island’s last hope, a lone swordsman with nothing but your blade, your will, and the resolve to bring down the colossals who shattered your world. Precision Hack-and-Slash Combat Master a tight and responsive combat system that rewards skill, timing, and strategy. Chain together sword strikes and dodge through deadly attacks in fluid, fast-paced battles. Conquer 7 Action-Packed Levels Battle your way through a journey across diverse environments, from shattered villages and stormy skies to the gates of a ruined castle in the land of the giants, Humungo . Each level brings new enemies, platforming challenges, and a path deeper into the giants' domain. Face the Colossals Two towering titans stand in your way: the brutal Earth Giant, and the ultimate force behind the island’s downfall—the Master Giant. These boss battles are intense, cinematic showdowns where only precise movement and brutal counters will carry you to victory. Save What Remains The war against the giants has already devastated the island. Now, with only fragments of hope left, you must face overwhelming odds, reclaim the land, and put an end to the chaos once and for all.
row.short_description: A fast-paced 2D hack-and-slash platformer where you battle through 7 levels and face off against two towering giants. Master precision combat, overcome deadly enemies, and reclaim a ruined island from the brink of collapse.

row.name: Last Hit Titan
row.detailed_description: An endless battle against powerful Titans! In this massively cooperative tower defense game , terrifying Titans travel from player to player. Every attack you land helps weaken these colossi, and the player who delivers the final blow receives rewards to become even stronger. Build, Upgrade, Survive Start with walls and a basic turret. Place your defenses strategically to maximize damage. Unlock and equip increasingly powerful towers through Titan loot. A Unique Economic Ecosystem Looted towers are Steam items . Buy turrets and walls with the money earned by attacking the Titans. Each 3h you can loot a tower. Each Titan has a special  loot table . The stronger the Titan, the more valuable its rewards. Merge towers and get upper guality tower !  Face Ever-Strong Titans Massive monsters with tons of health points. A pathfinding system that makes them either go around or destroy your defenses. Join the battle and leave your mark on the fall of the Titans!
row.short_description: Strategically place turrets and build defenses to maximize your firepower against colossal Titans! Experiment with different setups, optimize your battlefield, and take down legendary creatures with the most efficient tactics. Every decision counts in this unique tower defense experience!

row.name: Lingua Franca
row.detailed_description: Lingua Franca is a 3D puzzle adventure game where you explore your neighborhood and take pictures to help others. Not out of the goodness of your heart, of course, there’s an alien on the loose! Play as Asa, a young girl with a master plan to capture the alien and prove its existence to those around her. All you have is your camera and your wits, and you’ll need them to convince your neighbors to give you the materials you need to build your trap. By showing them pictures of the world around them, you will save a lost cat, crush a one-sided crush, and help two friends meet once again. With their help, the plan will go off without a hitch! Features: Three vibrant characters with their own stories, struggles, and silliness. A quaint, Japanese-inspired neighborhood to explore. One very confused alien whose only crime is its constant camouflage.
row.short_description: Lingua Franca is a puzzle game all about taking pictures. Help a young girl capture an alien by finding the materials she needs to make her trap, photographing the world to get others to help her, and maybe even helping them along the way.

row.name: Dark Jump: Endless Ascent
row.detailed_description: Leap, Conquer, and Push Your Limits in This High-Stakes Infinite Platformer! Traverse treacherous landscapes, evade relentless enemies, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced infinite jumper. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned platforming expert, this game offers endless action and challenge. Master Unique Characters & Unlock Powerful Abilities Choose from 10 distinct characters , each with their own abilities and playstyle. Uncover a secret character waiting to be discovered and push your high score even further. Adapt your strategy and find the perfect hero to dominate the leaderboards. Conquer Ever-Changing Worlds Explore 5 dynamically designed worlds , each packed with unique obstacles, enemies, and hazards. Every run presents a new challenge, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same. Collect, Upgrade, and Rise to the Top Gather coins as you progress, smash through enemies, and unlock exclusive rewards. Elevate your experience with new characters and abilities to refine your strategy and reach new heights. Features: ✅ 10 Playable Characters – Each with distinct abilities, including a secret unlockable character. ✅ 5 Unique Infinite Levels – Diverse environments, unpredictable hazards, and escalating difficulty. ✅ Challenging Enemies & Obstacles – Test your reflexes with increasingly difficult platforming. ✅ Coin Starter Bonus  – Downloading the game provides a free 450 coins to unlock an extra new character or level of your choice right off the bat. How high can you climb? Prove your skills, set new records, and conquer the ultimate infinite platforming challenge!
row.short_description: In this fast-paced platforming challenge, precision and skill are key. Master 10 unique characters, traverse dynamic worlds, and overcome relentless enemies.

row.name: FP Racer
row.detailed_description: Do you like the turns? Like the high speed maneuvers in Spa or Glen? FP Racer is all about the turns. It's the feeling of control at a God-like level. Immerse yourself in the world of FP Racer! FP Racer is a short solo racing experience. It has 9 levels. There is a leaderboard for each level. It is like a runner with car handling controls. There is no AI or competitive element except for the leaderboard. It has a minimalistic design.
row.short_description: A short solo racing experience in a minimalistic setting.

row.name: Almanach: Of Empires and Sorcery Playtest
Robbery Day
row.detailed_description: The game is a first-person crime action game with three main locations: Bank, Jewelry Store and Meth Lab . The player takes on the role of a criminal, performing robberies, fighting the police and cooking meth to sell. Each location has its own mechanics.
row.short_description: This is a first-person shooter where the player controls one of three characters. Each has two types of weapons, allowing them to adapt to different tactical situations. The gameplay combines dynamic shootings and robberies.
row.notes: Murders, cooking meth.

row.name: Wild Space
row.detailed_description: Wild Space is a turn-based strategy game where dice rolls determine your luck, but it's up to you how you use it . Use your dices wisely and be the quickest ship in space. Choose your path carefully and upgrade your ship along the way. Outwit your opponents and master the dice to claim victory! At the beggining of every new game, you can choose which systems of the ship you want to upgrade! A branching path will lead you to the final boss. Plan your route wisely in order to take the most advantageous path! You can't control the number of the dices, but you can pick and choose what to do with them! Along the galaxy you'll find special places where luck and strategy combine so you can level up your systems and have certain advantages in combat.
row.short_description: Wild Space is a turn-based strategy game where dice rolls determine your luck, but it's up to you how you use it. Use your dices wisely and be the quickest ship in space. Choose your path carefully and upgrade your ship along the way. Outwit your opponents and master the dice to claim victory!

row.name: TCG Multiplayer Card Shop Simulator Playtest
Taskbar Looters
row.detailed_description: Taskbar Looters is a very simple idle game where you recruit animal looters to break open chests right on your desktop. Recruit Looters: All you need to do is spend coins to recruit looters, and they will happily open chests for you automatically! However, no matter how badly they want to, they can't break open chests that are out of reach. Collect Treasures: Gather coins and stars from chests! Use coins to unlock and recruit a variety of looters, and spend stars to upgrade them, making your looters stronger! Looters are Interactive: Each type of looter has its own reaction when clicked. Through interaction, you can help them find nearby chests—or even distract them!
row.short_description: Taskbar Looters is a simple idle game where animal looters collect treasures on your desktop while you focus on other tasks.

row.name: Green Revival
row.detailed_description: You are a young Plant Spirit who is trying to save his ancestral Valley. It is dying from an unknown source of infection, with bugs becoming more dangerous and plants no longer growing. What happened and who will help you fight back? Start the adventure and find out the answers. The path lays from the safe and familiar garden to the farthest corner of the Valley, where the source of the poison is hiding. Our hero will travel through the forest and mountains. And in the caves Spirit will have to face another danger - pitch black darkness. Spirits don’t have bodies, so they are unable to affect the world around them. The only things they can do are moving and observing. But after long years of living in the Valley spirits learned another trick - possessing plants. While hiding inside a plant Spirit can shoot seeds to plant new plants or to protect himself from hungry bugs. Each plant shoots differently, for example, ficus shoots poisonous juice and chestnut throws a heavy seed that strikes down anything in it’s way. Each plant can be useful in a different situation! Hungry bugs and exploding batteries - those are the enemies that Spirit will have to face on his way. Each of them has a weakness against a certain type of plant. Our hero is going on a dangerous journey but he won’t have to be on his own, Old Spirit, his teacher, will help and support him the entire time. From the safety of the garden, of course. Also during his adventure Spirit will meet new unexpected friends, some of which will join and travel with him. To save endangered plants Spirit will have to collect new seeds while travelling. And, of course, learn how to use the new plants. Old Spirit gathered all the information about Valley’s plant life in a handbook which Spirit will be able to read at any time. The source of the poison, giant battery monster, won’t be an easy target. To save the Valley Spirit will have to figure out a strategy and use the most effective plants. And his friends will help him!
row.short_description: The Valley is in trouble! It's infected by thrown out batteries. Plants are endangered by poisoned soil and hungry bugs munching on every leaf or branch they can find. Only young Plant Spirit can find the source of the harm. Fight bugs, collect and plant new seeds and seek allies to save the Valley!

row.name: The Gallery
row.detailed_description: The Gallery , a mysterious first-person puzzle adventure where every painting hides a secret. Navigate two eerie galleries, each containing eight rooms filled with mind-bending puzzles, cryptic clues, and interactive artwork. To progress, you must decipher riddles, manipulate paintings, and uncover hidden patterns to unlock the next door. With no time limits, an immersive ambient soundtrack, and a unique collectible system, The Gallery offers a relaxed yet thought-provoking experience. Observe, experiment, and solve—can you uncover the gallery’s ultimate mystery? Key Features: 🖼️ Painting-Based Puzzles – Change, rearrange, and decode artwork to solve intricate riddles. 🔎 Interactive Environment – Pull levers, rotate paintings, and manipulate objects to unlock secrets. 🎵 Atmospheric Soundtrack – A haunting yet relaxing ambiance enhances the experience. 📜 Collectibles & Hidden Clues – Find and display artifacts that reveal more about the gallery. 🚶 Explore at Your Own Pace – No timers, just a deep dive into the world of art and mystery. Wishlist now and prepare to unlock the secrets of The Gallery !
row.short_description: The Gallery is a first-person puzzle game where every painting holds a secret. Explore a mysterious art museum, solve observation-based riddles, and unlock new rooms by deciphering clues hidden within the artwork. Will you uncover the truth behind the gallery?

row.name: Bait & Tackle
row.detailed_description: Get Hooked on this Fishing Adventure… Where The Fish Fight Back! Step into the boots of a legendary fisherman returning from a shameful retirement. Travel the coastline chasing after exotic fish and regaining your forgotten skills. But beware – deadly catches are lurking everywhere… Take down a variety of comical bosses in fast-paced, high-intensity fights! Cast your fishing line like a grappling hook to sling yourself around stages, while also using your rod to smack sea monsters into submission! The One That Got Away… Long ago, The Big One got away and forced you into an early retirement. But now, you finally have the chance to redeem your reputation following recent sightings of the mythical monster! Follow the trail of rumors while taking down other terrible creatures that have been terrorizing the coast, including Mini Minnow , Big Bass , Crude Crab , and Swordmaster Swordfish .  No Laughing Matter. Don’t let their wacky appearance fool you: each boss fight will push you to your limits and provide fresh challenges that force you to make the most of the fishing rod you wield. You’ll learn to master various movement techniques and boss patterns while constantly switching up strategies and adapting on the fly! As you improve, chase high scores as you replay past fights and challenge yourself with Super-Boss versions of fights! A suite of accessibility options ensures that you can play by your own rules and rise to any challenge. Gotta Fish ‘Em All! Chase after dozens and dozens of unique fish (and secret easter eggs) in each location! With unique rarities and difficulties, filling up your Fishdex is no easy task…  Download for Free Today! Filled with hand-crafted pixel art, gut-busting jokes, and nail-biting challenges, the world of Bait & Tackle awaits… Grab your fishing rod, cast your line, and chase after The One that Got Away !
row.short_description: Catch exotic fish and fight comical sea-monsters as you chase after The One That Got Away in this fishing-centric boss rush!

row.name: 봄을 부르는 설녀 - 유나
row.detailed_description: '봄을 부르는 설녀 - 유나' is a visual novel with no choices. Although it is a spin-off of '봄을 부르는 설녀' the story progresses from a completely different perspective, so even those who have not played the main story can play without any problems. This game does not support English.
row.short_description: I received a love confession from a doctor I met in a peaceful countryside village I came down to find peace in.

row.name: QuestionBank
row.detailed_description: 'QuestionBank' is a trivia game where you get one free quiz attempt every day. Each time you answer a question correctly, you consume one attempt and earn a unique 'Cat Coin.' Answering 30 questions correctly in a row will unlock the legendary 'Golden Scroll,' but there are only 1 million attempts available in total. By continuously answering questions, you not only test your knowledge and challenge your limits, but also compete with players worldwide! With every correct answer, you're one step closer to claiming the title of Quiz Champion! The 1 million+ question database covers everything from simple arithmetic to the creator's wildest ideas. With daily non-intelligent recommendations, it adapts to a brainpower marathon for players of all ages!
row.short_description: Challenge the limits of your knowledge! This is an exciting trivia competition game with millions of questions waiting for you to conquer. Come join the challenge—who will become the ultimate King of Knowledge?

row.name: End Chess Arrow
row.detailed_description: This time it's Chinese chess, but you have to play alone against the enemy. You can act every turn and have the long-range shooting ability of a crossbow; the enemy's army is closing in, and they will act whenever their patience runs out. On your turn, you can choose to move or shoot. Your crossbow has an extremely long range, but it is only precise in a flat shot within effective range. At long distances, the shot will randomly land somewhere within the expected area. Skillfully control the distance between you and the enemy to avoid being checkmated, and decisively shoot arrows to weaken the enemy’s ability to act, perhaps finding a slim chance of survival in the deadly battle. After each level, the shop will randomly offer various options for both character and enemy buffs. You can spend gold to strengthen yourself or take a risk by choosing to give buffs to the enemy, earning extra money to further enhance your own abilities. Balance the risks and rewards, and make careful decisions as you face increasingly complex challenges. In this unpredictable battlefield, who knows whether you can defy fate and perhaps truly end some of the boring chess games. Each game typically takes around 15 minutes to complete. The core gameplay is mostly complete, but we are still working on gameplay refinement, balance adjustments, and performance optimization . Your feedback is invaluable in helping us further polish the game and enhance the final experience.
row.short_description: It seems like Chinese Chess, but perhaps you can hold the entire game with just a crossbow. A strategy-based turn-based roguelike game.

row.name: Roses Shoot Red, Violets Shoot Blue Playtest
Pioneers of the Coast
row.detailed_description: 1-4 PLAYERS: In this top-down, turn-based resource strategy game, you and fellow pioneers set out to start your own towns in a newly discovered region. Be the first to dominate the land and lay claim to the entire area. HOW TO WIN: FEATURES:
row.short_description: In this top-down, turn-based resource strategy game, you and fellow pioneers set out to start your own towns in a newly discovered region. Be the first to dominate the land and lay claim to the entire area.

row.name: Railway Chai Wala
row.detailed_description: Step into the chaotic yet captivating life of a Railway Chai Wala at the Fakripur railway station, where the rhythm of trains is matched only by the hustle of hungry passengers. Ramu, a hardworking chaiwala running his shop at the Fakripur railway station. From brewing chai to frying samosas, serving guests, and selling cola, your daily tasks are as lively as the trains rushing past. But beneath the vibrant surface of sizzling samosas and steaming chai lies a web of secrets waiting to be unraveled. Key Features: Chai Brewing: Show your skills in brewing the perfect cup of chai and coffee, delighting passengers with authentic Indian flavors. Indian Snacks Galore: Serve crispy samosas, prepare mouthwatering vada pav, and offer chilled Kokila Kola to satisfy a variety of cravings for hungry travelers. Engage with Passengers: Meet a colorful cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and sometimes with eerie behavior. Railway Platform Realism: Experience the sights, sounds, and chaos of a bustling Indian railway station, complete with dynamic crowds and lifelike audio. Eerie Mysteries Unfold: Encounter strange events and uncover the hidden, spine-chilling secrets lurking in the station’s shadows. Authentic Indian Vibes: Immerse yourself in the cultural essence of India with vibrant visuals, detailed environments, and an atmospheric soundtrack that brings Fakripur to life. Whether it’s brewing chai or unraveling mysteries, Railway Chai Wala is a game that blends the warmth of Indian hospitality with the thrill of suspense. Can you thrive as Fakripur’s favorite chaiwala while braving the station’s enigmatic secrets? The answers await in this one-of-a-kind adventure!
row.short_description: Step into the world of Ramu, a spirited railway chaiwala at the bustling Fakripur station. Life isn’t just about brewing chai—it’s steeped in mystery! Uncover dark, masala-filled secrets in this Psychological Thriller Game with a blend of suspense and Indian flavor!

row.name: Art House
row.detailed_description: In Art House, step into the life of Lisa, mother to Ollie and Zoe, who's struggling to pick up the pieces of her life after the passing of her mother, Betty. After returning to Betty's mountain home, Lisa and her kids get trapped inside of Betty's paintings where her memories come to life. Guide Lisa through hauntingly beautiful paintings while solving puzzles and confronting the shadows of the family’s past. Navigate a journey through grief and towards healing that lingers after the final brushstroke. Features : Hand-drawn 2D environments inspired by Impressionism and Post-Impressionism Environmental puzzles combining platforming, object manipulation, and strategic enemy avoidance Dynamic layer-switching through painting rips to navigate foreground and background Magical paintbrush mechanics to restore broken objects, move platforms, and repaint the world Multiple enemy types with unique behaviors, including patrolling, lurking, and rip-chasing A fully voice-acted, narrative-driven experience told through memories and evolving paintings
row.short_description: Art House is a 2D puzzle platformer in which you play as a woman who gets trapped with her children inside the paintings of her recently deceased mother. Navigate through painting rips and use a magical paintbrush to escape and come to terms with your grief.
row.notes: Art House contains narrative themes involving death, memory loss, and the emotional impact of grief. Sensitive players should be aware that the game deals with cognitive deterioration and loss, though all story moments are presented thoughtfully and can be skipped.

row.name: Chaos Classroom
row.detailed_description: Chaos Classroom is a fast-paced action roguelite and bullet heaven adventure that takes place in the imagination of a group of students. Players will navigate through reimagined school settings—gymnasiums into castles, math class into a witch's paradise, and science class into a lab for variety of slimy experiments. All of these teeming with a variety of make-believe monsters. Team up with a dynamic cast of students, each bringing their unique abilities, personalities, and playstyles into the fray. Swap seamlessly between characters to strategize, exploit enemy weaknesses, or adapt to the challenges the imaginative school world throws your way. Survive escalating waves of whimsical foes and collect powerful upgrades as you strive to make it through the chaotic week. Will you master the creativity-fueled chaos and emerge victorious, or will the classroom get the better of you and end up in detention? Jump into the action and let your imagination run wild!
row.short_description: Chaos Classroom is an action-roguelite, bullet-heaven where the player selects a team to fight hordes of make-believe enemies in an imaginative dream version of the school, with the option of swapping between different students as they try to make it to the end of each week.

row.name: Wild boar survival
row.detailed_description: About This Game Survive for a long time against endless waves of wild boars with the lonely protagonist. Then, set your best score and brag to your friends. When the game starts, a boar will spawn at each respawn location. All wild boars rush towards the protagonist. If you defeat a boar, you get 1 point. The game ends when the main character's HP becomes 0. Play time Takes 40 minutes based on a score of 100 Controls The character moves using W, S, A, and D, J for attack, and K for dash.
row.short_description: Survive for a long time against endless waves of wild boars with the lonely protagonist. Then, set your best score and brag to your friends.

row.name: ファイヤーエムブレイスII～中年と希望の光～
row.detailed_description: This game is a single player, the 1990s style RPG game. The volume and screen size can be controlled in the title screen. The pixel art and retro BGM makes you nostalgic. The demon king is so strong that your strategy will be needed. Playing time: 4 hours ～ 12 hours Ending: The game has 1 ending. Story: It's fiction about parallel universe of Japan You can get some hints to clear this game by many NPC on the way to adventure. Finally your goal is to reach a map where has the demon castle. Explore lots of maps and progress the story, and then defeat the demon king.
row.short_description: ファイヤーエムブレイスII～中年と希望の光～ is a single player, the 1990s style game. The pixel art and retro BGM makes you nostalgic. Finally your goal is to reach a map where has the demon castle. Explore lots of maps and progress the story, and then defeat the demon king.

row.name: Napolitan Hotel
row.detailed_description: Welcome. It’s your first night shift as a staff member at the Napolitan Hotel. Your tasks at the hotel are very simple. Your main duty is to complete the safety checklist placed on each floor. If you notice any suspicious objects or items in the hallway, call the front desk to receive appropriate instructions. However, there may be situations that the front desk cannot resolve. For example: The elevator you’re in suddenly moves to a floor you didn’t select. The power system unexpectedly shuts down, turning off the hallway lights. A strange sound gets closer and closer to you... To prepare for such situations, make sure to familiarize yourself with the Staff-Only Safety Guidelines passed down by senior employee Steve. Use all your senses to make it through the night shift safely. If you do your job well, you may become the full-time hotel staff member you’ve always wanted to be. Good luck.
row.short_description: A thrilling horror game where strange phenomena and mysterious entities disrupt your night shift. Can you finish your work and become a full-time employee?

row.name: WallSmashers
row.detailed_description: an action physics-destruction-based infinite runner where you smash into walls at high speeds in order to accumulated multipliers and points. THIS IS NOT A RACING GAME! See how you stack against other players with our leaderboards (on mobile only for now)
row.short_description: an action physics-destruction-based infinite runner where you smash into walls at high speeds in order to accumulated multipliers and points. THIS IS NOT A RACING GAME! See how you stack against other players with our leaderboards (on mobile only for now)

row.name: Wildcat Snack Attack
row.detailed_description: Wildcat Snack Attack is a new survival game where you have to protect your snacks against Wildcats!  Waves of cats will pursue you, so get ready to run, dodge, and throw. Do you have what it takes to keep your snacks safe? Or will you have to spend all your precious bean bucks? Play now, fill up your water balloons, and survive!
row.short_description: An action survival game where you have to defend your snacks from wildcats. Hit them with water balloons to turn them away and save your snack stash, or turn to vending machines if you find yourself running low.

row.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Words of Vengeance
row.detailed_description: The Mechanicum of Mars have gifted you a blessed new weapon - a keyboard! Brutally decimate hordes of daemonic scum with every keystroke, in this fast-paced rail shooter. None can stand against the might of your WPM!  RETURN TO GRAIA   Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Words of Vengeance is a creative twist on epic boomer shooter Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Instead of mowing down your enemies with elite FPS skills, kill the relentless hordes of enemies that descend upon you by typing out words.  Set in the world of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, play as Malum Caedo on his mission to cleanse Forge World Graia of cultists, traitors and Chaos daemons that threaten to overrun it.    THE EMPEROR GUIDES YOUR HAND Put your typing skills to the test by typing out randomised words and phrases from Warhammer 40,000 lore to end the lives of your foes. Time to brush up on the spelling of Manufactorum, Incommodus, and Astronomican!   Obliterate your enemies by quickly typing their death sentences but beware as one typo could spell your own demise.   FEATURES  Creative reimagining of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun as a first-person typing game.   Randomised words and phrases from Warhammer 40,000 lore to make every playthrough unique  The faster you type, the quicker you kill.   Difficult to master with 4 difficulties for every level
row.short_description: Type like your life depends on it in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance! Smite the enemies of the Emperor with every keystroke spelling their demise. But every typo could mean the difference between life and death.
row.notes: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Words of Vengeance contains scenes involving violence, blood and gore.

row.name: HardDriverz
row.detailed_description: HardDriverz is an arcade racing game where players can customize their karts to compete through fun, twisty, futuristic tracks that defy gravity. Pick different cool, unique power-ups that will help you get ahead of other racers as you compete to be the fastest racer. Race through six tracks that showcase three terrain themes as you compete against AI racers! Each track is set in one of three different terrains digitally recreated within a packed stadium, filled with eager spectators ready to see who will win the race. Start your race through the iridescent roads of “Disc Drive” as you boost through to victory. Twist and turn through the hilly dunes of a sandy “Android Arena” wasteland. Fly through the neon-lit cyberscape of “Circuit City” as you see a vibrant city inside of a computer. Customize your kart to look and play the way you want to! Choose how you want to play by customizing how your kart looks. Change your kart’s wheels, spoiler, and engine to adjust your acceleration, handling, and weight abilities. You can even choose what colors to make your kart and driver. There are over a hundred possible kart combinations, so discover your unique race champion. Powerful pickup items will give you the edge over your competitors! Utilize six different pickup items that can give a variety of fun abilities that can help you further your advantage or catch up to the competition. From shields to speed boosts and a tractor beam that’ll drag you to an opponent up ahead, these powerful pickups will be key to your victory. Made by the students at SMU Guildhall HardDriverz was made by the students of Cohort 34 at SMU Guildhall as part of their Team Game Project II course over the course of a 12-week development cycle.  Click the 'Visit the Website' link in the list to the right of this description for more information.  Thank you for supporting this team, and please help spread the word if you enjoyed it.
row.short_description: Burn rubber across futuristic cityscapes on twisting gravity defying tracks with customizable karts in this competitive arcade racer!

row.name: Dinos TD
row.detailed_description: Get ready for a tower defense game 65 million years in the making! Assemble a herd of unique dinosaurs to defend against an onslaught of invading insects.  Control the Terrain! Dinos TD flips the tower defense genre on its head! You control the battlefield! Draw the paths your enemies walk on. Place Biome tiles to give your Dinos boons! Dinosaurs! Dinosaurs! Dinosaurs! Discover a wide range of Dinosaurs each offering a new way to strategize and synergize with the environment and other dinos. Level up each Dino to unlock flashy new abilities.  Avoid Extinction! Play around destructive world events like the meteor! Become the master of dinosaurs in Dinos TD!
row.short_description: Prepare for prehistoric pandemonium as you command a dinosaur herd against an insect invasion! Control the battlefield by drawing paths, setting traps, and charting biomes. Discover a diverse cast of dinosaurs with a range of unique abilities. Get ready for a primordial tower-defense adventure!

row.name: The Path of Blades
row.detailed_description: The Path of Blades A brutal, arcade-style dungeon crawler with modernized combat, Souls-like intensity, and retro-inspired visuals. Enter the Dungeon. Survive the Unknown. You’ve been thrown into a treacherous labyrinth where survival is instinct, and every decision is the difference between life and death. Navigate dark corridors, dodge deadly traps, and engage in visceral melee combat as you carve your way through this ever-hostile dungeon. Classic Dungeon Crawling Reimagined First-Person & Third-Person Combat Dynamic Combat System Wield an arsenal of melee weapons, dodge with i-frames, and use skillful timing to survive. Arcade Souls-Like Gameplay Destructible Barrels & Loot – Smash your way through the secondary environment to uncover hidden rewards. Unforgiving Traps & Ambushes. Pixelated Modern Aesthetic – A fusion of Doom-inspired retro pixelation with modern lighting and physics for a fresh but nostalgic experience.
row.short_description: A brutal, arcade-style dungeon crawler with modernized combat, Souls-like intensity, and retro-inspired visuals.Classic Dungeon Crawling Reimagined Arcade Souls-Like Gameplay
row.notes: The Mature Contents is mostly Gore & Violence.

row.name: Viet Quoc Truyen Ky
row.detailed_description: Viet Quoc Truyen Ky is a classic-style MMORPG featuring familiar elements such as monster hunting, level grinding, item collection, and free item trading between players. The game's setting is primarily inspired by Vietnam's late feudal period, a time when secret societies and captivating legends were prevalent. However, the game is not confined to a specific era but instead blends multiple historical periods with unique Vietnamese mythology and folklore. Gameplay Details Leveling Up Like classic RPGs, you will hunt monsters to level up. Each time you level up, you become stronger through potential points, can equip better gear, and learn new skills. Items and Equipment Items in the game are primarily obtained by looting monsters, and the stats of equipment when dropped are random. The drop rate is higher when you hunt monsters with a similar level. Factions At level 10, you can join one of 6 factions, each with its own unique skill system and characteristics. Monsters The game features many types of monsters spread across different areas. Monsters in higher-level regions are stronger and drop better loot. Each area also has a major boss that requires team coordination to defeat, but the rewards are more attractive. Maps The game world includes 3 safe towns and many areas to level up. Each map has its own distinctive landscape. In addition to the main maps, there are also hidden and fantasy maps related to folklore stories. Freedom Like The Old Days The game features a classic and free playstyle, not confined to quests and daily activities. You can explore based on your personal preferences or venture with friends and guilds to level up and hunt bosses.
row.short_description: Viet Quoc Truyen Ky is an online role-playing game (MMORPG) with a strong classic, retro style, featuring familiar elements such as monster hunting, level grinding, item looting, and free item trading between players. The game is deeply intertwined with captivating legends and rich folklore.

row.name: StoneStory
row.detailed_description: Game Introduction Stone Story 'is a newly created MMORPG online PC game that is set against the backdrop of primitive tribal civilization. It integrates pet cultivation, strategic combat, and social exploration gameplay, and presents players with high-definition Q-version graphics to provide a novel and interesting adventure experience in the primitive world.   Game Background Stone Story: Q Cute Primitives Fight Mechanical Tyrannosaurus Rex! The cross temporal adventure has officially begun. When primitive humans collide with future black technology - the counterattack of primitive humans! The out of control masterpiece of Doctor Dinosaur in the future world, the mechanical tyrannosaurus, descended onto the primitive continent through a space-time black hole! In order to prevent this steaming steel behemoth from destroying the world, a group of silly primitive people launch a counterattack of 'animal training+technology'! Gameplay Free domestication of hundreds of cute pets. Contains hundreds of unique pets, including classic primitive species such as Tyrannosaurus rex and Thunder Dragon, supporting capture, skill matching, and creating exclusive combat partners.     Pet evolution. The ultimate goal of pet cultivation is that different pets contain different potentials and evolve into more dazzling, cool, and powerful forms. We look forward to primitive people coming to tame them.   Strategic turn based combat. Adopting a turn based gameplay of character and pet collaboration, combined with attribute restraint, formation strategy, and skill combination, it tests the player's tactical layout ability.   Open world exploration. Seamless map design allows players to freely collect resources, challenge dungeon bosses, or participate in casual gameplay such as treasure hunting.
row.short_description: Stone Story 'is a newly created MMORPG online PC game, set against the backdrop of primitive tribal civilization, integrating pet cultivation, strategic combat, and social exploration gameplay, providing players with a novel and interesting primitive world adventure experience.

Hermes' Runner
row.detailed_description: The Gods are impatient. Don’t keep them waiting. Hermes Runner is a fast-paced parkour game set to the backdrop of an alternate universe Greek city defined by its hyper-capitalist Pantheon. Traverse the city as quickly as possible to please your celestial boss, and tag things along the way to be stylish while doing it. Speed-based movement system - Master a momentum based movement system to navigate the city. Deliveries to colorful characters - Engage with colorful, voice-acted characters that give a glimpse into the alternate reality setting. Spray painting, sticker tagging, paint bombs - Leave your mark on the city with unique tags. Hermes' Runner is produced by Hermes Devs LLC, a member owned indie studio brought to you by senior students at Utah Games. We hope you enjoy early access, and we hope you keep up with our upcoming final touches!
row.short_description: Hermes Runner is a 3D movement-based open level parkour punk game. Freerun using Hermes’ boots, deface billboards, and make deliveries in a reimagined 2000s Greek city where the Gods are real, and they own everything.

row.name: Whispers of the Architects
row.detailed_description: Demo Content In this demo, you’ll get a hands-on experience with the game’s core mechanics, including the modular design of your units and their programmable functionality. The demo showcases the initial levels, featuring two maps and providing enough points to experiment with approximately ten modules and tactics. Gameplay Echoes of the Architects is a real-time strategy game that rewards creativity, strategic depth, and adaptability. Victory lies in your ability to design and deploy customizable, programmable units to dominate the battlefield. At its heart is a robust unit customization system, letting you build armies tailored to your playstyle. Combine modules like locomotion systems, weapons, and repair tools, and define your units’ roles—whether gathering resources, defending key points, or executing precision strikes to outflank enemies. Battles are fast-paced and dynamic, demanding sharp strategic thinking and quick adaptation. With programmable units capable of executing complex maneuvers autonomously, you can focus on your tactics rather than high actions-per-minute gameplay. As you advance, unlock new modules, unit classes, and tactical options, continuously evolving your forces. Explore diverse planets, each with unique environments and challenges, as you expand the fight across the galaxy. In Echoes of the Architects, every decision matters. Success depends on how you configure your army, time your deployments, and outmaneuver your opponents in the relentless chaos of war. Key Features Design with Precision : Craft modular, programmable units, each tailored to play a specific role in your customizable army. Shape your strategy, one unit at a time. Adapt Strategically : Analyze your opponent's strengths and weaknesses to deploy the perfect combination of units for any challenge. Flexibility is your greatest weapon. Deploy Tactically : Master the art of timing and positioning in dynamic skirmishes. Outsmart your enemies with clever builds and adaptable tactics. Dominate the Battlefield : Unlock powerful modules and advanced tactics to upgrade your army, overcoming tougher foes and securing victory through superior innovation. Asynchronous Multiplayer : Enjoy stress-free gameplay with pausable battles and unlimited, always-on replayability Story The galaxy was ours to conquer—or so we believed. In our unyielding quest for dominance, humanity delved too deeply into the void, awakening a force beyond comprehension: the Architects. Silent, enigmatic, and devastatingly efficient, they seized our greatest creations—turning humanity’s own advanced technologies into instruments of annihilation. Entire worlds fell in mere moments, their skies darkened by the machines we once called progress. Now, you stand as one of the last sparks of resistance, seeking shelter on a scarred and broken Earth—a planet consumed by the wars and greed of its past. With only the remnants of human ingenuity at your disposal, you command the battlefield from a distance, deploying what’s left of our scattered forces. Every battle is a desperate gamble, a flicker of hope against the Architects’ impenetrable grip. But there’s something more—whispers buried deep in the ruins of our shattered worlds. Clues that hint at the true nature of the Architects, their purpose, and why they were waiting for us to awaken them. Understanding them might be the key to victory—or a revelation too dangerous to confront. This is our last chance to reclaim the galaxy, dismantle the Architects’ empire, and unearth the secrets of their origin. The final war begins, and humanity’s fate rests in your hands.
row.short_description: Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game where creativity drives victory. Design modular, programmable units to build your perfect army. Adapt and outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes that reward tactical precision, ingenuity, and strategic mastery.

row.name: Office Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Office Simulator: Prologue is a limited-content version designed to let you experience office management right away. Manage your employees, plan tasks, and navigate the challenges of office life! For a more complete experience, don't forget to add the full version to your wishlist! CAREER JOURNEY Begin your career as an intern. Complete various office tasks such as organizing files, scheduling meetings, delivering documents, and responding to emails to gain experience, improve your performance, and get promoted to higher positions. OFFICE UPGRADES Purchase new office items to increase productivity and capacity, gaining advantages that enhance your employees' performance. RESPECT THE EMPLOYEES Everyone in the office needs a coffee! You can either politely serve coffee to your employees or energize them early in the morning with coffee. The choice is yours! But remember, happy employees are more productive. ASSISTANT MANAGEMENT As you advance in your career, you can hire an assistant and delegate some of your responsibilities. This allows you to take on more tasks and accelerate your career growth. COMPANY CREATION AND EXPANSION Establish your own company and design your office as you like. Hire new employees, expand your business, and secure a strong position in the corporate world. BID AND PROJECT MANAGEMENT Take on projects by bidding in the market and assign tasks to your employees. The more contracts you win and successfully complete, the faster your company will grow, advancing toward industry leadership. CHARACTER NEEDS Manage your own needs by drinking coffee to boost energy and taking timely restroom breaks to stay productive and efficient throughout the workday.
row.short_description: Office Simulator: Prologue is a limited-content version designed to let you experience office management right away. Manage your employees, plan tasks, and navigate the challenges of office life!

row.name: Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: In our free version, you can play up to shop level 10, unlock a set of sushi, access one shop area, and expand your sushi shop’s conveyor belt. This gives you a taste of the core gameplay experience and a glimpse of what’s waiting for you in the full version! 'Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator' is a cozy first-person simulation where you serve sushi to customers, earn money, and grow your sushi restaurant business. PROLOGUE FEATURES: Make sushi and place it on the conveyor belt, allowing customers to pick their favorite sushi. Order stock from the supplier using your tablet. Seafood prices vary daily based on the day's supply. Scan the sushi plates to calculate the bill. Make sure you don’t miss any plates, or you’ll receive less money! Clean the table for the next customer and deal with troublesome customers before they cause any trouble.
row.short_description: Run your own conveyor belt sushi restaurant. Make sushi, serve customers, process payments, clean tables, hire staff, and design your restaurant’s conveyor belt. Set your own prices, manage troublesome customers, and expand your sushi restaurant.

row.name: PropWiz

GOLDEN GUN Use the special weapon to score big and turn the tides. UNIQUE MAPS Five different maps with distinct playstyles and vibes.
row.short_description: Hide, seek, and outsmart your opponents in PropWiz — a fast-paced multiplayer party-game. Use clever movement, quick thinking, and special abilities to claim your victory.

row.name: I Got Hired To Guard The Button That Destroys The Earth
row.detailed_description: You just got hired to guard the button that destroys the Earth. So you better take your task seriously. This is your job now. Just whatever you do, you are not supposed to press the button, otherwise the world goes poof. You have no idea how many things can distract you while doing this task. Oh and did I mention there are literally no breaks? So if you decide to quit, that also destroys the Earth. Just guard the button. For the sake of the World. Features: 7 different events to react to Seeing the timer go up Collect Steam Achievements Compete with other guards through an Online Leaderboard This game will test your patience, how long can you guard the button?
row.short_description: An indie waiting game that is going to test your patience and focus. Become the most successful button guardian on Steam with Steam Leaderboard

row.name: Vampire Master
row.detailed_description: Vampire Masters an immersive, strategy-driven RPG that invites players to step into the dark, thrilling world of vampire supremacy. As a Vampire Master, you will command an army of undead, conquer powerful realms, and build an empire under the cover of night. Gameplay: Four Paths, One Destiny Choose Your Power Tame Beasts of the Night Ride in Style Dark Elegance Endless Customization Vows Under the Moon Power in Unity Fight for Power Rise as the True Master
row.short_description: Vampire Masters an immersive, strategy-driven RPG that invites players to step into the dark, thrilling world of vampire supremacy. As a Vampire Master, you will command an army of undead, conquer powerful realms, and build an empire under the cover of night.

row.name: 浮空秘境
row.detailed_description: 一秒踏入秘境，你便置身一个有关剑与魔法的像素世界。 记忆复苏意味着封印的松动，浮空大陆的沉浮命运再次交到了你的手中。面对即将来临的风雨，身处风暴中心的你将做出怎样的抉择…… 【游戏玩法】 作为一款标准的放置类卡牌游戏，《浮空秘境》主打“轻松养肝+超高福利+差异化内容”。抽卡获得角色、挂机获得资源收益、通过副本刷装备和更多资源，再对角色进行升级、进阶、升星等趣味养成，从而轻松提升战力，一路高歌猛进，推掉层层关卡，这就是游戏的主要玩法内容。 游戏战斗采用半回合半即时的行动条机制，战斗过程则全权交给系统托管自动进行。无需研究技能施放的门道，降低新手的门槛，而同时策略性并没有减少，各种有趣玩法的加持也让老玩家持续保持游戏激情。 【游戏特色】 ◆复古像素，精美立绘 游戏整体采用了复古像素风，在当今放置类游戏中别具一格，体验酣畅淋漓的战斗，一秒梦回童年！在大部分像素画面之外，每个角色均有二次元画风的精致立绘。在剧情对话中，立绘会以Live2D的形式呈现出，精美画面与像素画风相结合，更显视觉冲击力与吸引力。 ◆丰富玩法，能佛能肝 融合传统放置玩法，战斗、收集、养成！内置挂机经验收集，即使下线也可以持续为您收集经验材料与装备。而追求深度体验的玩家，也可以在遗忘之河、永恒王座、无尽之海等各种丰富玩法的系统和趣味小游戏中找到不断更迭的乐趣！总之，各类玩法一应俱全，轻松畅玩不逼氪，随心快乐自由行~ ◆热血角斗，巅峰竞技 Boss战、跨服战、各种竞技副本与荣誉榜单，在这里，你可以组建属于自己的公会，结识来自五湖四海的朋友，在埃蒙大陆留下你们的足迹！ ◆超高福利，零氪福音 升级即送vip，五星英雄登陆送，零氪也能拥有豪华阵容。开局一时爽，一直挂机一直爽！高爆率，高福利，每周兑换码羊毛薅不停，邀请好友的逆天奖励更可让你直接躺平。 ◆深度剧情，顶级声优 顶级声优团队倾情配音，完美呈现游戏人物个性与弘大剧情。300000字主线剧情书写浮空大陆的兴衰沉浮，更拥有同名连载小说，从第三者的视角，见证“你”从无名之辈到盖世英雄的传奇！超强的代入感，让你无论线上线下都能爽翻天！
row.short_description: 《浮空秘境》是一款经典日式RPG像素风休闲放置游戏。传说中光之女神缔造了神圣的埃蒙大陆，然而这里的魔法文明正悄然被恶念侵蚀，蛰伏千年的魔王即将复苏。纷乱的时空下，一个光怪陆离的梦开启了你尘封的记忆，你开始回想起遥远时光里的一切：在那片被战火倾轧的千疮百孔的大陆上，一直有一个坚毅背影引领人们走向光明，而那个背影就是身为执行者的“你”！ 记忆复苏意味着封印的松动，浮空大陆的沉浮命运再次交到了你的手中。面对即将来临的风雨，身处风暴中心的你将做出怎样的抉择……

row.name: Deskie
row.detailed_description: Deskie: Your AI Desktop Companion 🏠 Bring companionship onto your desktop Deskie isn’t just a chat window trapped in the corner, nor a cold, isolated app. It’s a little companion that feels alive — living right on your desktop, breathing, thinking, reacting warmly, and understanding what companionship really means. You can poke it anytime, chat with it through text or voice, ask it for a story, vent your feelings, or let it quietly keep you company. It understands multiple languages and replies with a vivid original voice. Its facial expressions, movements, and even lip sync match its speech—just like a real friend talking to you in person. Even better, characters have long-term memory. As you spend more time together, it gradually remembers your preferences and past conversations. Your interactions never “reset”—it just understands you more and more, making every moment feel warm and naturally connected. 🚀 A vibrant and expressive character library Our character library is not just a lineup of cardboard cutouts—it’s a whole crew of lively little gremlins brought to life with high-fidelity Live2D magic! They can act cute, interact freely on your desktop, and even look adorable while spacing out. It’s like pulling your favorite anime buddies straight into your monitor! Each character comes with its own quirks and backstory waiting for you to discover. And the best part? Our team and talented community creators are constantly “adopting” new cuties, making sure your desktop always feels like a never-ending fun-filled party! ✨ Customize your own special character Want a desktop buddy that’s truly one of a kind? The door to creative customization is always wide open! From dialogue style to voice tone, from personality settings to story prompts—you control every detail. You can use tons of available models, or drag your own Live2D/3D OC straight onto your desktop. Plus, there’s a huge voice library ready to melt your ears. And when you’ve created the ultimate masterpiece, you can share it with the whole community for tons of praise—or keep it private just for yourself and close friends. 🧡 Enjoy free daily credits To let more people experience the vision of Deskie early: 🎁 Receive free usage credits every day during public testing 🎁 AI chat and voice interaction available daily for free 🎁 Character downloads, creation, editing, and publishing — all free
row.short_description: Transform your desktop into a warm home with Deskie, your interactive AI companion. This lively desktop pet breathes, speaks, and keeps you company while you use your PC. Whether you are grinding games or just spacing out, she remembers your chats and offers a comforting presence.

row.name: Novice in the world
row.detailed_description: This game includes RPG content such as exploration, self building teams, battles, and growth, as well as multiplayer gameplay such as interacting with other players, forming guilds, and competing in battles. Players can cultivate their own characters, and their teams can freely explore the world map. They can explore different caves, sects, and strongholds, learn different martial arts, and recruit different characters. [Feature] -Open worldview and plot setting, free martial arts activities. -Leisure gameplay mode, idle growth fun. -Ultra high character engagement, recruiting and sparring with all NPCs. -Multi directional partner pairing, high freedom cultivation and growth. -Numerous anticipated follow-up features have been released.
row.short_description: This game includes RPG content such as exploration, self building teams, battles, and growth, as well as multiplayer gameplay such as interacting with other players, forming guilds, and competing in battles.

row.name: Dusty
row.detailed_description: Dusty is an intense multiplayer shooter where strategy, teamwork, and skill come together for thrilling combat. Players are divided into two fierce teams, Phantom and Blaze , battling it out across a variety of game modes: Capture the Flag , Team Deathmatch , and Free for All(More gamemodes will be added) . In Capture the Flag , players work together to outmaneuver and outsmart the enemy team to secure the flag and score points. Team Deathmatch challenges each team to dominate the battlefield, trying to get more kills than enemy. For those who prefer the chaos of solo combat, Free for All throws players into an all-out battle, where it's every player for themselves. Whether you're a tactician coordinating with teammates or a lone wolf aiming to be the last one standing, Dusty offers fast-paced action, intense firefights, and a variety of strategies to keep you on the edge of your seat. Join the fight, choose your team, and prove your dominance in the ultimate arena!
row.short_description: Dusty is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter where strategy and skill determine victory. Join intense battles in Capture the Flag, Team Deathmatch, and Free for All, with more modes coming soon. Choose your team, fight for dominance, and experience adrenaline-fueled combat!

row.name: Gambling Forever
row.detailed_description: Gamble with your friends in a game of dice! Bet on the total number of dice with a specific value on the table, while you can only see your dice. Using various items and magic dice, outluck your friends or figure out an impossible-to-lose strategy! With many skins, free rotation of your character and multiple emotes, become one with your gambler and laugh and rage like never before!

row.name: Prisonela MD

row.name: ONE MAP - Never Ending Battle Royale
row.detailed_description: One Map is a revolutionary online multiplayer third-person shooter game where the entire world joins a single, never-ending battle royale. With no match-making wait times, you instantly dive into continuous PVP action, surrounded by players from across the globe. Gamers are tired of complicated menus and long waits — in One Map, the focus is on what matters most: the action. The map dynamically adjusts its size based on how many players are online, so it's never too big to feel empty or too small to feel crowded, ensuring the perfect balance for engaging gameplay and strategy. When you die, jump straight back into the death match and keep trying to survive longer than before. The goal is simple: survival. Play solo and rely on your own skills, or team up with friends to get an edge in this intense third person shooter. Every second counts, and the clock is always ticking. It’s simple to play but hard to master—perfect for those looking for a real shooter challenge. One Map’s goal is to break the world record for the most players online in a single game. With its continuous game design, One Map brings players together in one massive, real-time battle royale. The current record is 8,825 players, and we need your help to beat it. Join the fight, stay alive, and make gaming history in this ultimate survival showdown. Features: One Global Game: No more waiting for match-making! Everyone around the world is playing the same game, so there's always a strategy-packed match to join in this intense PVP arena. Dynamic Map Size: The map expands or contracts based on the number of players online, ensuring it's never too big or too small, creating the perfect environment for intense action and strategic play. Survive Together or Alone: Play solo to test your skills, or team up with friends to gain an advantage in this intense third person shooter. Real-Time Leaderboards: Track your progress with in-game leaderboards that rank every current player based on survival time. The player who has survived the longest will be ranked first, followed by the rest. Additionally, view daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards that highlight the top players in this thrilling battle royale experience. Combat Variety: Take down opponents your way—shoot them in PVP combat, sneak up for an assassination, or celebrate a win with dance moves. Choose Your Character: Pick from a variety of characters with unique appearances. They all perform the same but let you customize your look on the battlefield. How long can you survive? The longer you stay in the game, the greater the battle royale challenge. Dive into One Map - Never Ending Battle now, and see how long you can last in this intense multiplayer action and strategy game!
row.short_description: One Map is an online shooter where the entire world fights in the same never-ending battle. No lobbies, no waiting—just instant action. The dynamic map adjusts to the player count, ensuring non-stop combat. Survive, compete, and help break the world record for the most players online in a game.
row.notes: One Map is a third person shooter featuring online multiplayer battles. Players engage in PVP combat using firearms to kill each other in order to stay alive longer, but the game does not include blood, gore, or dismemberment. There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm.

row.name: 초요소녀 리리나 2 (Choyo Girl Lilina 2)
row.detailed_description: This game cannot be cleared if you are addicted to dopamine. However, with just a bit of perseverance, you may temporarily free yourself from dopamine addiction. Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is a game about the training journey of a 16-year-old magical girl. At the age of 13, she was rescued by a special forces unit and began working as a magician. To become a stronger magician, she travels from village to village, training and gaining experience. Guided by a secret agent from the first village, she moves on to the next village. Helping villagers with their troubles will earn her rewards, allowing her to purchase better items. Experience Lilina as she overcomes hardships, defeating wrongdoers and dangerous creatures! Supports subtitles in Korean, English, Japanese, Turkish, German, and Indonesian. Basic voice acting is available in Korean, English, and Japanese. Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is an RPG where you embark on an adventure and enhance Lilina's abilities. If you encounter an enemy too strong to defeat, level up and purchase better equipment to overcome the challenge! Controls: ''' Press the Page Up (PU) key to view your current tasks ''' Move: Arrow Keys Select: Spacebar Menu: ESC Key ★ If you have no idea what to do, read this ★ Pressing the Page Up key will show you what you need to do at the moment. If you waste money by going to the academy from the beginning, the game may become difficult. You should first explore every area of the map, earn money, equip basic armor and weapons, and then enter the academy. At the beginning, it’s a good idea to find treasure chests in the village or clear missions from villagers that are nearby and use the rewards to prioritize setting up your armor. If the stamina gauge at the bottom right runs out, it’s game over. You can restore stamina to 100% by sleeping at an inn. Stamina increases as your level increases, so leveling up lets you explore the map more freely. If you can’t defeat strong enemies in Phase 2 or 3, it may be more efficient to defeat them one at a time with single-target spells instead of area spells. If you proceed to the next map without being able to handle the strongest enemy in the current map, you may be in trouble. It’s recommended to level up until you can easily defeat the strongest enemy before moving on. It might seem difficult at first, but once you get used to the general flow, you’ll find it’s not too hard to clear.
row.short_description: Choyo Girl Lilina 2 is an RPG game about the training journey of a 16-year-old magical girl. Embark on an adventure through various villages, hunt monsters, and purchase better items from shops.

row.name: My life with you
row.detailed_description: 'My Life with You' tells the story of a young woman who, after falling in love as a teenager, ends up getting pregnant. Abandoned by her boyfriend, she must face the challenges of being a single mother, balancing work, household responsibilities, and her dream of building a better future for herself and her child. Living with her grandmother, she seeks a job to support their home while dealing with the struggles of motherhood and the possibility of finding love again. At the core of it all is the bond between mother and child, showing the highs and lows of a journey filled with challenges, growth, and love. This project was carried out with resources from Complementary Law No. 195/2022 – Paulo Gustavo Law, funded by the Paulo Gustavo Law, IECINE/RS, the State Department of Culture of Rio Grande do Sul, the Ministry of Culture, and the Federal Government, with execution by Sorora Game Studio. A sensitive narrative experience, with little to no text, accessible in any language. Explore the protagonist’s everyday life: caring for her child, searching for a job, and navigating her emotions. Play at your own pace—no timers, no pressure—just experience and connection.
row.short_description: 'My Life with You' is a STORY DRIVEN experience that follows the journey of a young SINGLE MOM who must BALANCE life's challenges while raising her child. An emotional journey focused on the BOND BETWEEN MOTHER AND CHILD, marked by obstacles, growth, and love.

row.name: MALMIJAL - Basic
row.detailed_description: 🧩 About This Software — MALMIJAL Basic MALMIJAL Basic is a free, drag-and-drop data analysis platform that lets you process and visualize data intuitively — no coding required. With just a few clicks, you can perform preprocessing, statistical analysis, filtering, and spectrum analysis, then visualize the results as graphs or export them as files. Every step follows a visual pipeline structure (DATA → PROCESS → DISPLAY) , making it easy to see how your data flows through each stage. The streamlined single-path workflow allows you to complete complex analyses quickly and effortlessly. 🔹 Key Features Preprocessing: trend removal, resampling, curve fitting, arithmetic operations, differentiation, integration, peak detection Statistical Analysis: max, min, median, standard deviation, variance, RMS, skewness, kurtosis Filtering: moving average, exponential moving average, FIR/IIR filters (Butterworth, Chebyshev, Elliptic) Spectrum Analysis: FFT, PSD, Power Spectrum, STFT, 1/3-Octave analysis Data I/O: supports MATLAB (.mat), Excel (.xlsx), audio (.wav, .flac, .mp3, etc.), and text (.txt) files Graph Options: automatic bar/line/pie chart conversion, customizable markers, line styles, colors, and data cursors 🔹 Difference from MALMIJAL-Modeling Basic focuses on a single-flow visual pipeline , perfect for quick and simple data analysis. In contrast, MALMIJAL-Modeling provides a block-based modeling environment , where you can freely add and connect multiple DATA, PROCESS, and DISPLAY blocks to build complex models. With Basic , you can analyze one dataset efficiently. With Modeling , you can design, expand, and automate entire analysis systems. When you upgrade to MALMIJAL-Modeling , you’ll be able to: Process multiple inputs in parallel Create and reuse custom operation blocks Save complex workflows as reusable models The familiar Basic interface carries over, so you can seamlessly use from quick analysis to advanced modeling . 🔹 Example Scenario Import an audio file containing background noise, apply filtering to remove the noise, and perform FFT analysis to visualize the frequency content. All steps can be executed with simple clicks — and when you’re ready to go further, switch to MALMIJAL-Modeling to save the same process as a reusable model for deeper analysis.

row.name: Aker Fern 2
row.detailed_description: Aker Fern 2 – a visual novel unlike any you've experienced before! Continuing the story of mystery, destiny and the impact of the past on the present In the 16th century, in a world filled with superstition and mystery, there lived a man named Mikołaj Fern. He was no ordinary traveler but someone who sought to discover truths that could change his fate. Traversing the lands of the Republic, he tracked supernatural phenomena and eliminated them not out of concern for humanity but out of a desire to escape his inevitable fate. His life ended with a public execution, but the story he began was not finished. New story, new hero, same fate After more than five hundred years, Dan Tern was born, an ordinary boy leading a quiet life until memories of a previous incarnation shatter his reality. Mikołaj Fern has returned, but this time in a different body and era. The mystery he carries enters the modern world, entailing events that will not only change his fate but also uncover the truth about the Shatris Core —an enigmatic element that influences human destiny. A new approach to narrative – changing perspectives Aker Fern 2 is a sequel to the visual novel released in 2020, distinguished by its innovative narrative form. This time, the story will not be told from only one perspective. The game introduces a system of changing characters , allowing the events of the previous part to take on new meaning and new plots to weave into a unified, immersive story. Multifaceted story – events are presented through the perspectives of different characters, allowing a deep understanding of their motivations and emotions. Coherent, linear narrative – although the game contains smaller choices, its main asset is a strongly developed storyline without unnecessary bifurcations, allowing you to focus on its quality. Character development – Dan Tern, like other characters, will evolve over the course of the game, affecting how you experience the story. Climate and style – a combination of humor and mystery The game's style is inspired by anime aesthetics, featuring clear outlines and a relatively simple yet thoughtful color palette. However, Aker Fern 2 is not just about beautiful illustrations; it is primarily a story that combines elements of mystery, drama, and comedy . The narrative surprises with emotional moments and unexpected humorous twists. Secrets of the past – discover the secrets Fern has been hiding and learn the consequences of his past decisions. Exaggerated humor – light and comedic moments contrast with more serious themes, creating a unique dynamic. Action elements – dynamic scenes that can be compared to the shounen's showy parts. What can you expect in the full version? The game's demo offers only a snippet of the story; the full version contains ten times more content! You can expect: More locations and illustrations – each scene has been designed with attention to detail to immerse the player in the right mood.. An extensive soundtrack – atmospheric music that provides depth. In-depth storyline – new chapters, new mysteries, and new emotions! Refreshed graphics – elements known from the demo have been improved and enhanced. Key information Platform: PC (Steam) Genre: Visual novel (visual novel) Engine: Ren'Py Free demo available on Steam Who is this game for? If you appreciate a deep, engaging narrative and are interested in stories of mystery and time travel , then Aker Fern 2 is for you. The game will especially appeal to those who love visual novels with an intriguing plot but do not shy away from humor and dynamic scenes . Why is Aker Fern 2 worth playing? Unique combination of genres Aker Fern 2 is primarily a visual novel that combines elements of thriller, drama, fantasy, and subtle humor . The game offers a story where the mysteries of the past intertwine with the characters' personal choices. Instead of imposing a pace, it allows the player to discover its details independently. It's a story-driven journey that explores the impact of decisions, destiny, and self-understanding—without unnecessary embellishments or exaggerated drama. A deeper understanding of the plot Although the game doesn't offer many plot bifurcations, the player, in the role of an observer, has the opportunity for a deeper understanding of the characters and their motivations. This is not a classic interactive story where choices change the course of events; instead, the player discovers different layers of the same story , analyzing the fate of the characters from various perspectives. This approach allows for a deeper immersion into the presented world and an understanding of what truly drives the characters . Heroes – who are they, and how do they affect the story? Dan Tern / Mikołaj Fern – two personalities, one destiny The main character of the game is Dan Tern , an ordinary young man leading a quiet life until his consciousness becomes permeated by memories of his previous incarnation. Mikołaj Fern comes back to life, and his memory begins to dominate Dan's mind. They are both the same person, but their life paths intertwine to form one cohesive character. Together, they form a full-bodied character: on one hand, a determined young man, and on the other, someone who has experienced too much to be naive. Other characters Ajris We meet Ajris at a time when her life had completely fallen apart, and she was contemplating suicide. As she plunged further into the lake, she heard the laughter of an older man—Mikołaj Fern. His behavior irritated her greatly, but his words made her decide to abandon her intention and eventually follow him. Since then, Ajris has accompanied Mikołaj Fern on his travels. Over time, she began to appreciate him as a man who changed her life. She recognized that if she had to sacrifice herself to save him, she would do so without hesitation. However, at one point in the story, she finds Mikołaj Fern hanging from a noose. When Mikołaj Fern's soul is burdened with a curse, forcing him to kill his own family, Ajris confronts his chained soul and is mortally wounded. However, she discovers a way to free him. Her soul is separated from her body, and the curse is sealed inside. Mikołaj's soul finds peace and passes away, while Ajris's soul remains trapped in the human world for 500 years—until Mikołaj's consciousness awakens in Dan Terna. From then on, Ajris, as a spirit, constantly accompanies him. Sana Gabler Sana was created from a combination of the curse incumbent on Mikołaj Fern and Ajris' body. The body was supposed to remain sealed for eternity, but Dan Tern opens the sarcophagus, hoping to restore Ajris to her body. However, he discovers that over 500 years, the curse has developed a consciousness. He decides to name her Sana and observe her behavior among humans to determine if she poses a threat. Blanka Surma Blanka is Dan's close friend and one of the most decisive characters in the game. She was by his side when the memory of Mikołaj Fern awoke in him. She is a meticulous person and a model student, but she also has an impulsive nature and is excellent at fighting, which has earned her the nickname 'Amazon' in the past. Weronika Furman Weronika epitomizes laziness—whiny, insufferable, and reliant on convenience, preferring others to do the work for her. Despite this, she is the president of the student government. What no one knows is that there is a secret related to the creation of the school where Dan ended up. She is a shadowy figure and plays a key role in the story. Tatiana Mika Tatiana is a girl with 'reporter's ADHD'—she's always seeking sensationalism and isn't afraid to step in where she shouldn't. In the past, she encountered the Last Devil and survived the confrontation thanks to Dan Tern's help. This experience left a mark on her character and motivations, which we discover throughout the game. Erika Flis Erika is the daughter of a school principal, and her life is marked by rebellion against her father and the rules imposed on her. She is energetic and spirited, often leading to absurd situations. Although Erika seems to be Tatiana's opposite, their fates intertwine in surprising ways. Ariel Biernat Ariel is a character shrouded in mystery. He accompanies Erika and Feliks on their comedic, yet often twisted, adventures. His motives remain unclear, and behind the facade of intelligence and precise actions lies a mystery yet to be uncovered. Karen Lasota Karen is one of the most enigmatic characters in the world of Aker Fern . She is quiet and aloof, giving the impression of someone who does not understand the reality around her. Her presence arouses anxiety and curiosity; she is an enigma that intrigues both the characters and the players. Game mechanics – what sets Aker Fern 2 apart? Narration based on emotions – the characters react to situations in a dynamic way, which makes the story more realistic. Stylized graphics and animation – anime aesthetics combined with refined lines make every scene resemble a frame from a high-quality animated series.. Why should you play? Aker Fern 2 is the full version of a game born from a passion for storytelling. It expands on the plots from the earlier demo , enriching them with new perspectives, characters, and mysteries. This visual novel not only narrates the fate of its characters but also allows players to reflect on their own choices and their consequences. Our goal was to create a game that combines an immersive storyline with an unconventional atmosphere—something we would want to experience as players ourselves. We put our hearts into every detail, from the dialogues to the music, to ensure that the story of the Aker Fern world captivates you completely. The game is completely free, just like our previous projects. We aim to promote Polish visual novels and want everyone to access our work without financial barriers. If you've played the demo, you know that Aker Fern is more than a simple game—it's a story awaiting your interpretation and decisions. We encourage you to discover the whole story and learn the truth about the Shatris Core. We hope you find something here that inspires, intrigues, or simply allows you to have a nice time.
row.short_description: Take on the role of Dan Tern, a young man in whom the consciousness of Mikołaj Fern—a man from five hundred years ago—has awakened. Discover the mysteries of the past, confront the curse that haunts him, and conclude a story that never reached its end.

row.name: Champions Tactics Reforged

In the dark world of Grimoria, you rise as a young lord entrusted with leading a team of mythical Champions crafted by a mysterious Alchemist using forbidden magic.
