Engage in thrilling turn-based tactical battles against other players where the outcome relies on tactics, mind games, and Champions' abilities. Diversity reigns supreme as you assemble your team with a vast array of Champions, each a unique masterpiece with its own distinctive abilities, strengths, and weaknesses. Will you choose The Grim Rogue, The Ardent Diviner or The Savage Oracle? The choice is yours! BECOME A WORLDWIDE LEGEND Test your tactical prowess in intense online PvP battles, rise through the ranks, and earn epic rewards. INVOKE CHAMPION Master the power of the Bloodstone to invoke powerful champions with unique skills & abilities. ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM   Collect thousands of unique powerful champions to outmatch any opponent's lineup. TACTICAL PLAY TO WIN Victory comes from skill, not chance. row.short_description: Champions Tactics REFORGED is a turn-based strategy game where players command squads of mystical figurines in tactical PvP battles. Forge unique Champions, master deep strategy, and outsmart rivals in intense duels. Shape your legend in the dark and mysterious world of Grimoria.

row.name: Wardoll

row.short_description: 《湖中天空 ：CAELUM IN LACU》是以RPGMaker引擎制作的解谜冒险向角色扮演类像素俯视角RPG游戏。 玩家将在游戏开始时以“林间浦叶”这一角色的视角进行探索，并在学院内的不断探索中结识几位性格各异的女性，与一部手机中的神秘联系人“赞丹的风车”一起逐步揭开这所学院内发生的秘辛往事。

row.name: Luck and Fear
row.detailed_description: You wake up on the tenth floor of an abandoned hotel. Your head hurts—someone has attacked you, and now you’re trapped. You have no idea why this happened, but one thing is clear: you must escape. But the hotel is not just any abandoned building. It’s a maze of dark corridors, locked doors, and unexpected dangers. The way out is full of obstacles—and worst of all? You’re not alone. Game Features: Exploration and Puzzle Solving – Search for keys, hidden objects, and clues to progress through locked rooms and hallways. Survival Against a Killer – A mysterious enemy roams the halls looking for you. You must be careful, hide, and use your environment to survive. Intense Horror Atmosphere – Dynamic lighting, disturbing sounds, and a terrifying environment create a constant tension that will keep you on edge. Diverse Escape Routes – Choose from various ways to escape the hotel. Will you take the long, safer route, or risk a shorter but more dangerous route? A Mysterious and Shocking Story – Discover secret letters, and clues scattered throughout the hotel that will help you understand the hotel’s and the killer’s dark past—and your connection to it. A Random and Unpredictable Experience – Every time you play, the experience will be different. The hallways, rooms, and keys are randomly placed, making each escape attempt challenging and surprising.
row.short_description: A tense survival horror game where you must explore a dark, ever-changing hotel, solve puzzles, and evade a relentless killer. Every playthrough is unique, with randomized environments and unpredictable dangers.

With our VR Builder , you can design, modify, and bring your vision to life instantly. Enter the Arena & Prove Your Skills!
row.short_description: Magic Madness VR is an immersive elemental PvP arena where every motion is magic and every spell is a choice. Battle up to four players in fast, skill-based VR combat, mastering Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water across evolving arenas that test balance, reflex, and true elemental control.

row.detailed_description: In 1925, the Harvard University & Boston Museum of Fine Arts Expedition under George Reisner made one of its greatest discoveries at Giza: Buried under sand, hidden among other tombs, lay the mysterious tomb G 7000X, which some believe was the final resting place of Queen Hetepheres I., mother of pharaoh Khufu. Join the expedition that discovered this strange tomb and help them solve the mysteries that lay within. Narrated by famous Egyptologist and Harvard Professor Peter Manuelian, you can visit a tomb that has been sealed shut for almost a century. Uncover and restore some of the invaluable artifacts to learn about the researcher's work and how it continues till present times. Modes The game aims to not only be fun to play for individuals but also to be played in an educational contexts (schools, museums, ...). Depending on how much time there is per person, you can choose between three modes*: - Long: Relive the full history of the tomb (Playtime: ~30 min) - Short: Focus on modern archeological work (Playtime: ~15 min) - Exhibition: Only the final exhibition (Playtime: ~5 min) * Each experience ends with players being able to explore the final exhibition.
row.short_description: An interactive, history-based, virtual reality experience joined with a digital exhibition about one of the greatest discoveries made at the Giza necropolis. Retrace the steps of famous archeologists and ancient royals to find and restore their lost treasures.

row.name: SIGame

row.name: Dream Slayers

Face cursed knights and shifting beasts , each more twisted than the last. Conquer the darkness to uncover the truth… or be consumed by it. row.short_description: Enter the realm of the Dream Slayers, a Fantasy-Themed Extraction RPG where you battle nightmares, survive raids, and escape with powerful loot... or lose it all.
row.notes: Dream Slayers features stylized fantasy combat and dark thematic elements set within a dreamlike world. The game does not include any sexual content, nudity, depictions of sexual assault, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm. row.name: Snap Flex
row.detailed_description: Snap Flex Snap Flex is a fast-paced, reflex-driven card game based on the classic Snap rules. Players take turns placing cards on the table. When two cards match in rank, the first to snap wins the pile. The goal is simple: collect all the cards to win. Flex Mode introduces new ways to play: Match both ranks and suits for a more dynamic, fast-paced experience. row.short_description: Snap Flex is a fast-paced card game based on classic Snap. Match ranks or suits, play with points or winner-takes-all. Enjoy offline or online multiplayer with up to 4 players.

row.name: GnollHack
row.detailed_description: GnollHack is a traditional roguelike that takes the legendary depth of NetHack and brings it into the modern age. With graphics, sounds, and voiceovers, the dungeon isn’t just a place you explore — it's an adventure full of surprises, dangers, and opportunities that challenge your wit at every turn. This isn’t a game about quick reflexes or fast button-mashing. Every step is turn-based. Every choice matters. You succeed not by clicking fast, but by thinking smart — learning the dungeon’s secrets, mastering its systems, and using skill and cunning to overcome impossible odds.   Modern Action Roguelike Fans If you love randomized item drops and rewards in  modern action roguelikes , GnollHack offers that same “one more run” magic — but in longer sessions. Runs can last hours or even days, filled with emergent stories you’ll remember: desperate escapes, clever victories, and the occasional sudden downfall. There’s no grind or unlock treadmill — only your knowledge and skill carry you forward. Traditional Roguelike Fans Fans of traditional roguelikes will find something rare here: a roguelike that modernizes a classic game without losing depth. GnollHack adds a layer of immersion through visuals, audio, and narration, and bakes vital gameplay information directly into the game, sparing you the need to read wikis. It’s still hardcore, still endlessly replayable — but far more welcoming to play. NetHack Veterans If NetHack is your home, GnollHack is its expanded cousin. It adds new monsters, spells, items, and mechanics while keeping the heart of the game intact. It offers graphics, sounds, and voiceovers, and retains the option to play with the same depth and complexity you know and love. With active development and frequent updates, GnollHack is not just another variant — it’s a continuation of NetHack's legacy. Main Features Outsmart the dungeon: a test of intelligence, skill, and mastery — not reflexes. Experience modern graphics, sound effects, and voiceovers. Create your own stories through emergent gameplay and unexpected twists. Explore one of the deepest, most replayable games ever made. Free to play, with no ads, no microtransactions, and no grind. GnollHack is more than a game. It’s a puzzle, an adventure, and a test of wit. If you’re ready for a roguelike where every decision can mean the difference between glory and a sudden death, then enter the Dungeons of Doom and play GnollHack.   Enabling Dedicated GPU In the case your computer has multiple GPUs, GnollHack uses the integrated GPU by default. If you want to use the dedicated GPU , you must enable it as follows: 1. Open Windows Settings . 2. Go to System → Display → Graphics . 3. Add a desktop app  and select  'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\GnollHack\GnollHackM.exe'. 4. GnollHackM should appear in the app list. Click on it to expand its options. Select High Performance  as  GPU preference . Troubleshooting If the game is stuck in the loading screen in the ' Done loading ' phase, you can fix the problem as follows: 1. Open Control Panel . 2. Click Clock and Region . 3. Click Region . 4. Select the Administrative  tab and, in the Language for non-Unicode programs section, click Change system locale . 5. Select English (United States)  as the current system locale and click OK. Alternatively, you can download an MSIX installer for the game from GnollHack's GitHub releases page . Installing the game through it will also fix the problem.
row.short_description: GnollHack brings NetHack’s legendary depth to life with graphics, sounds, and voiceovers — a roguelike where wit and mastery decide your fate.

Experience Chaos Destruction!  Everything you see can be shattered, crumbled, and blown to bits. Skill-Based Gameplay: Burn for Power, or Play It Safe? The brighter the Mush, the closer you are to overdosing, but the more powerful your dashes become. Procedurally Generated Levels: Endless Variety, Unpredictable Difficulty! Experience challenges that range from surprisingly forgiving to incredibly tough, with a unique level layout every time you play. Prove Your Dominance: Are You the Ultimate 'Mush' Master? Challenge players worldwide and climb to the top of the leaderboards!... or die trying!
row.short_description: A stimulating, yet deeply chill, psychedelic action roguelite platformer. Master your reflexes, collect dopamine, and chase Nirvana... or overdose trying.

row.name: In Season
row.detailed_description: In Season is a chaotic couch co-op game! Play alone or with your friends to complete all your orders in time and deliver vegetables, flowers, fish and more to the farmstand!  Play with 1-6 players locally In Season can be played alone or with up to 5 of your friends locally. Or play online using the Steam Remote Play Together feature. The difficulty of the orders adjusts to the number of players, but the fun remains! Play through all four seasons When you reach 4 stars you can move on to the next level- the next season! Every season has unique crops, but if you make it to the greenhouse in winter, you will have to plant crops from every season all at once! Are you up for the challenge?  Every crop or animal comes with a unique mechanic Every plant requires different treatment. The pumpkin for example is so heavy, it can only be harvested by two farmers (or one very strong farmer, if you are playing alone) . In the little menu book, illustrations explain the crops, that get unlocked one by one.  The Strawfools wish you the best of luck and most of all a lot of fun this season and every season!
row.short_description: In Season is a chaotic and fun couch Co-op game! Complete orders in time by planting and harvesting crops correctly and gain enough stars to make it to the next season!

row.name: Bearly Awesome
row.detailed_description: Bearly Awesome is a fun blend of action, adventure, puzzle-solving and RPG. Players control cute and cuddly bear avatars, each with unique abilities, skills and customizations in an epic journey across diverse environments. Explore the enchanting fantasy world of Snuzzleland with your unique and adorable Bearlie, earn points and advance through fun levels! The top-down game blends exploration, puzzle-solving, light-hearted combat elements and cute characters in the ultimate furry adventure. Bearly Awesome is a sweet and joyous experience – a mix of wholesome and mischievous fun – where heaps of cute characters and exciting events await. Quest through magical lands, overcome obstacles, battle quirky enemies who wreak havoc on the forest, solve puzzles, claim new territories and eat as many snacks as you can get your paws on. Team up with friends or bond with new ones over your shared passion for mischief, fun and adventure. Some levels require you to be brave and resourceful, while others demand you to be quiet and sneaky as you manoeuvre around the campsite or the village without getting noticed. Charming Graphics and Dynamic Gameplay Enjoy varied, technical combat. Slide, jump, belly bump and strike! Face a wide cast of monsters, big and small — and explore colourful and connected worlds of lush forests, snowy mountains, busy towns, shady campsites and more. Discover hidden treasures and useful items to help you on your way. Solve puzzles using your Bearlie’s special skills, such as moving objects with strength, digging for hidden items, or using agility to traverse tricky platforms. Collect Honeycomb Coins to unlock new abilities, items, and levels. Defeat enemies and overcome every challenge in this enchanting and unexpectedly dynamic world. A Chill Game with Personality Simple Controls make the game easy to enjoy and fun to play. Players earn Honeycomb Coins to level up their bear avatars, unlocking new areas and abilities. Or use their special Bearlie skills to bear through challenging obstacles or overcome exciting challenges.  Play a single level to pass a few minutes of time or immerse yourself for hours in a beautifully cozy game world with fresh new challenges for players to complete! Many Exciting Skins to Choose From
row.short_description: Transform into a furry Bearlie and explore a mysterious, daunting world full of endless surprises and quests. Use your bear skills wisely to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles and team up with other players to advance through the enchanted world.

row.name: Bosquet
row.detailed_description: Please note that this game is only available in French. Bosquet  est un jeu d'aventure narratif destiné aux personnes impliquées dans les soins pédiatriques. Il a été élaboré par une équipe d'étudiants et intervenants de Bellecour École d'Art, en collaboration avec l'équipe de soins pédiatriques ESPPERA , rattachée au Centre Léon Bérard . A travers une histoire fantaisiste, Bosquet  aborde les thématiques de la maladie, de l'incertitude, du deuil, afin que le joueur développe son rapport à elles. Les personnages ont été pensés pour représenter différents profils de patients, parents et soignants, et leur évolution pendant le parcours de soin. Ci-dessous, une description de chaque profil représenté : FAMILLE & SOIGNANTS : Berthe représente un parent protecteur qui apprendra à se reposer en laissant un peu de sa charge à d'autres parents ou professionnels de santé Otto représente un soignant qui apprendra l'importance de l'écoute et des activités hors du contexte médical Pascal représente un soignant qui apprendra à laisser les enfants qu'il accompagne atteindre une plus grande autonomie émotionnelle Bonke représente un grand frère tourmenteur qui apprendra à accompagner sans faire de mal Saule représente un parent sacrificiel qui apprendra à s'étoffer moralement afin d'apporter la protection qu'il désire Gus représente un animal de compagnie, heureux lorsqu'il peut accompagner les autres PATIENTS : Charly représente un patient à mobilité réduite dont la découverte du voyage participera au rétablissement Ameli représente un patient anxieux face à ses faiblesses qui ira mieux grâce à l'accompagnement et à la confiance de ses proches Pico représente un patient complexé par sa maladie, qui apprendra à briller par lui-même Lily représente un patient s'étant construit une carapace pour nier sa maladie, qui apprendra à être elle-même dans les contexte sociaux Titou représente un patient à la santé très fragile, qui apprendra qu'on peut avoir une place dans la vie des autres, aussi bref que soit notre passage Akim représente un patient dont l'état se dégrade, dont on devra profiter de la présence sans s'acharner à la prolonger outre mesure Kami représente un patient indifférent à sa condition, qui apprendra l'importance de prendre soin de soi-même Dash représente un patient hyperactif qui apprendra à rediriger son énergie pour apprécier des moments plus calmes
row.short_description: Une aventure narrative sur le thème de la maladie avec un gameplay du genre auto-battler. Explorez la forêt, affrontez des ennemis et rencontrez de nombreux compagnons aux personnalités uniques !

row.name: Knight Light
row.detailed_description: In a small Victorian town, terrifying nightmares manifest, attempting to shatter the Witchball—a mystical barrier safeguarding the sleeping residents. As a courageous deity, you must battle through relentless waves of nightmarish creatures, defending the Witchball and protecting the town from falling into eternal darkness. Save their dreams before it’s too late! Protect Divine Defense Wave Based Combat Gothic Horror Aesthetic Evolving Enemies This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Terrifying nightmares manifest, attempting to shatter the Witchball—a mystical barrier safeguarding the sleeping residents. As a courageous deity, battle through relentless waves of nightmarish creatures, protecting the town from falling into eternal darkness. Save their dreams before it’s too late!

row.name: MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS
row.detailed_description: JUST LIKE IN THE PAPERS. MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS is a short, fast-paced 3rd person horror/comedy hybrid of games like  Hotline Miami and Post Void, with hand-drawn visuals inspired loosely by retro detective comics. You'll step into the well-polished shoes of Clive, an undead detective working to take down the criminals that initially killed him. LIVE. DIE. LIVE AGAIN. When a parasite reawakens detective Clive from death, he is recruited into a secret taskforce to stop those that killed him from weaponizing this newfound immortality. Slay crooks and goons in semi-linear corridor levels that are built for honing in and optimising your own quickest path through. Prepare to die, and then die again.
row.short_description: When a parasite reawakens detective Clive from death, he is recruited into a secret taskforce to stop those that killed him from weaponizing this newfound immortality.
row.notes: Contains lots of gore and violence against crooks and criminals, plus brief mentions of violence and drugs.

row.name: Labyrinthine Dread
row.detailed_description: Play as Doctor Elizabeth 'Liz' Landrake, a genetic scientist in an alternate Victorian era laboratory. As time has passed, your workplace respite has become desolate, abandoned, and filled with deadly chimaeras who have turned against their creators. Traverse through your laboratory, armed only with your quick reactions and a kerosene lantern, to collect a series of key cards in the attempt to escape this laboratory in lockdown. Along the way, collect notes, remnants of a time before this laboratory got shut down, to provide insight as to who was here alongside Liz. Light is the only thing that seems to keep the monsters at bay, so keep your lantern filled, and try to only use the light when it is absolutely necessary. The Light is Your Friend - Make your way through an abandoned laboratory, finding the rooms filled with light that keeps the apparent occupants at bay. It Has Your Scent - Monsters that lurk in the dark who know where you are even better than you do. The Sounds of a Dangerous Waltz - Hand-crafted compositions and audio to immerse the player in the mind of Doctor Elizebeth Landrake. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: In this Top-Down Horror game, try to escape from an otherwise abandoned laboratory, armed only with a lantern and the keys strewn about in monster-infested rooms.

row.name: Critter Isle
row.detailed_description: Welcome to CRITTER ISLE! A wonderful resort where you can immerse yourself in the role of island manager and caretaker for the Egglins, rare and mysterious critters taking the world by storm.  BECOME A FARMER With over 10 different crops, you'll have your work cut out for you learning how to grow all of them and figuring out your Egglin's favorite. DECORATE YOUR ISLAND Every good environment deserves some homey touches, and with over 60 different island decorations, you can customize every inch of your island to suit your fancy. The Egglins will appreciate you for making their world your own. COLLECT EGGLINS Once the first egg hatches you'll be dying to hatch more and collect the over 60 known Egglins throughout the world! And don't worry about losing track of them. The Bestiary logs all of your discovered Egglins throughout your collecting adventures. So are you ready to take this once in a lifetime opportunity and start your Egglin collecting adventure? Just remember, be good to the Egglins, and the Egglins... may be good to you ... possibly. Oh and no return deposit for the Island. Have fun!!
row.short_description: Jump right in and hatch your first Egglin, let creativity flow as you learn how to manage your Egglin's wants and needs through food and play. Zen out to the blissful comforts of decorating your island how you see fit, and bask in the rewards your Egglins provide as you grow your Egglin empire.

row.name: Click Click Bomb
row.detailed_description: A casual clicker incremental game inspired by Giant Bomb's Blight Club. Click the button, spend currency on unlockables, and enjoy uncovering mechanics as you go. A short, afternoon experience that can be played on your second monitor at work. Built with React and Electron. FEATURES: Clicking Spending Clicks on Gimmicks Barely any ludo-narrative dissonance 15 Unique Achievements No hidden fees New Game+ DOES NOT FEATURE: Full Motion Video actually, wait, yes it does Controller Support Actual Pickles
row.short_description: A Giant Bomb inspired clicker-incremental game with unlockables and gimmicks to discover. A casual experience, best enjoyed on a second screen at work. Features moreish Match 3-esque mechanics.
row.reviews: “Some art will, given time, morph alongside us. Some art will wait calmly, even stubbornly, for us to return with a new perspective. Click Click Bomb, by my estimation, has done a bit of both. It has sat patiently, confident in its mechanisms and gargantuan in its ideas, but has also shifted -- just a little bit -- while we all did our best to grow.” Dan Ryckert

row.name: Ant Guardians Prologue
row.detailed_description: Prologue Version Information 3 stages and 20 units available 1 hero available Maximum level 10 (Progress from the demo version does not carry over.) Summon Your Units, Build Your Strategy, and Defend! Seal the corrupted crystal while fending off endless waves of invading enemies! Gather resources and summon ally units to defeat increasingly powerful foes. Block entrances with walls or use sturdy units to hold back enemies. Enhance items to make your units even stronger. Learn powerful skills to quickly annihilate your enemies. Create your own unique strategy to complete your mission!
row.short_description: It’s a defense game where you create your own strategy, grow your units, and defend against enemies.

row.name: Jade Spring
row.detailed_description: Jade Spring Currently In Beta Jade Spring  is actively in development as I continue to fix bugs, improve features, and add decorations! This means that you could come across game components which are unstable or incomplete. Tickets or messages about bugs, improvements, or feature ideas would be greatly appreciated. Thank you, and enjoy! About the Game Relax, potter, and build in Jade Spring, a small Guild Wars 2 decorating and homesteading fan game featuring entirely hand-made assets and items. Tend your garden as a Xunlai jade bot, clearing weeds and pests, dispelling Dragonvoid blights, and furnishing your plot with architecture, flora, furniture, and ornaments from across Tyria! Zen Cleaning Engage in mini-games to spruce up your plot, clearing out bugs, invasive plants, and leftover strands of Dragonvoid. Collect Karma from each task to spend on permanent improvements to your gardening and decorating abilities! Granular Decoration Personalise your space using robust tools which let you easily move, rotate, scale, snap, and clear items. Acquire enough Karma to unlock fancy decorations, as well as utilities which allow you to change the time of day, clear the map to start fresh, and fine-tune your environment to suit your creativity. A Guild Wars 2 Tribute Jade Spring is an independent developer’s love letter to Cantha and to Guild Wars 2 in general, featuring hand-made assets, art, models, animations, and music directly inspired by the worlds of Tyria, and filled with small tributes and references. Notice as specified by ArenaNet’s content terms of use: © ArenaNet LLC. All rights reserved. NCSOFT, ArenaNet, Guild Wars, Guild Wars 2, GW2, Guild Wars 2: Heart of Thorns, Guild Wars 2: Path of Fire, Guild Wars 2: End of Dragons, and Guild Wars 2: Secrets of the Obscure and all associated logos, designs, and composite marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of NCSOFT Corporation.
row.short_description: Relax, potter, and build in Jade Spring, a small Guild Wars 2 decorating and homesteading fan game.

row.name: SOLANIS
row.detailed_description: A thousand years ago, humanity tore the moon from the sky, sealing it within you and chaining you to the earth. But all chains rust. It's time to spread your wings once more. Soar between the ruins of a scarred world, exploring floating islands, hidden canyons, and breathtaking monuments, each with unique characters, challenges, and secrets to discover. Using powers divined from the the moon, transform into a shooting star and propel yourself through the air. Peer into the realm of darkness to aid your search for the fallen moon shards. Your choices shape not only your journey, but the fate of those around you. Will you restore the moon to the sky, or forge a new destiny in a world of eternal light?
row.short_description: A thousand years ago, humanity tore the moon from the sky, sealing it within you and chaining you to the earth. But all chains rust. Now freed, you must journey into the scorched, war-torn land you once called home and return the moon to the sky.

row.name: Hauntrick
row.detailed_description: A co-op horror game where the supernatural isn’t just terrifying—it’s also completely ridiculous. Face mischievous, unpredictable ghosts, perform chaotic rituals, and survive the ever-growing madness. Can you outsmart the hauntings, or will the trick be on you? 1-4 PLAYER Online CO-OP Team up with up to three friends in this chaotic horror experience. Work together to locate cursed objects, set up the ritual, and deal with the bizarre, unpredictable entities standing in your way. Each game feels fresh, thanks to randomized enemy behaviors, supernatural debuffs, and maps that keep you guessing. UNPREDICTABLE AND GOOFY SPIRITS The spirits in Hauntrick are anything but ordinary. Each one behaves differently—some are goofy, some are unpredictable, and others have their own strange ways of interfering with the ritual. You never know what they'll do next, making every encounter unexpected and full of chaos. EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT Each session in Hauntrick throws new surprises your way. Procedurally generated maps, randomized cursed objects, and a rotating cast of unique spirits make sure no two runs feel the same. Adapt fast, or get tricked into an early grave. PERFORM THE RITUAL, BANISH THE CURSE Your goal is simple: find the cursed objects scattered around the map and place them in the ritual circle. However, with spirits lurking around every corner, working quickly and efficiently is key—hesitation will only make things harder. BUY, SURVIVE, REPEAT In Hauntrick , collecting coins isn’t just for show—it’s your key to survival. Use your earnings to buy powerful items from the shop, giving you a fighting chance against the unpredictable hauntings. Use the spell, English or Spanish, to freeze spirits in place, turn invisible with a special pill, teleport out of danger, or even arm yourself with a gun. Whether you choose to escape, outsmart, or fight back, the shop ensures that every run offers new strategies to survive the madness. CHAOTIC DEBUFFS: EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED Want to make things even crazier? Enable the Debuff Setting and suffer through randomized effects that change how you play. Lose the ability to jump. Get your controls reversed. Drop items uncontrollably. Or get hit with a surprise game of Red Light, Green Light. SURVIVE THE CHAOS, OR BECOME ITS NEXT VICTIM?
row.short_description: Hauntrick is a chaotic, goofy horror game where you hunt cursed objects, perform rituals, and survive bizarre hauntings—solo or with friends. The ghosts? Unpredictable, absurd, and hilariously annoying. Every match is a mix of strategy, panic, and laughter as reality itself starts to unravel.
row.notes: During the game, you can witness characters being injured. Additionally, you may encounter some supernatural events due to the realistic atmosphere in the game. The game features mild horror violence.

row.name: This Game is Ground Breaking
row.detailed_description: OUT NOW! 🎉 BREAKING NEWS: This Game is Ground Breaking… literally. After months of digging deep and breaking everything in sight , we’ve finally done it — This Game is Ground Breaking is now available for FREE! We’ve sacrificed no sleep but a lot of brain cells to bring you a game that: 🎮 Will make you want to bash your friend with a controller 💔 Never let your sibling forget who is better and therefore more loved 🕹️ Makes you realise that you were never good at video games Play it now, so you can get over your depression in preparation for GTA VI  About the Game This game is ground breaking -ly fun! The most popular game at our local gamescom is now on Steam! This Game is Ground breaking is a couch-co-op game made to invoke the absolute chaos of playing split screen arcade games as a kid. This game will make you want to smash your friends head through the TV have unforgettable moments with your friends. 5-10 minutes of pure fun, Remote Play Supported! If you and your 'Friend' wants to play together, you can do so via Remote Play. Follow the instructions below on how to set it up. Note: This is only required if you are playing with a friend on a remote PC, if you both are in the same PC skip this Setup  1. Open the Game  2. The Host will need to have one additional Input Device (Controller) connected apart from the keyboard and mouse. 3. Shift+Tab -> Right Click on a Friend -> Invite Remote Play. 4. Once they have Joined, Shift + Tab again, find the remote play Icon on the bottom, and you should see your friends name on the Remote play list. 5. Click on the Keyboard and Mouse Icon next to the Friends name to Give access. 6. Success! They should now be able to use their own Keyboard &Mouse or a Controller to play with you!. How to Play The objective is simple, outlast your friend in the arena. If you step on a tile, the tile will fall shortly after. So be careful where you tread, If you want to speed up the winning process, shoot explosives at the other friend which will break all the tiles instantly upon impact. This game features ground breaking mechanics and new features such as. - No micro-transactions: If we bother to make a skin, just take it. - No battle-passes that unlock useless items on level up. - No annoying ads asking you to review and rate our game. (We already know its awesome, we don't need you to tell us that.) - Actually having a good time with your friends. (I know it's a bit out there but we think it just might work.) Play with either 2 Controllers, or Single Controller and a Keyboard & Mouse.
row.short_description: This Game is Ground Breaking - aims to bring back the fun of wanting to smash your friend in the head with a controller!

row.name: The Catastrophe
row.detailed_description: Embark on a relaxing, light-hearted space adventure in this 2D spaceflight simulation! In The Catastrophe , you take on the role of a pilot navigating your spaceship through a vibrant, pixel-art cosmos. Your mission is simple but essential — rescue the lost catstronauts scattered across the vast expanse of space and return them safely. Key Features Weight-Based Mechanics : The more catstronauts you have on board, the more weight your ship gains, affecting its maneuverability. Additionally, the amount of fuel you have also contributes to your ship’s mass, further influencing your ability to navigate through tight spaces and avoid obstacles. Obstacles and Hazards : Dodge asteroids, mouse bombs, and other space dangers while staying on course to find all the lost catstronauts. The deeper you venture into space, the more challenging the environment becomes. Charming Pixel Art : Immerse yourself in a visually delightful world where everything—from the fish-shaped spaceships to the feline-themed obstacles — is designed with cute, quirky charm. Relaxing, Casual Gameplay : Enjoy a peaceful experience with no time limits or stressful penalties. Perfect for unwinding while still offering a fun challenge as you manage your ship’s stats.
row.short_description: Set off into space on your personal spaceship and rescue all the lost catstronauts! Navigate through flying obstacles while managing fuel and health. Don’t forget to watch your ship’s weight — it affects your maneuverability. Enjoy a relaxing gameplay experience with pixel art and cozy cosmic vibes!

row.name: Forgetmenots
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the stage of Forgetmenots , a story-driven puzzle adventure where memories linger like echoes in an empty theater. In this beautifully crafted world, the entire game plays out like a theatrical performance, with shifting stage floors revealing new scenes as you progress through a sidescrolling journey of wonder, mystery, and melancholy. With a vibrant, whimsical aesthetic that contrasts its deeper themes, Forgetmenots tells a heartfelt story about loss and the fleeting nature of memories. Solve creative puzzles that bring the stage to life, uncover hidden moments from the past, and navigate a world where joy and sorrow dance together under the spotlight. Game Features 3D side-scrolling theatre Interact with the world in many different ways. Pick up and throw or push large objects in order to restore the memory to its correct state. Physics-based puzzles and interactions create challenging environments. Explore this thrilling stylized theater  Forgetmenots  is a group project made by students. Expect a short yet thought-provoking game.
row.short_description: Step onto the stage in Forgetmenots, a story-driven puzzle adventure where memories take center stage. Explore a theatrical world that unfolds like a live performance, solving puzzles in a whimsical yet bittersweet journey about loss and remembrance.

row.name: Naica Online
row.detailed_description: Save the world of Naica Naica started in the Age of Golcondite, also known as the Genesis age by most denizens, during this time the crystalline form of this world was born, cold and barren. Naica felt alone, and in her loneliness she began to dance to warm herself up, with this dance she has created Light and gave her the name Naide - The Goddess of Order which helped her warm her cold exterior. As the saying goes, there cannot be Light without Darkness, as soon as the first dance finished Icaon - The God of Chaos was born in tandem, helping balance the extreme heat of the light. The Rebisphene Age was the consequence of the constant quarrels between Naide and Icaon, both yearning for the attention of their mother, also known as the age of Discord, which created the First Ones - the first proper inhabitants of Naica. They split their loyalties between Naide and Icaon based off their respective promises which only split the world even further. As the ages passed, and quarrels continued, the First Ones became clustered, the most devoted ones still continued to bicker, but the rest became what we now recognize as Naicalites. Their variety came from adapting to their living environments which shifted throughout the ages, hence why even though they share the same ancestors, most Naicalites look nothing alike. Create and Customize Your Hero Choose from one of four native Naica races, the dexterous Vulpian, the mighty Cerbali, scaly Ophimanders or the sneaky Azralians. Take the path of the Warrior, Ranger or Mage, each with 3 distinct playstyles that you can specialize in. Some of which include the Crusher Warrior, the Assassin Ranger or a Chilling Mage. Express yourself by mixing and matching various talents to create a build that is perfect for you! Take up arms against the invading dark forces of the land and equip yourself with enchanted gear from the Age of Verberyl, a time of re-discovery and exploration, which allowed the Naicalites to flourish after the Age of Discord. Harness the magical power within various armor and weapons, and look great while doing it! Assist Your Fellow Naicalites You will encounter many people throughout your adventures in Naica, each with their own personality and quests for you to help them with. It is up to you to help heal the world through good-faith actions and helping your fellow Naicalites during your Journey. They will help you explore the various zones across the world, and guide you on the path to becoming a powerful ally in their fight against the dark forces that have invaded and corrupted Naica. Overcome the Hardest of Challenges During your adventures, you will encounter powerful enemies, treacherous locations and even remnants of the old world in the form of Dungeons. Gather up your party of at least two allies and clear these Dungeons for great rewards! The runes you obtain can be used to help you progress further than ever before. With each Dungeon level you clear, the enemies will become stronger, increasing their tenacity and amount of pain they inflict, but remember, the deeper you go, the better the rewards will be! [shots of dungeon UI selecting the difficulty] Everything that Naica has to Offer Level 40 Cap 3 unique classes with 9 different playstyles With 12 gear sets tailored to each playstyle obtainable in Dungeons and through spending of Ancient Runes 7 beautiful zones filled to the brim with interesting NPCs, various enemies and bosses to encounter With more than 100 quests to complete 3 dungeons which can be cleared endlessly with increasing levels of difficulty and higher rewards in turn Dungeons scale infinitely (currently up to Level 20) 3 battleground arenas for all PvP enjoyers World PvP as well as PvP exclusive gear that will enhance your combat prowess A transmogrification system that allows you to exchange gear pieces without changing your overall look The Gem shop where you can obtain cosmetics and certain conveniences like faster gathering An alchemical talent tree which allows you to customize the effects of your potions
row.short_description: Naica is a 8bit Fantasy cross-platfrom MMORPG where you take on the role of a lowly adventurer trying to assist those in peril. Fight, collect or explore what the world of Naica has to offer, secrets lie behind every corner. The world needs your help adventurer, will you answer the call?

row.name: Bee careful!
row.detailed_description: In this challenging puzzle game, you will be the guide of a swarm of up to 4 groups of bees. Your goal will be to collect pollen from the flowers and take it safe and sound to the honeycomb, facing different obstacles on the way. Control each group with the number keys and direct their movements with the directional arrows. Plan carefully and coordinate your swarm's movements to avoid dangers and overcome challenges in each level. Will you manage to complete all the levels and help the bees to maintain pollination in the world?
row.short_description: A defiant Bee puzzle where you will have to control different groups of bees by remote control to collect pollen, avoid obstacles and be able to take them to the honeycomb.

row.name: Echo Rift
row.detailed_description: Features: Over a hundred attack patterns to avoid 6 unique stages with 4 minion encounters and 2 boss fights Set high scores with tracked gameplay statistics All original songs Master teleport abilities Comprehensive tutorial Story Beats: Echo always wondered why they felt different, why they always heard a head-thumping tune that no one else seemed to notice. One day, Echo tried to uncover the truth behind this music that was becoming impossible to ignore. Only then did they discover how the elite were hoarding this powerful and vibrant music to themselves in order to keep the masses in an aphonic state of order and obedience. All hope was not lost; there were others like Echo. It was time to rebel! Will you be able to help Echo in their quest to bring Rock to the people? Developer Team: Echo Rift was developed by students from the University of Utah's Division of Games Masters' Program.
row.short_description: Fight enemies to the beat and bring Rock to the people in this epic rhythm game! Echo Rift is a beat-based combat game where players dance on an arena grid in their fight against the audiocratic elite to bring back music to a silenced world.

row.name: THE WELL
row.detailed_description: The nameless main character—a hermit who lives many miles away from the nearest human soul—after a splendid feast, he suddenly realizes that someone has doomed him to death. Any connection with the outside world was cut off by an unknown force: there was no electricity, the car was broken, and someone destroyed a battery-powered landline phone—the last chance to escape. The protagonist is physically unable to escape; he had chosen to live far away from other people, which was his undoing. Slowly starving and going mad, he drinks water from the well in the hope of at least slightly dulling his unbearably growing desire to eat. One day, realizing that the bucket has caught something heavy, he puts all his strength into pulling out… A human corpse. GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW THE WELL is a first-person psychological linear horror game with elements of exploration, hunting, and story progression. Explore the main character’s property and the surrounding forest. After discovering the corpse straight from the well, the protagonist begins to carry out its orders, as if they came from a living person. Day-by-day plot progression. Explore the main character’s property, shrouded in thick fog, as the story progresses. Find notes, books, and other interactive items that tell you what happens. Execute the corpse’s requests. Even though communication is mostly one-sided, you understand what she needs. Hunting. As a player, you will find yourself in the forest thicket teeming with humanoid creatures. You have to kill them with a slow-reloading rifle and finish them off them with a machete. Basic stealth and noise management included. The core gameplay loop consists of exploring locations, reading notes, finding required items, completing simple objectives, and hunting creatures in small forest areas. KEY FEATURES A short psychological horror game (approximately 30 minutes long). It includes the full story experience, several in-game days, multiple locations to explore, notes to discover, and short hunting encounters. A gradual descent into madness. The transformation of the house into a dump, complete moral decay. Each day alters the environment, giving the player new objectives and areas to explore. Exploration and minimalist combat cycle. A slow-reloading rifle for the ranged attacks and a machete. The basic noise system is implemented—NPC will react to the player’s movement and gunfire, making noise an important part of the encounters.
row.short_description: Isolation. Hopelessness. Starvation. By the will of an unknown force, you find yourself isolated from the outside world. Now you are doomed to starve to death. No one will come to your aid. No one will hear your prayers.
row.notes: This game contains violence, depictions of corpses, dismemberment, and acts cannibalism.

row.name: Smoke Break!
row.detailed_description: Smoke Break! is a 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as Applewood, a living puff of smoke, who's hungry for a sweet, charred treat. In this lighthearted adventure, mischief seekers will explore Applewood Factories — a whimsical pie-producing workshop. Cause hilarious hijinks as you delve deeper into this fantastical factory for a deliciously burnt pie! COLLECT SMOKE TO GROW Speedy navigation will burn away Applewood's size. Seek out smoke particles scattered around the factory and absorb them to stay puffed up. CAUSE MISCHIEF Slip through vents, burrow into sacks of flour, and sabotage sweet machinery as you slink your way through pastry-packed corridors.  DON'T GET CAUGHT Beware of the adorably aggressive bakers as they make every effort to keep you out. If that’s not enough, Gumbo the Janitor—a one-man cleanup crew with a turbo-charged vacuum—has zero tolerance for your smoky shenanigans. Stay sneaky, or it’s game over!
row.short_description: Smoke Break! is a lighthearted 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as Applewood — a living puff of smoke. By breaking machinery, dashing past bakers, and using smoke to grow, you can hunt down the ultimate, yet elusive, burnt pie!

row.name: We Bowling?!
row.detailed_description: 'We Bowling?!' is what happens when a bowling ball escapes the alley and goes on a wild adventure! Roll, bounce, and yeet your way through obstacle courses packed with ramps, seesaws, moving platforms, and even minigolf-style chaos. The pins are waiting at the end, but can you get there fast enough to top the leaderboards? Speed, precision, and a little bit of luck will decide if you’re a strike or a total gutterball. So, We Bowling!? Or are you gonna split?
row.short_description: WeBowling?! is built from the ground up for Speedrunners. In this game you take control of a bowling ball of your choosing and make your way through the obstacles as fast as you can! With 10 current tracks and global steam leaderboards, there are plenty of opportunities for you to get that WR!

row.name: Remanence
row.detailed_description: Remanence is a first-person souls-like that rewards players for mastering the sword combat mechanics. In the remains of a world where technology has progressed to the level of seeming magical, players take the role of a survivor of the apocalypse who aims to rise against the robotic cult that has destroyed the world using nanomachines. Armed with only a sword and little remaining nanomachine power, players must master sword combat and seek revenge on the cybernetic overlord. In their path is an army of machines with a variety of attacks. Some war machines are fast and nimble while others are slow but hit hard. It is up to the player to figure out the best approach to dispatch their opponent. A variety of challenging enemies with adaptive and versatile move sets A strange apocalyptic world to venture through Multiple intense boss fights to master and defeat Tight combat featuring rewarding parrying and repose This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A first-person souls-like that rewards players for mastering sword combat mechanics. Rise against the robotic cult that has destroyed the world using nanomachines and seek revenge on the cybernetic overlord.

Unlock new maps through your accomplishments and become the ultimate racer.

row.name: Where Winds Meet
row.detailed_description: Overview About the Game Where Winds Meet is an epic open-world action-adventure RPG rooted in the rich legacy of Wuxia. Set during the turbulent era of tenth-century China, you take on the role of a young sword master, uncovering forgotten truths and the mysteries of your own identity. As the wind stirs across mountains and rivers, so too will your legend rise. An Era on the Brink. A Hero on the Rise Immerse yourself in the captivating Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period of China, where epic battles and legendary tales come to life. From the bustling imperial capital to the hidden wilderness, every path is filled with secrets and adventures. In this world, freedom carries weight. Stir up mischief and face challenges, or take the noble route: befriend villagers, forge alliances, and carve your legacy as a Wuxia hero. In a land of possibilities, become the spark that ignites change! An Open World of Infinite Possibilities Explore a vibrant world filled with life, from bustling cities to hidden temples in lush forests—all dynamically shaped by time, weather, and your choices. Experience Wuxia—style traversal: scale rooftops, glide through the air, or use fast travel to swiftly navigate between regions. Uncover thousands of points of interest across 20+ unique regions. Interact with diverse characters, engage in authentic activities, explore ancient cities, discover forgotten tombs, play flutes beneath swaying willows, and enjoy drinks under lantern-lit skies. Master Your Way of Wuxia Combat Tailor your combat approach-melee, ranged, or stealth. Build a loadout that suits your playstyle. Engage in combat with classic Wuxia weapons—swords, spears, dual blades, rope dart, bows, fans, and umbrellas. Switch weapons and employ martial arts and mystic skills like Tai Chi to outmaneuver enemies. Customize your character, choose your role, align with factions, and explore unique professions to shape your identity. Adventure Alone or Forge Your Community Embark on a narrative-driven adventure filled with rich solo gameplay, or team up with up to four friends for seamless co-op experiences. Join or create a Guild to access group activities—intense guild wars, multiplayer dungeons, and epic raids. Show your skill in competitive duels, or enter a shared, evolving world with thousands of fellow adventurers.
row.short_description: Where Winds Meet is an epic Wuxia open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China at the tenth century. Players will assume the role of a young sword master as they embark on a journey to uncover the mysteries of their own identity. Let the wind carry your legend on an epic journey to the East!

row.name: Online Records: Unknown Seller

At first, everything seems normal, but as she steps inside, an eerie feeling creeps in. What was supposed to be a simple transaction quickly turns into an experience she will never forget. Gameplay Online Records is a first-person narrative experience with exploration and interaction mechanics. Key Features Immersive and gripping story , based on everyday events that take a sinister turn. VHS aesthetics and realistic graphics for a truly atmospheric experience. Real-time messages that add depth to the narrative. Choices and consequences that shape the outcome. Are you ready to face the unknown?

row.name: Cybernoir

Take on a wide variety of missions: eliminate high-value targets, solve brutal crime cases , hunt down criminals, and battle ruthless gangs. A sprawling open world filled with intrigue, corruption, and criminal underworlds awaits. Every alley hides new dangers and opportunities. Make morally challenging choices that shape the story and your relationships with powerful factions. Explore the city on foot or by vehicle, upgrade your gear and abilities, and uncover hidden locations. Engage in dynamic third-person action or strike from the shadows. Cybernoir offers a unique blend of intense combat, nonlinear storytelling, and immersive detective gameplay . Perfect for fans of detective games , story-driven action games , cyberpunk worlds , and open-world sandbox experiences .
row.short_description: Become a nameless detective in a cyberpunk city of the future. Explore an open world, face dynamic action, make moral choices, and uncover a dark, gripping story.
row.notes: Cybernoir is a game set in a dark cyberpunk world that explores themes of crime, moral dilemmas, and corruption. The game features violence, both in melee combat and with firearms. There are also themes related to drugs, addiction, and illegal dealings.

row.name: Running Horror
row.detailed_description: NOTE: This was a practice project made by amateur game devs to learn the process. Please, be kind. You can’t fight the Beast. You can only RUN. Running Horror is a first-person horror game that traps players in a vast, nightmarish labyrinth with a relentless, otherworldly pursuer. You’ve been caught in the aftermath of a miscast spell, and the only hope for escape lies in finding the scattered survivors who were drawn into the maze with you. Each of these motley characters holds a piece of the puzzle, and only by working through fear, disorientation, and dread can you piece together what went wrong and undo it. There are no weapons. No safe rooms. The only thing keeping you alive is your ability to move quickly and stay calm under pressure. The further you go, the closer the Beast gets, forcing you to balance exploration and urgency. Will you make it out before your sanity breaks... or the creature finds you?
row.short_description: A first-person horror game where you must explore a vast labyrinth, evade a relentless demonic Beast, and find trapped survivors to reverse a miscast spell and escape.
row.notes: Running Horror contains intense horror elements, including depictions of psychological terror, sustained pursuit by a monstrous creature, and fear-based tension. The game includes disturbing imagery, character death, and themes of mental strain and desperation. While there is no sexual content, drug use, or graphic gore, the atmosphere is designed to provoke a sense of dread, anxiety, and helplessness, which may be distressing to some players.

row.name: Path of Light

Unlock Abilities As Lumi progresses upwards through the Forgotten Chapel, he unlocks a total of four unique abilities to aid in his escape. row.short_description: Path of Light is a stealth adventure game following the journey of Lumi, a little robot seeking to reclaim his town's stolen light. Escape enemies, solve puzzles, and navigate obstacles to ascend the Forgotten Chapel.

row.name: Tiny Sheriff
row.detailed_description: Tiny Sheriff is a 2D movement platformer where you use weapons as a means of transportation. Master your movement capabilities to take on increasingly daring challenges. Your guns are more than just weapons—they’re your way of getting around! The knock-back from each shot propels you through the air, letting you dash, double-jump, and wall-bounce your way through treacherous terrain. But be careful—taking down enemies can throw you backwards, sending you hurtling into danger! These showdowns are fast, chaotic, and unforgiving. Dodge incoming attacks, keep your momentum, and find the right moment to strike. Stay sharp, stay quick—hesitate, and you’re done for. Cacti aren’t just scenery—they’re out to mess with you. Get too close, and you’ll be eating spikes. Step wrong, and you’ll quickly find yourself in a thorny mess.
row.short_description: Tiny Sheriff is a 2D movement platformer where you use weapons as a means of transportation. Master your movement capabilities to take on increasingly daring challenges.

row.name: AI T/F Escape: 10 in a Row to Freedom
row.detailed_description: When you wake up, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious room. It appears that to escape, you must answer a series of True/False questions correctly. row.name: The Untitled Tower
row.detailed_description: [Game overview] ``The Untitled Tower'' is an action game in which the main character struggles to save a princess who is imprisoned at the top of a tower by a demon. The protagonist meets unique residents, defeats the bosses that control them, and climbs a nameless tower controlled by a demon. Then the scenario takes an unexpected turn. Highly challenging action game. Various enemies, devices, and bullet hells block the hero's adventure. Part of the barrage can be erased with attacks, and there is an invincible rolling dodge, so you can easily escape attacks and traps that seem impossible to avoid at first glance. Furthermore, each weapon has its own secret tricks (special moves), so by using them, the path will open up automatically. Bosses with unique personalities. More than 90 bosses await you at the end of your adventure. A strange human, a giant caterpillar, a flying tank, and a genie. A variety of gimmicks, such as gravity reversal, action bans, and the sudden start of RPG and block breaking games, also add color to the overwhelmingly voluminous story. Full of many detour elements! In addition to the main story, ``The Nameless Tower'' includes 5 mini-games, sound collection, time attack, hidden bosses, and weapon enhancements. In addition to progressing through the main story, you can also enjoy a change of scenery and test your skills. [remarks] All work was done by a single developer and it took nine years to complete. Play time is approximately 45 ~ 80 hours until the ending. If you are good at action games, we expect you to clear the game in about 24 hours. Graphics, sounds, programs, scenarios, etc. are all made by myself.

LiveTale: Sandbox Game for Immersive Group Roleplay
row.detailed_description: LiveTale is a novel game project aiming to bring true collaborative storytelling online. Step into a world that you and your party build as you play. In LiveTale, there’s no GM; just a sandbox of tools to craft characters, weave their relationships, and spark wild events in real time. We’re in alpha now, and with your support, we can unlock exciting new milestones and complete this project together. The modular avatar and costume system lets you design one-of-a-kind heroes who stand out on any adventure. Bring your character to life with built in webcam motion capture and facial tracking on your standard webcam. Raise eyebrows, strike poses, and deliver that perfect dramatic flair. Real-time voice modulation can help both PCs and NPCs speak in-character so you can sound like the brooding rogue or mischievous elf or flirty mama orc. Build your world with a library full of props, items, buildings, and environments. Each element in your Tale has with unique properties and actions that can be accessed through the game's realtime scripting system. The World Builder mode can be accessed at any time by players to help the stage before your adventure begins, or shape the world on the fly with your party. Whether planning ahead or creating in the moment, world-building is all part of the fun! Characters naturally spark tensions based on their personalities and charisma. Turn those sparks into one-way or mutual connections - whether as rivals, mentors, or lovers. Use escalating relational consent to offer both natural progression and insure player safety according to what your friend group is okay with. These relationships influence conflicts, emotions, and even trigger new events, making every connection part of the unfolding adventure. Create dynamic adventures with fully customizable event cards that shape the story in real-time. Event cards trigger encounters, quests, and twists based on player actions and choices. Scripting with cards can access all the functionality of World Builder, character action animations, add new mechanics, and optionally leverage the Regards system for consent-driven card play. With this modular system, every adventure unfolds dynamically, adapting to the unexpected!
row.short_description: Step into a world that you and your party build as you play. In LiveTale, there’s no GM; just a sandbox of tools to craft characters, weave their relationships, and spark wild events in real time. Will your next session end in triumph… or glorious chaos? Yeah, probably chaos.

row.name: Neuro Nightmare
row.detailed_description: Make sure to read the Game Setting Manual! You need NeuroSky's Mindwabe Mobile 2 to play the game. Neuro Nightmare is an innovative game that utilizes brain-computer interface (BCI) technology to maximize the immersion of horror games. Players must run away from the unknown in a closed boarding school, operating all the levers to find a way out. But it's not just a survival game—your brain activity directly affects gameplay. The game adjusts the gaming environment by analyzing the player's concentration and stability in real time through BCI technology. The higher the concentration, the wider the field of view, and if you maintain stability, you can use the special ability to hide from monsters. This unique mechanism provides a sense of immersion that sets you apart from conventional horror games. It also includes a typical play mode that doesn't support BCI, and you can enjoy a different gaming experience while comparing the two modes.
row.short_description: Neuro Nightmare is a horror game that utilizes brain-computer interface technology to maximize immersion. Run all the levers and escape from boarding schools, running away from monsters. Your concentration and stability directly affect gameplay.
