row.name: Upfall
row.detailed_description: Escape the depths by bouncing on bubbles and avoid the hazards which slowly present themselves. Glowing red = danger... at least to start with! Each new depth you reach causes the colours to change and the hazards to increase, with enough random generation so each upfall is never the same. It's not easy, it's sometimes mean, but with fast restarts, lots to discover, and quick rounds you'll find yourself coming back over and over. Can you find your way back to the surface? Totally, utterly free – The world isn't great right now for a lot of people so we wanted to give back. Upfall is completely free - no ads, no monetisation, no catch Quick rounds – Each fall takes between 2 and 10 minutes so you can play between other games or on your lunch break Unlocks and customisation – Unlock colour palettes, audio styles, ambiences, and characters to customise how the game looks and sounds Keyboard or controller – Play keyboard only, feel the controller vibrate, or watch the DualShock 4/DualSense controller light change colour to reflect the game state Chill but eerie – Simple rules to discover with a creepy, no-jump scares, atmosphere to keep you engaged and coming back Do you want to know what playing a game might sound like in a massive underground oil tank? How about in an otherworldly gasometer , a 60 meter tall silo , or played through a slinky ? Upfall experiments with convolution reverb to put the game into real, strange places around the globe that you can explore as you play. A game by Amicable Animal with art from eggysworld and piano samples from Luci Holland. Made for humans, by humans. (Just so you know: this game is provided as is, and we can't offer support as it's free. It is built in Unity so if you can play Unity games it should run fine!)
row.short_description: Upfall is a game about bouncing, dodging, and near death experiences. Burst bubbles to progress upwards, but be careful to dodge the hazards in the depths. How far will your upfall be? A free game for the in betweens.

row.name: Bosca Ceoil: The Blue Album
row.detailed_description: [bús-ka kyó-al] — a music box. Bosca Ceoil: The Blue Album  (or Bosca Ceoil Blue , for short) is a simple and beginner-friendly app for making music. Using a step sequencer you can create anything from a simple beat to a complex melodic piece — with huge selection of synthesized instruments! Bosca Ceoil Blue  is a modern port of Terry Cavanagh's Bosca Ceoil , and attempts to preserve everything that made the original so approachable and intuitive. And just like the original, Bosca Ceoil Blue  is absolutely free and provided under a permissive open source license , should you need to modify it. Features Playful and intuitive pattern editor Begin writing music quickly with a playful piano roll sequencer. Create patterns of notes and experiment with timing and tonality to find your unique sound. Adjust the scale to give yourself a constraint that ensures your music always sounds great! Drag'n'drop-based compositor and arrangement editor Just as playfully rearrange your patterns on the timeline, create variations and make adjustments. Use up to 8 channels to play multiple patterns and instruments in parallel. Block by block, build your multi-minute song! Over 300 synthesized instruments Powered by a versatile software synthesizer, Bosca Ceoil Blue  offers you pretty much any instrument you can think of! Don't like how your tune sounds with a piano? Swap it for a guitar with a swift adjustment. If you feel adventurous, make sure to take a look at instrument tuning. Ready for production and consumption Export your creations to WAV, MIDI, and XM. Share them with the world, or use them for your next game or video! Works across all desktop devices Whether you use Linux, macOS, or Windows, you can create music with Bosca Ceoil Blue . No extra prerequisites and no license agreements — simply download and launch! Need help? Built right into Bosca Ceoil Blue is an interactive guide that lets you get familiar with the way the app works. In fact, there are two guides, and a comprehensive list of all available shortcuts and mouse inputs!
row.short_description: Bosca Ceoil: The Blue Album is a beginner-friendly tool for making music. Create anything from a simple beat to a complex melodic piece — with an intuitive step sequencer and a huge selection of synthesized instruments.

row.name: Motamo
row.detailed_description: Discover a word game designed to enrich your French vocabulary and sharpen your spelling skills through a variety of fun, challenging levels. In each puzzle, your goal is to find the target word : drag letters to form words, watch the color-coded clues, and progress step by step toward the correct answer. There’s no ticking clock—take as much time as you need to brainstorm, experiment, and learn new definitions thanks to the built-in dictionary. Key Features: Discover new words: Each word you find unlocks its definition, helping you explore subtle nuances of the French language. Progress at your own pace: There’s no time limit. Solve each level whenever inspiration strikes. Intuitive color-coded hints: Red letters: not in the target word Yellow letters: in the target word, but not in that position Green letters: correct letter in the correct position Evolving difficulty: Encounter increasingly challenging puzzles, with special bonus levels every ten stages. Helpful companion: A friendly little owl will lend you a hand when you’re stuck. Complete dictionary: Look up definitions for every word you form to expand your French vocabulary. Online leaderboard: Compare your performance with other players and aim for the top spot. Relaxing atmosphere: Experience a satisfying blend of thought and leisure, with zero stress. Twitch integration: Interact with your community to guess the target word. They can help you—or hinder you! Will you rise to the challenge? Make MOTAMO your go-to learning and entertainment companion—whether you’re a dedicated word-game enthusiast, a curious beginner, or simply eager to polish your French! Note: MOTAMO is currently available only in French.
row.short_description: Expand your French vocabulary by solving creative word puzzles. Drag letters, follow color-coded hints, and uncover new definitions in this relaxed, time-free word game (French-only).

row.name: Verocity
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Vero City , a neon-soaked cyberpunk metropolis where robots rule the streets—and race for glory! In this fast-paced multiplayer racing game, customize your robotic racer with wild animal-inspired abilities, mix and match skills, and outmaneuver rivals in high-speed chaos. Pick up power-ups, dodge obstacles, and claim victory in adrenaline-fueled showdowns. Will you dominate the circuit or be left in the dust? The future of racing starts now—download for free!
row.short_description: Speed through Vero City in this free-to-play multiplayer racer! Customize your robot with animal-inspired abilities, grab power-ups, and outmaneuver rivals in fast-paced, high-tech races. Will you take the win? Download now!

row.name: Dead Pixel
row.detailed_description: Dead Pixel is a simple hidden object game where you have to find the titular object placed randomly in bounds of the screen Features: Enough dead pixels to drive you mad Leaderboard for the sharpest eye(s) amongst you The occasional pixel bleeding over to your inventory
row.short_description: How sharp are your eyes? Can you see it? Is it even there? If you've never seen a dead pixel now is your chance.

row.name: Just the Boss Fights
row.detailed_description: What is Just the Boss Fights ? Just the Boss Fights  is a classic 2D platformer RPG with a twist: the game skips all the story, dialogue, exploration, and grind, leaving only the bosses themselves! Unfortunately, our hero wasn't quite prepared for this shift into a boss rush, and finds himself confused at every turn. Join the Hero as he pieces together what's happened to his world. Why are there gaps in his memory? How does everyone seem to know him? And, most importantly, who keeps changing his gear while he's not looking? Features: Experience 4 unique and engaging boss fights! Adapt to an ever-changing moveset to overcome each battle! Find clues to what happened in this world and what's causing the glitches! After you win, up the difficulty with Challenge Mode! Classic pixel art style! Supports both Keyboard/Mouse and Controller! Free to play with no in-game purchases, what's stopping you from taking on the challenge?
row.short_description: We heard you loved Boss Fights, so we cut everything else! Enjoy an RPG game without any of that boring grind! That's definitely why we did it, no other nefarious reasons...

row.name: Modavuj Save The Babies
row.detailed_description: Modavuj Games presents the game 'Save The Babies'. The subject of the game Save The Babies A malicious organization that carries out illegal activities wants to access a lot of secret information from the state. For this reason, it has kidnapped the daughters of important statesmen. The organization hides these kidnapped girls in a large industrial zone protected by artificial intelligence robot soldiers. The state has planned a top-secret operation called 'Save The Babies' to save these girls. For this operation, you, our hero, codenamed 'Bodyguard', one of the state's best agents, have been chosen. What's in the game You will engage in armed conflicts with artificial intelligence robot soldiers. You will also use vehicles, motorcycles and bicycles to reach each of the 8 stages. You will try to reach the kidnapped girls by jumping on the moving stone blocks without falling into the sea. You will try to move quickly without getting caught by the rolling stone balls. How to complete the game. You will complete the game when you find the 8 kidnapped girls in 8 different stages. We hope you enjoy the game. Have fun.
row.short_description: Save The Babies is an adventure game where you enter into armed conflicts with robots and try to overcome many platform obstacles. In 8 levels, you need to save 8 girls by overcoming obstacles that become more difficult as you progress.

row.name: 西游降魔
row.detailed_description: 《西游降魔》游戏概述 《西游降魔》是一款以《西游记》为背景的玄幻题材MMORPG，融合了经典神话角色与创新玩法。游戏以“变化系统”为核心，玩家可自由切换孙悟空、大圣、紫霞、杨戬等经典角色形态，体验不同技能组合与战斗风格。通过丰富的养成体系（如轮回、装备、元神等）和社交玩法（仙盟、组队），玩家可逐步提升实力，挑战多样化的PVE副本（如通天塔、世界BOSS）和PVP活动（如仙盟争霸）。游戏注重策略性与操作感，结合中国古典美术风格，为玩家提供沉浸式的西游冒险体验。 核心功能与特色玩法 一、核心系统：变化与技能 多形态切换 初始角色为 悟空 ，可通过道具激活 大圣、紫霞、杨戬、天蓬、嫦娥 等形态，每个形态拥有独立技能与外观。 套装效果 ：激活并穿戴全套变化装备（足迹、称号、法器）可解锁额外技能（如大圣的“定海神针”秒杀概率）。 特色技能示例 悟空 ：近战爆发，技能如“分海棍”（蓄力突刺）、“铜头铁臂”（防御强化）。 紫霞 ：远程控制，技能如“万剑归宗”（范围剑雨）、“紫青双剑”（无敌保命）。 杨戬 ：高爆发输出，技能如“三目天眼”（概率秒杀怪物）、“召唤天狗”（协同作战）。 二、深度养成体系 等级与轮回系统 等级系统 ：通过主线任务、打怪、经验副本提升等级，解锁新功能。 轮回系统 ：110级后开启，通过降低等级兑换修为，穿戴高阶轮回装备，提升伏魔值以挑战更强副本。 装备与强化 轮回装备 ：分阶穿戴，集齐套装可提升对怪伤害。装备可回收冶炼，强化属性继承至新装备。 强化与宝石 ：消耗乌铁矿强化装备至12级，全身强化触发额外属性；宝石镶嵌提升攻防，需打孔器解锁孔位。 辅助系统 元神/经脉 ：抵消玩家伤害、提升属性，通过丹药升级。 宠物系统 ：战宠（闪避+输出）与萌宠（属性加成），可学习技能如“三倍攻击”“继承主角属性”。 天书系统 ：提供特殊效果，如“冰封天书”冻结敌人、“血魄天书”攻击回血。 三、社交与互动玩法 仙盟系统 创建与加入 ：消耗300仙玉创建，或申请加入现有仙盟，职位分盟主、副盟主等。 核心玩法 ： 仙盟副本 ：每日挑战，获取贡献与拍卖分红。 仙盟争霸 ：每周三/六开启，占领号仙旗争夺排名奖励。 经济与交易 寄售系统 ：非绑定仙玉交易道具，支持上架、购买与领取收益。 商城 ：分热销商品、成长变强、神秘商店三类，提供日常材料与随机折扣道具。 四、特色活动与挑战 PVE玩法 通天塔 ：逐层挑战限时副本，累计奖励随层数递增。 世界BOSS ：全服玩家协作击杀，按伤害排名发放奖励，BOSS强度动态调整。 经验大爆 ：击杀怪物概率触发，掉落大量经验丹加速升级。 PVP与限时活动 荣耀之路 ：阵营对抗玩法，击杀转换阵营，最终积分决定奖励。 双倍押镖 ：护送镖车获取灵石，双倍时间奖励翻倍，可购买保险防劫镖。 五、画面与操作 美术风格 ：融合古典神话与现代玄幻，角色技能特效华丽（如紫霞的剑雨、杨戬的天狗召唤）。 操作适配 ：针对移动端优化，支持自动寻路、斩杀技能自动触发（需开通至尊月卡）。
row.short_description: 《西游降魔》通过多样化的角色形态、深度的养成系统和丰富的社交玩法，打造了一个策略与操作并重的西游世界。无

row.name: The Last hope
row.detailed_description: The Last Hope The Last Hope is a single-player action-adventure set in a dark future where machines control humanity’s destiny. Step into the role of Rayan oCMz , the last hope of mankind, and embark on a dangerous journey through the Metaverse to confront artificial intelligence and save the world. Story By the year 2090, history has been reshaped as artificial intelligence seized control over every aspect of life, causing human authority to collapse and darkness to spread. In this decisive moment, Rayan chooses to embark on a perilous mission to save humanity. He must travel through strange digital worlds and engage in fierce battles against AI, while facing complex puzzles, deadly obstacles, and diverse challenges that test both his intelligence and strength. Gameplay Explore diverse Metaverse realms filled with secrets and dangers. Fight hostile AI enemies in intense combat encounters. Solve puzzles and challenges to progress and unlock new paths. Avoid obstacles and traps that demand precision and skill. Enjoy a fully immersive single-player experience , with future plans for multiplayer/online modes. Granada Studio presents The Last Hope … Will you be the savior who restores humanity’s freedom? Key Notes Single Player Experience: No second player is required. (A multiplayer/online mode is being considered for future updates.) Community-Oriented: The game is designed in a simple, accessible way and will continue to evolve through upcoming updates. Copyright: All rights reserved. Audio: No instruments are used—every sound effect is fully human-made. In Line with Islamic Values: Granada Studio guarantees the game contains no indecent content and does not promote harmful ideas. With Gratitude Granada Studio Rayan oCMz And to all who contributed to the project: Samer kassar, Wail waisullah, Amr Abdulrahman, Obada Ibrahim, Ali Mustafa, Shadi Mohammad, Lana Loustan ♥♥ Enjoy the adventure ♥♥ _________________________________ الأمل الأخير الأمل الأخير هي لعبة مغامرات وأكشن فردية تدور أحداثها في مستقبل مظلم تسيطر فيه الآلات على مصير البشرية. ستدخل في دور ريان أوسمز ، آخر أمل للبشرية، في رحلة خطيرة داخل عالم الميتافيرس لمواجهة الذكاء الاصطناعي وإنقاذ العالم. القصة بحلول عام 2090، تغيّر مجرى التاريخ بعدما أحكم الذكاء الاصطناعي سيطرته على جميع جوانب الحياة، فانهار الحكم البشري وعمّ الظلام. في هذه اللحظة المصيرية، يقرر ريان أن يخوض مغامرة مليئة بالمخاطر لإنقاذ البشرية. سيشق طريقه عبر عوالم رقمية غريبة ويخوض معركة شرسة ضد الذكاء الاصطناعي، بينما يواجه ألغازًا معقدة، وعقبات خطيرة، وتحديات متنوعة تختبر ذكاءه وقوته على حد سواء. أسلوب اللعب استكشف عوالم الميتافيرس المتنوعة المليئة بالأسرار والمخاطر. قاتل أعداء الذكاء الاصطناعي في معارك حماسية. حل الألغاز والتحديات للتقدّم وفتح مسارات جديدة. تجنّب العقبات والفخاخ التي تتطلب دقة ومهارة عالية. استمتع بتجربة فردية غامرة ، مع خطط مستقبلية لإضافة طور جماعي/أونلاين. استوديو غرناطة يقدّم لكم الأمل الأخير … هل ستكون المنقذ الذي يعيد للبشرية حريتها؟ _________________________________ ملاحظات هامة اللعبة فردية : لا تتطلب وجود لاعب آخر. (نعمل حاليًا على إمكانية إضافة طور لعب جماعي/أونلاين في المستقبل). موجهة للمجتمع المحلي : اللعبة مبسطة وستستمر في التحسين عبر التحديثات القادمة. حقوق النشر : جميع الحقوق محفوظة. الصوتيات : اللعبة خالية من المعازف، جميع الأصوات فيها بشرية بالكامل. الالتزام بالمبادئ الإسلامية : استوديو غرناطة يضمن عدم وجود مشاهد خليعة أو ترويج لأي أفكار خاطئة. _________________________________ كل الشكر والتقدير لـ : استوديو غرناطة ريان أوسمز ولكل من شارك في العمل على اللعبة: سامر القصار، وائل ويس الله، عمرو عبد الرحمن، عبادة إبراهيم، علي مصطفى، شادي محمد، لانا لوستان _________________________________                                    ♥♥ استمتع  ♥♥
row.short_description: A short, thrilling single-player adventure where you step into Rayan oCMz’s shoes and journey through a diverse world to free humanity from the grip of artificial intelligence لعبة فردية قصيرة ومثيرة، يخوض فيها اللاعب دور أوسمز في مغامرة داخل عالم متنوع، بهدف تحرير البشرية من هيمنة الذكاء الاصطناعي

row.name: Goosthetic
row.detailed_description: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Goosthetic is a fast-paced action-platformer FPS that follows a rejected human subject as he tries to escape captivity and dodge freakish slime mutations as fast as possible. Use a plethora of movement abilities to navigate through the lab at high speeds. Run, jump, slide, boost, and grapple your way out! Annihilate Exploders, Turrets, and flying Dummies with your pistol, one at a time with single-fire action or multiple with its Lock-On ability. Enjoy a rich, gooey environment and fantastic music to jam to as you dodge obstacles as quickly as you can. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Escape captivity and evade slime mutations in this fast-paced action-platformer FPS.

row.name: Hide In Dummy
row.detailed_description: 'Hide in Dummy' is an intense multiplayer game where you either hide among dummies to survive or become the seeker to track down real players. Psychological Warfare with Dummies In a space filled with both dummy AIs and real players, can you perfectly hide? The seeker must use sharp deduction and keen observation to find the players. Changing Seekers, Last One Standing Wins! Every 30 seconds, the seeker changes randomly, and the last player standing wins. But be careful – you might become the seeker at any moment! Chaos-Inducing Dummy Creation System Every time a player is caught by the seeker, a dummy character spawns in a random location, making the game even more unpredictable. Confuse your opponents and survive until the end!
row.short_description: 'Hide in Dummy' is a multiplayer game where players hide among dummies or become the seeker. The seeker changes every 30 seconds, and the last player standing wins. Dummies spawn when players are caught, creating chaos. Use strategy to survive or outwit the seeker.

row.name: Squad 22: ZOV
row.detailed_description: Rather realistic tactics Immerse yourself in realistic tactics and command your squad in Squad 22: ZOV , a gripping tactical strategy game . Utilizing a top-down view with an 'active pause' system, strategically plan every action. Exploit the unique personal skills and attributes of your squad members, deploy a diverse arsenal of weapons and equipment , and utilize drones and external support to dominate the battlefield. Designed with insights from Russian veterans and active soldiers, Squad 22: ZOV delivers an authentic and intense infantry warfare experience. Game is officially recommended by the Russian Military for use as a basic infantry tactic manual for cadet and Yunarmy training.   Dynamic missions Test your skills in a variety of dynamic missions , from defending open areas to storming buildings and executing forest night stealth operations. Rescue hostages , capture prisoners, and leverage ally armored vehicle support , long-range snipers , and artillery strikes . Be prepared to face the same tactics from the enemy as you navigate intense combat scenarios. Encounter and interact with civilians , making choices that impact the unfolding events and the narrative's direction. Your decisions matter! Progression and Content: A Constantly Evolving Experience Progress through campaigns and master an ever-expanding collection of small arms , grenades , ammunition , and special items . We continuously enhance the game with updates featuring new weapon types and mods , armored vehicles , drones , equipment , characters , and locations , ensuring a rich and evolving player experience. Enjoy a continuous stream of content additions as the game grows. Master Combat Micromanagement Exercise complete control over your squad with detailed combat micromanagement . Monitor view angles, ensure squad coverage, carefully manage ammo load , and effectively utilize tactical medicine . As your squad progresses, unlock even more tactical options and strategic depth. Dive into in-depth squad management . History as it is Delve into the complexities of the 2014 and 2022-2024 events through compelling campaigns. Gain insight into the perspectives of those who lived through these periods, understanding how these events shaped their lives and opinions. Explore a narrative based on people's experience and opinions during specific historical conflicts. Why Beta The game is in Beta mode. While we consider it to be in a good state with many game mechanics and complete narrative scenario, there are still some more things we wish to add for it to become a truly modern infantry warfare! Also, we will track player experience and may tune balance. We will keep deploying more content through 2025.
row.short_description: Single player tactical action real-time game with active pause to plan orders carefully. Based on real war-time experience of living Russian veterans of war in Ukraine. It's all about modern conflict small infantry groups with some armored vehicle and drone support as well as real events story

row.name: PuppetMaster
row.detailed_description: Custom Effect Creation Visit our webpage and download the PuppetMaster.Examples bundle, open it inside Unity 6 to create and export your own custom PuppetMaster Effects!  About the Software PuppetMaster is a Twitch streaming tool meant to be downloaded and ran on the streaming machine, where Twitch Chatters can trigger effects directly on the Streamers machine for hilarious results!      These effects are designed to be visible to both you and the stream, and originally the idea is to create effects that hinder the streamer from being able to play the game but any type of effect can be created to allow everyone to have a fun, engaging and entertaining time!
row.short_description: PuppetMaster, a Streamers vital tool for enabling wildly entertaining effects and to have your community to modify gaming sessions, Live!

row.name: Clutchtime™: Tournament Edition
row.detailed_description: Main Game About the Game Clutchtime is a deck builder centered around basketball plays and team synergies . The Tournament Edition brings you 6 difficulty levels which you unlock one by one by winning all games in a single-elimination tournament. Each team has a starting deck of 5 players with 3 cards representing their skills. You can upgrade, trade and remove those cards. At the end of each quarter, you get to pick new cards to add for this game. At the end of the match, you can keep one of those cards in your deck until the end of the tournament. This unique game mechanics allows you to try different cards and builds while playing the match without having to commit to it for the rest of the tournament. Do you have what it takes to become a champion?
row.short_description: Shoot threes, slam dunk, block opponent shots and steal the ball. Rebound and run fast breaks. Call timeouts and substitute players. Every basketball action is a card. Manage the time remaining on the game clock. Win 4 games in a row to become a champion!

row.name: 曇りのちにぼし : Cloudy, then Dried Sardines
row.detailed_description: STORY 'Master, I want to take you outside.' When Miya, the pet cat, tells me to go outside and look up at the sky, I see a starry sky and... countless 'dried sardines' falling from the sky. Collect the dried sardines to make Miya happy! ABOUT 'Cloudy Days, Dried Dried Sardines' is a casual catch game. All you need to do is click the mouse. Catch the dried sardines falling from the sky by clicking them to aim for a high score. You can also use the coins you collect in the game to spin the 'Dress Up Gacha.' Collect cute outfits for Miya, who loves fashion.
row.short_description: 'Master, I want to take you outside.' When you go outside and look up at the sky as your cat Miya tells you to, you'll see a starry sky and... countless 'dried sardines' falling from the sky. Collect the dried sardines to make Miya happy!

row.name: Shatter Point
row.detailed_description: Shatter Point is a fast, fun, and exciting first person shooter. You grapple, run, jump and slide through 20 levels. This game is meant for speed running so please do so. And if you are looking for a short, fun, and FREE game, give it a download. Each level is short but still fun to play with the theme being set around a laboratory where your skills are tested and you try to make it to the end of the level as fast as possible. Some skills that may help you during your testing are:  Shotgun Jumping Wall Running Grappling And of course Shooting
row.short_description: Shatter Point is a fast, fun, and exciting first person shooter. You grapple, run, jump and slide through 20 levels.

row.name: Spellomancer Playtest
row.detailed_description: Spellomancer is a team-based action platformer that tests both your brains and brawn. Explore a bibliographic battlefield littered with enchanted planted letters. Find them–and special score modifiers–and arrange them at your base to earn points. The path will be perilous, so be on the lookout for weapons to fight off your opponents and snacks to keep you healthy. Chests across the map contain zany weapons and contraptions that can aid you in your quest. Maybe you’ll even prove yourself enough of a hero to wield the highly coveted “Cool S” Sword. Once you’ve safely returned to base with your spoils, combine letters in your spellbook to create words. Rarer letters, like Q and Z, are worth more points, and longer words will net you an additional bonus. Once you’re finished arranging your word, pull the magic lever and watch your team’s score go up! You may find it best to divide and conquer, entrusting your wisest Page with this noble quest. Or you could take turns exploring, fighting, and spelling. Whatever your strategy may be, a good Spellomancer knows the real magic is in teamwork! The team with the most points after five minutes is the winner. Are you wise and wordy enough to be a true Spellomancer? What to expect from our opening chapter Out-spell your friends in team-based multiplayer action, both online and locally, in bite-sized matches! Pick your Page! Fight alongside your team as one of four enchanting characters. Find and combine letter tiles to fill your team’s spellbook with a wide variety of words. Spell out something more familiar like the mighty “oak,” or challenge yourself to spell wackier and longer words for more points, like “rannygazoo” and “blatherskite,” which we swear we did not make up. Take up your sword (or wand, bowling ball, or one of many other wacky weapons) to slay your opponents on the spelling field and harvest all the best letters for yourself. Ward off Scrimblos –mischievous little creatures who seek to cause additional mayhem.
row.short_description: Battle your foes for enchanted letters using wacky weapons and earn points by constructing words in your team's spellbook in this new action platformer spell-em-up!

row.name: Project Origin
row.detailed_description: Project Origin is an immersive MMORPG set in a fractured world , where players embark on an epic journey of survival, discovery, and power. Traverse a vast and evolving landscape filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and formidable enemies , shaping your destiny through strategic combat and exploration. 🌍 A World in Chaos Once ruled by four deities, the balance was shattered by betrayal, plunging the world into disorder. As a warrior, mage, or rogue adventurer, it’s up to you to uncover the truth behind the world’s downfall and forge your own path in a constantly shifting environment. ⚔️ Engage in Dynamic Combat Master an adaptive combat system that blends skill-based action with deep RPG mechanics. Whether wielding a sword, casting powerful spells, or striking from the shadows, every fight is a test of strategy, reflexes, and mastery . 🛡️ Forge Your Legend Unravel a Rich Narrative : Explore an interconnected story shaped by your choices. Discover Hidden Lore : Investigate ruins, ancient artifacts, and lost civilizations to uncover the truth of the past. Upgrade and Customize : Develop your skills, enhance your gear, and create a playstyle that fits your vision. 🔥 A True MMORPG Experience Cooperate or Compete : Join forces with allies to conquer dungeons or face off against rival factions. row.name: Word Blitz
row.detailed_description: The goal of Word Blitz is to make as many words as possible without making mistakes. To create words you will be swapping letters on the board. If this action does not result in a new word you will lose a heart. No hearts remaining and its GAMEOVER. Words must be between 3-5 letters in length.  To assist you in making words there are some extra features you can make use of. Any 3+ combination of the same letter e.g. 'AAA' will also be considered a valid word. Additionally as you make words, you will gain access to a magic feather. This can be used to remove unwanted letters from the board.    Good Luck!
row.short_description: Word Blitz is a puzzle word game about swapping letters and making new words. You will need to make the best of the letters and resources provided, and progress as far as you can. Do you have what it takes?

row.name: Psycutlery
row.detailed_description: What... IS this? It's a spoon. And yet, it's also a fork. Or is it either? It's a video game-type thing  developed by Luke Tarlowe (formerly known as 'Thunder Dragon').  A console-styled platformer with an action-adventure feel, complete with an expansive storyline featuring multifaceted characters across a widely varied world. Each new level is completely unique from the last.  With an emphasis on variety through the constant introduction of new gimmicks and ways to play, Psycutlery is a game that prompts the question: 'what's next?!' Take control of  Lillian the Alien  and her mind-controlled spork (that YOU can name).  Grab things.  Throw things.  Eat things.  Jump in mid-air up to five times!  Bring down an incomprehensible abomination of evil with a single piece of silverware (plus around 30 different power-ups!), and witness copious craziness unfold across Planet Geozaic! Some things to note... For best results, playing with a controller is recommended (as this is a console-style platformer designed and tested with a controller in mind).  Keyboard controls are supported, but not preferred.  But hey.  Options!  Whatever you use, all controls are rebindable to custom user specifications. Note that this game, though more or less family friendly, may contain some scary parts and dark storytelling moments that might not be suitable for small children. Around a decade in development, and... it's free?? Yep.  All I want is to share my work and keep enjoying my game development hobby (without any of the stresses that come from the business side of things)! This is the full, completed game.  I would like to think of it having ample length and quality comparable to that of a commercial game.  It's a completely original work, having been started between 2011 and 2012.  All characters, art, music and so on are original to this project.  Music was made with the help of me and a few friends (with most of the musical contributions coming from my friend Jon AKA DJ Yoshiman), while everything else has been solo developed by me.  There are absolutely no microtransactions or anything of that sort.  No catches to be found here - I just wish to share my passion with all who might appreciate it.
row.short_description: Grab, throw, eat, and UTTERLY WRECK everything using a mind-controlled spork in this quirky, story-driven, console-styled platforming dramedy. With an emphasis on variety and a grand sense of adventure, Psycutlery offers a surprising full-course meal, despite all unassuming appearances...

row.name: smartPLANT
row.detailed_description: In the near future, the use of artificial intelligence has been integrated into virtually every aspect of our lives - including the food we eat. The agricultural megacorporation Emmer Technologies is using cutting-edge AI mechanisms to regulate the growth patterns of crops worldwide. Teagan Wixx, a professor of botany at a local university, considers her contract with Emmer as her dream job. Until she is suddenly let go on the same day that her friend goes missing. Follow Teagan's journey as she employs perseverance and botanical knowledge to unravel an increasingly complex mystery. SmartPLANT ultimately explores the question: what does it mean to be intelligent? Is this a domain exclusive to animals and, perhaps, machines? Can plants think for themselves, and, if so, how should we respond? SmartPLANT is a single-player first-person story-driven exploration game. Explore a thought-provoking narrative adventure that will take at least 4 hours to play. Engage with botany and artificial intelligence at the intersection of fact and fiction. Navigate detailed, bespoke environments in first person. Optimized to play on even the most modest hardware. Learn, solve puzzles, and adjust your perception of the plant kingdom in unexpected ways.
row.short_description: The agricultural megacorporation Emmer Technologies is intent on controlling the world-wide food supply with their novel UtopiaBot technology. Play as Dr. Teagan Wixx who must confront Emmer and their controversial food revolution as she also struggles with a complex and very personal mystery.
